title: Jordan 1 High Brooklyn Black (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Brooklyn Black Womens delivers a bold and elevated take on the iconic silhouette through its fully blacked out execution and platform inspired build. The black upper creates a sleek and commanding presence, while flat pewter accents add subtle depth. The structure feels more substantial, giving the classic design a modern twist.

Fans of the Jordan 1 appreciate how variations like this reimagine the silhouette while maintaining its identity. The all black colorway enhances versatility, making it suitable for a wide range of styles. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage design with a contemporary and fashion forward update.

The Air Jordan 1 High Brooklyn Black Womens was released on December 12, 2023 with a retail price of $165.

title: Jordan 1 High OG Ruby (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 High OG Ruby (Women’s) brings a bold Varsity Red/Black-White palette to the timeless Air Jordan silhouette, delivering instant statement style with everyday versatility. Premium leather overlays pop in rich ruby tones against crisp white panels, while deep black accents on the Swoosh, collar, and laces sharpen the contrast for a high-impact look. Classic details, like the woven Nike Air tongue tag, iconic Wings insignia, and a perforated toe box, anchor the design in hoops heritage. A padded high-cut collar supports the ankle for a secure, confident feel, and the sculpted lines of the OG shape keep the profile sleek and flattering on foot.

Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a durable rubber outsole with pivot-circle traction provide comfort and grip from first wear to last step. Whether paired with tailored streetwear or dressed-down basics, the Jordan 1 High OG Ruby (Style: FD2596-602) elevates any outfit with its energetic color blocking and polished materials. The crisp white midsole frames the upper and enhances the silhouette’s proportions, while the red outsole adds a final punch of color. Designed for all-day wear and all-season appeal, it’s the kind of pair that turns quick errands into runway moments and makes every rotation feel fresh.

Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Air Jordan DNA with striking Varsity Red flair, delivering standout style, comfort you can count on, and a versatile colorway that shines in any rotation.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Día De Muertos
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Día De Muertos is a tribute to the rich tradition and the Day of the Dead celebration. Its design encapsulates the vibrant and respectful spirit of Día De Muertos with color schemes that pay homage to the traditional Mexican holiday. The quality construction with classic Jordan 1 detailing makes it a comfortable yet stylish choice.​
​​
​The sneaker's design elements reflect a modern interpretation of a timeless silhouette. The cushioning of the Zoom Air unit ensures a comfy stride while the unique colorway and detailing resonate with the tradition it represents, making it a meaningful and fashionable choice.​
​​
​Step into a legacy of style and cultural richness with the Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Día De Muertos. Released on October 21, 2023, and retailing at $165, this sneaker is a beautiful blend of tradition, comfort, and modern design that will make a significant addition to your collection.​
​​
​DISCLAIMER: Paint patterns may slightly differ on each pair of the Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Día De Muertos.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Legend Coffee
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Legend Coffee is a coffee-colored inspired colorway that pulls design inspiration from the OG Jordan 1, which was MJ’s original signature shoe.

This is a luxurious high-top silhouette crafted with premium suede, mesh, and synthetic textures. The neutral palette of Legend Medium Brown, Fossil, Legend Coffee, and Sail pairs with the laid-back design and radiates a relaxed vibe. Legend Coffee is seen on the quarter panel and perforated toebox, while Legend Medium Brown decorates the eyestay, heel, and collar. The dark brown fossil-colored Nike Swoosh is a focal point and matches the outsole.

StockX experts think that Formula 23 foam found in the outsole is what provides comfort (did you notice the CMFT in the colorway’s name?) and sets this shoe apart from others. The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Legend Coffee sneaker was released on January 20, 2024, with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 1 High OG First in Flight (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 High OG First in Flight (Women's) updates the Air Jordan High OG with a colorway that pays tribute to the Wright Brothers and Michael Jordan’s accomplishments while at University of North Carolina.

The First in Flight (Women's) Jordan 1 High OG features a smooth leather construction with a Sail base and colorblocking overlays in University Blue and ultra-dark Midnight Navy. In addition, the signature Swoosh logos come in University Blue, while the Air Jordan Wings logo displays University Gold. While Sail’s slightly yellow hue gives the sneaker a vintage feel, University Blue is Jordan Brand’s take on the University of North Carolina’s Carolina Blue. Padding around the collar protects the ankle, while the encapsulated Nike Air-Sole unit provides responsive cushioning.

Our experts at StockX like the collegiate-inspired insole, which features the letters ‘A’ and ’23,’ Jordan’s famous jersey number. The women’s size Jordan 1 High OG First in Flight (Women's) was released on July 10, 2024, and retailed at $180.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT London
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT London is made up of a rubber outsole and a leather upper, with a light smoke grey color palette.

This High Zoom Air Jordan 1 comes in photon dust-light smoke grey-grey fog colorway. The sneaker features the "Photon Dust" colorway at its tumbled leather uppers, Swooshes, overlays and ankle flaps. This palette references London’s foggy climate. In addition, the Zoom tongue branding and ball-and-Wings logos are rendered in a dark teal color with pale peach tones on the collars and mesh tongues and eggshell-colored midsoles.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT London was released on the 27th of February 2021, and retailed for $175.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Yellow Ochre (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Bicoastal
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Dark Powder Blue
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Dark Powder Blue refreshes a legendary silhouette with modern comfort and a cool-weather palette. Sail, Blue Grey, Light Silver, and Dark Powder Blue layers play across soft suede and durable textiles, creating depth and dimension that looks sharp from courtside to city streets. Signature design cues, like the cut-out Swoosh, padded high-cut collar, and classic Wings logo, nod to the heritage of the Air Jordan 1 while updated materials deliver an elevated feel. Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a lightweight foam midsole are engineered for day-long wear, pairing stable support with a smooth, springy ride. The traction pattern grips with confidence, and the plush tongue and lining round out a locked-in, easygoing fit.

Designed for style versatility, the Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 DV1307-104 complements everyday fits and standout looks alike. The tonal balance of Dark Powder Blue with Sail and Light Silver makes it an effortless match to denim, joggers, and tailoring, while thoughtful details, stitched overlays, breathable panels, and refined edge finishes, enhance durability and polish. Whether you’re collecting Air Jordan icons or seeking a reliable daily rotation piece, this pair strikes the ideal blend of heritage and innovation, delivering the familiar Air Jordan 1 profile with a noticeably softer step and refined craftsmanship.

Our team loves this product because it combines the timeless appeal of the Jordan 1 High with upgraded cushioning and a versatile Dark Powder Blue colorway that elevates any outfit.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Terra Burnt Sunrise
Jordan 1 High Brooklyn Dark Spruce Green (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Pine Green Orange Blaze (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Pine Green Orange Blaze (Women's) is a high-top basketball shoe. Its stylish color scheme includes green, orange, and crème with black shoelaces. The shoe is made of suede and mesh, making them more comfortable and breathable.

With features like the Air Jordan Wing symbol on the ankle, this shoe for women is reminiscent of the original Air Jordan 1 sneaker. It has a rounded toe cap with ventilation holes, a serrated outsole, and Swoosh symbols on the sidewall and the Nike Air label on the tongue. Suede panels on the upper add something retro to the aesthetic, and the black laces complete the look.

The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Pine Green Orange Blaze (Women's) is a good basketball shoe because of its air cushioning system and grippy soles for traction on indoor or outdoor courts. Our team is most impressed with its color blocking and old-school vibe. Nike released this shoe on September 7, 2023. It originally retailed for $150.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Barely Grape (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Barely Grape Womens delivers comfort driven innovation through a soft and modern palette. Photon dust forms a neutral base, while barely grape and lapis accents introduce gentle color that feels fresh without overpowering the silhouette. The Zoom Air CMFT 2 build emphasizes cushioning and flexibility, subtly updating the traditional high top structure for everyday wear.

Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it merges heritage design with contemporary comfort enhancements. The muted tones make it versatile, while the layered materials add depth and dimension. Fans appreciate how the CMFT line evolves the Jordan 1 without erasing its core identity, creating a balance between nostalgia and progress. It stands as a refined interpretation of a classic, blending performance updates with a calm and expressive color story.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Barely Grape Womens was released on March 1, 2023 with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 1 High Golf Gift Giving Pack
description:
Elevate every round with the Jordan 1 High Golf Gift Giving Pack, a heritage icon reimagined for the course. Dressed in Metallic Silver, Photon Dust, and crisp White, this high-cut silhouette brings standout shine to the fairway while preserving the timeless lines of the original Jordan 1. The premium upper feels supportive around the ankle, and the padded collar helps lock in comfort from tee box to clubhouse. Classic details, Wings logo, bold Swoosh, and clean paneling, pair with the festive sheen of the Gift Giving Pack to deliver head-turning style no matter the lie.

Purpose-built for performance, the Jordan 1 High Golf features a grippy, course-ready outsole engineered for reliable traction through drives, approaches, and putts. A cushioned midsole softens impact over 18, while the secure lace-up fit keeps you planted through your swing. Subtle durability touches and easy-to-wipe materials make post-round care simple, ensuring the Metallic Silver finish keeps its polished look. From early-morning dew to afternoon sun, this model blends stability and comfort with the swagger of hoops heritage, making it as versatile as it is visually striking. Style code FD6815-001, released 11/17/2023.

Our team loves this product because it blends tour-ready traction and daylong comfort with a bold, gift-worthy finish that shines on and off the course.

title: Jordan 1 High Brooklyn Coconut Milk Pine Green (Women's)
Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy Neutral Grey
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy Neutral Grey brings refined versatility to the classic silhouette, pairing a clean white base with rich midnight navy overlays and soft neutral grey accents. Crafted with a smooth leather upper, it features the signature perforated toe box for breathability, a padded collar for lasting comfort, and a nylon tongue capped with the Jumpman for that timeless finish. The gum medium brown outsole not only adds a vintage-inspired touch but also enhances grip, complementing the shoe’s low-profile stance and everyday wearability. Style code 553558-146 and the White/Neutral Grey/Gum Medium Brown/Midnight Navy colorway make this pair an easy standout in rotation, subtle enough for daily fits, yet bold enough to anchor a look. 

Underfoot, a durable rubber cupsole and an encapsulated Air unit in the heel deliver a familiar Jordan ride: supportive, stable, and comfortable from first step to last. Crisp stitching, classic Wings branding at the heel, and polished color blocking nod to heritage while feeling modern and effortless. Whether you’re styling it with denim, tailoring, or athleisure, the Jordan 1 Low model offers the kind of adaptability that elevates outfits without trying too hard. Released on 2025-04-20, this pair captures the enduring appeal of the AJ1 lineage with a fresh, contemporary twist that works across seasons and settings.

Our team loves this product because the refined navy-and-grey palette, cushioned feel, and traction-ready gum sole make it a go-to sneaker for all-day wear and easy styling.

title: Jordan 1 Low OG Obsidian UNC
description:
The Jordan 1 Low OG Obsidian UNC brings back a color scheme inspired by Michael Jordan’s alma mater, the University of North Carolina. Featuring an all-leather upper, this low-top iteration mirrors the beloved AJ1 High "Obsidian" with obsidian overlays, a university blue heel, and a sail base for a clean yet bold contrast. The timeless silhouette is finished with Nike Air branding on the tongue and the iconic Wings logo on the heel, staying true to its heritage.

This release blends nostalgia with everyday wearability, offering a sleek and versatile look for both Jordan enthusiasts and casual sneaker fans. The premium leather construction ensures durability, while the off-white stitched midsole and dark blue outsole complete the aesthetic. Whether you’re lacing up for the streets or keeping them fresh for special occasions, this pair delivers classic Jordan DNA.

Released on March 29, 2025, for a retail price of $140, the Jordan 1 Low OG Obsidian UNC delivers an iconic colorway in a low-top form. With its perfect mix of heritage and style, this sneaker is a must-have for any collection.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Space Jam Magic Ball
Jordan 1 Low OG Rookie of the Year
description:
The Jordan 1 Low OG Rookie of the Year pays homage to Michael Jordan's stellar first season in the NBA. This sleek sneaker features a premium Sail leather upper, accented with Black overlays and Golden Harvest details. The iconic Swoosh logo in Gym Red adds a pop of color, while the classic Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel completes the retro look.

Designed for both style and comfort, these low-top sneakers boast the original Air cushioning in the sole, providing excellent support for everyday wear. The perforated toe box ensures breathability, while the durable rubber outsole offers superior traction on various surfaces. Our experts state this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a piece of basketball history to their collection, combining vintage aesthetics with modern performance.

title: Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate brings one of Jordan Brand’s most legendary color stories into a low cut format that feels fresh and accessible. The black, starfish, and sail combination instantly calls back to the Shattered Backboard legacy, tying the shoe to one of the most iconic moments in Michael Jordan history. Even in low form, the color blocking carries undeniable energy and familiarity.

Fans love this release because it offers a new way to wear a beloved story. The Jordan 1 Low silhouette makes the Shattered Backboard theme feel more casual and versatile, while still honoring its roots. Collectors appreciate this pair as a bridge between nostalgia and everyday wear, celebrating Jordan lore without feeling locked into a retro moment.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

title: Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir
description:
Air Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir brings a muted and confident color story to one of Jordan Brand’s most versatile silhouettes, leaning into balance rather than flash. The combination of light smoke grey and off noir feels calm and intentional, giving the Jordan 1 Low a refined presence that works effortlessly across everyday wear. It highlights the silhouette’s timeless paneling and proportions, letting form and color placement do the work instead of relying on bold contrast.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it feels endlessly wearable without sacrificing identity. The understated palette allows the Air Jordan 1 Low’s heritage to shine through, making it a natural rotation staple rather than a one moment statement. It represents why the Jordan 1 continues to resonate, adapting to modern tastes while staying rooted in its original DNA and cultural importance.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir was released on 07/11/2025with a retail price of $125

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Concord
description:
Jordan is going back to the classics in 2023, releasing a special edition Air Jordan 1 Low in the popular black and white Concord colorway.

The Jordan 1 Low SE Concord’s draw inspiration from the Air Jordan 11 Concord, highlighted by the sneakers combination of black patent leather, and white leather uppers. Jordan brand used a translucent blue outsole, and added a white Air Jordan Wings logo placed on the heel of each sneaker.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Concord released January 17, 2023, with a retail price of $120.

title: Jordan 1 Low Element Gore-Tex Black Challenge Red
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Element Gore Tex Black Challenge Red pushes the Jordan 1 into all weather territory while keeping its attitude intact. The black base gives the shoe a serious and utilitarian feel, while challenge red accents add energy and contrast that nod to classic Jordan color storytelling. It feels rugged and ready, designed for function without sacrificing identity.

Collectors are drawn to this version because it expands what a Jordan 1 can be. The Element Gore Tex construction gives the shoe purpose beyond style, making it appealing to fans who want performance and durability wrapped in a familiar silhouette. It represents evolution done right, where innovation supports the design instead of overshadowing it, keeping the Jordan 1 relevant in changing environments.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Element Gore Tex Black Challenge Red was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $205

title: Jordan 1 Low Triple White
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 is a silhouette that arrives in a monochromatic colorway.

The smooth white leather upper of this Low Air Jordan 1 has perforations in the toe box, white leather overlays, and a white leather Swoosh. This sneaker also features a white rubber cupsole and an Air-sole unit in the heel. A white debossed Jumpman appears on the white padded tongue, a black Jumpman boasts on the white insole, and an embroidered white Wings logo is displayed on the white heel.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 was released on September 1st, 2022, at a price of $110.

title: Jordan 1 Low Triple Black
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Triple Black (2022) was released as an additional colorway in the Jordan 1 line.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Black 2022 has perforated detailing on the toe box for added breathability. The shoe includes a padded collar and matching black laces. The outsole consists of durable rubber, which provides traction and stability on a variety of surfaces. The sneaker has a low top silhouette which allows for easy movement and the Swoosh is visible on both sides.

We think that the primary feature of the Jordan 1 Low Triple Black (2022) is its all-black colorway. The entire shoe, from the upper to the outsole, is a solid black color. This creates a minimalist and sleek aesthetic, with no contrasting colors or patterns to detract from the shoe's simple and clean design. The shoe was released on September 27th, 2022 at a retail price of $90.

title: Jordan 1 Low Black White Grey
description:
The Jordan 1 Low White Black Grey features a white leather upper with black overlays and grey Swooshes. From there, Jordan Wings and Jumpman logo embroideries on the heel and tongue complete the design.

The Jordan 1 Low White Black Grey released in the Summer of 2021 and retailed for $90.

title: Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe takes cues from the 2018 Air Jordan 1 High Bred Toe with its signature black and red color blocking. The upper is composed of white, black, and red leather, with black and red leather smothering the vamp, Swoosh, and heel while white leather is prominent on the quarter panel. From there, an embroidered Wing logo on the heel and a Jumpman tongue label complete the design.

The Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe released in December of 2021 and retailed for $100.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Sail Deep Pewter Elephent Print
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Sail Deep Pewter Elephant Print brings back one of the most beloved textures in Jordan Brand history, the elephant print pattern that first appeared on the original Air Jordan 3 and has since become a recurring detail collectors actively seek out. A sail base keeps the shoe grounded and versatile, while deep pewter, gamma grey, and game royal accents layer in depth and contrast across the low top silhouette. The elephant print panels give this pair a textured, tactile quality that sets it apart from standard leather or suede Jordan 1 releases.

Elephant print holds a special place in sneaker culture, often signaling a more premium or thoughtfully designed release whenever it appears on a silhouette outside the Jordan 3 itself. Collectors chase pairs like this specifically because the print adds visual interest and a bit of Jordan Brand history to a shoe, giving it more depth than a straightforward colorway. The low top build keeps things versatile for everyday wear, making this pair a strong pickup for both longtime Jordan 1 collectors and those drawn in by the elephant print detail specifically.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Sail Deep Pewter Elephant Print was released on November 15, 2022 with a retail price of $140.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Pinksicle Patent (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 Low SE Black Pinksicle Patent (Women's) brings a glossy material treatment and a contrasting pink palette to the familiar low-top silhouette. Pinksicle, White, and Black give the design a balance of bright and neutral tones, while the patent finish adds another visual element. For collectors exploring variations on the Jordan 1 Low, this edition offers a distinctive combination of color and surface character.

The low-cut shape works naturally with denim, casual trousers, or shorts, giving the sneaker flexibility across everyday outfits. Black and white provide easy connections to wardrobe basics, while Pinksicle can serve as the main accent or coordinate with smaller accessories. The patent treatment changes how the design catches the light, making texture part of the styling appeal. Fans who enjoy recognizable Jordan silhouettes with more expressive finishes can build around this pair without needing additional statement pieces to complete the look.

Released on May 1, 2022, the Jordan 1 Low SE Black Pinksicle Patent (Women's) retailed for $130.

title: Jordan 1 Low Panda (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) arrives in a white, black, and white color palette.

The Low Panda Jordan 1 (2023) (W) has an upper that is constructed from durable materials, including a combination of supple leather and suede. The shoe's cushioned midsole and supportive collar ensure a comfortable fit. The outsole is made of a durable rubber material with a traditional tread pattern, providing traction and stability. The shoe's toe box is perforated for ventilation. The sneaker features black Swoosh branding on either lateral side, the Jumpman logo on the tongue, and the Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel.

The women’s rendition of the Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) was released on March 10, 2023, and sold for a retail price of $110.

title: Jordan 3 Retro True Blue (2026)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 is the sixth retro release of one of the four original 1988 Air Jordan 3 colorways, featuring a white tumbled leather upper, Cement Grey elephant print across the toe and heel in a thinner, more refined pattern that closely resembles the 1988 original's specification rather than the heavier print of some previous retros, True Blue accents on the sock liner, Nike Air-branded heel tab, and midsole, a red Jumpman logo on the tongue and tongue interior, and a mostly grey rubber outsole completing the OG-faithful construction. The True Blue Air Jordan 3 is the only one of the model's original 1988 colorways to break from Chicago Bulls colors, relying entirely on color and design to carry its iconic status without team affiliation, representing a pivotal moment in Tinker Hatfield's design demonstrating that the Jordan signature line could succeed outside of the Bulls palette. The 2026 retro also includes the throwback MJ face box packaging that distinguished the 2016 retro, with full family sizing spanning men's at $230, Grade School at $155, Preschool at $95, and Toddler at $80, available simultaneously across Nike SNKRS, Nike.com, Foot Locker, Finish Line, DSG, and Hibbett on release day. The 2026 release marks the tenth anniversary of the most recent 2016 retro and the first time the True Blue has been available since, making it one of the most anticipated Jordan retros of the summer 2026 calendar.

Released July 18, 2026 at $230 retail via Nike SNKRS and select Jordan Brand retailers globally with style code IF4396-102.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 was released on July 18, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad brings a more personal and story driven approach to the Jordan 3, using a mix of sail, black, university red, pale ivory, and palomino to create a layered and thoughtful design. The Jordan 3 already carries deep heritage with its visible air unit and iconic shape, but this version adds a narrative element that makes it feel more meaningful than a standard release. The tones work together to create a warm and slightly vintage feel across the upper.

What makes this pair stand out is the message behind it. Jordan Brand has leaned into themed releases more over time, and this one connects directly to everyday life in a way that feels relatable. For collectors, it offers something that goes beyond aesthetics, turning a classic silhouette into a piece that represents appreciation and storytelling within sneaker culture.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $215.

title: Jordan 3 Retro OG Black Cement (2024)
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro OG Black Cement (2024) is one of the most hyped and sought after sneakers of 2024, making it one of the hottest drops of the holiday season.

Originally making it's debut in 1988, this colorway has become iconic in the sneaker community and is one of the most timeless designs in the entire Jordan Brand line.These sneakers famously made their debut on Jordan's feet during the 1988 All-Star Game. The Black Cement 3s last released as a retro in 2018.

The Jordan 3 Retro OG Black Cement released on November 23rd, 2024, for a retail price of $220. Our experts love the Black Cement 3s due to their storied history and iconic color blocking, making them one of the most classic sneakers in the history of sneakerhead culture.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025)
description:
Clean, crisp, and timeless, the Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) refreshes a beloved silhouette with a pristine White/White/Metallic Silver palette. The tumbled leather upper delivers a refined texture, balanced by smooth leather overlays and subtle perforations that enhance breathability. Metallic Silver accents at the eyelets and heel branding add a polished flash, while the classic Jumpman on the tongue grounds the look in heritage. Underfoot, a visible Air unit and cushioned polyurethane midsole provide day‑long comfort, and a durable rubber outsole with dependable traction patterns keeps each step confident. Style code CT8532-111 and the July 3, 2025 release date mark this pair as a standout entry in the Air Jordan 3 lineage.

With its clean lines and understated details, the Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) is built to elevate everything from tailored streetwear to everyday essentials. The padded collar, supportive heel counter, and sculpted midsole deliver a stable ride, while the white-on-white execution earns instant versatility across seasons and settings. Discreet textural hits echo the model’s iconic DNA without overpowering the minimalist aesthetic, making this a go-to choice for collectors and first-time Jordan buyers alike. Whether you’re curating a rotation of neutral sneakers or seeking a statement-making yet wearable pair, this colorway offers the perfect blend of heritage design and modern polish.

Our team loves this product because its monochrome leather construction, Metallic Silver highlights, and classic Air cushioning create a sleek, easy-to-style sneaker that feels just as good as it looks.

traits.value: Velvet Brown/Light British Tan/Rust Pink/Pearl White

title: Jordan 3 Retro Fireside (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro Fireside (Women's) brings a warm, rustic palette to one of the line’s recognizable silhouettes. Velvet Brown and Light British Tan establish the earthy color direction, while Rust Pink laces and Pearl White Jumpman branding introduce contrast. Leather and nubuck across the upper combine with elephant-print texture, giving the design several material details to appreciate beyond its overall color scheme.

Visible Air cushioning preserves a defining Jordan 3 feature, pairing the heritage presentation with comfort underfoot. A foam midsole and rubber outsole complete the construction, supporting the shoe’s role in an everyday sneaker rotation. Brown tones work naturally with dark denim, cream knitwear, and neutral trousers, while the pink accent offers another color to pick up through accessories. For collectors who enjoy seasonal interpretations of familiar retros, the Fireside edition combines established design elements with a softer palette that can anchor an autumn outfit.

Released on October 3, 2026, the Jordan 3 Retro Fireside (Women's) retailed for $205. nike.com

title: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air embraces a more expressive and seasonal approach, blending soft tones with brighter accents that reflect the energy of spring. The sail base keeps the design clean, while jade aura, iced carmine, and iris whisper details add color that feels fresh and layered. It is a version of the Jordan 3 that leans into mood and atmosphere rather than tradition alone.

Collectors are drawn to this pair for its unique palette and the way it reinterprets a classic silhouette. The mix of colors gives it a more playful and creative feel, making it stand out from more standard releases. It is a shoe that feels designed to capture a moment rather than just replicate history.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air was released on March 28, 2026 with a retail price of $215.

title: Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined
description:
Jordan is traveling back in time to 1988 for the next part of their Reimagined series, with the release of the Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined.

Jordan used the same design and specs as the original 1988 Jordan 3 silhouette to help craft the second model of the Reimagined series. The Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement is constructed with a white leather upper, and off-white colored midsoles and heel tabs, helping to give the sneaker a vintage design.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined released March 11, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

title: Jordan 3 Retro True Blue (2026) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 GS brings back one of the most iconic colorways in Jordan history, extending the legendary True Blue combination down into grade school sizing for a new generation of collectors. The White, Varsity Red, True Blue, Cement Grey, and Anthracite palette stays faithful to the original design, featuring the signature elephant print detailing and visible Air unit that made the Jordan 3 a turning point in the line's history. This GS release lets younger fans experience one of the most celebrated color stories in sneaker culture firsthand.

True Blue holds a legendary status among Jordan collectors, often cited as one of the definitive colorways that helped cement the Jordan 3's place in sneaker history. Bringing this combination to grade school sizing gives families a chance to introduce younger collectors to a genuinely historic release rather than a diluted alternative. It is a pair that carries real weight regardless of size, thanks to the strength of the original True Blue design.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 GS was released on July 18, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025) is a revival of an iconic silhouette that exudes stealthy elegance. Wrapped in premium black nubuck, the sneaker showcases subtle accents of dark charcoal on its signature elephant print overlays. The monochromatic design is elevated by black patent leather, unique elephant print laces and minimal black and chrome branding, creating a clean yet powerful aesthetic that resonates with Jordan’s legendary "Black Cat" persona.

This modern interpretation of the Black Cat features updated materials, making it as functional as it is stylish. The classic Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel maintains its timeless appeal, while visible Air units in the sole provide both comfort and an enduring retro vibe. This sleek design perfectly balances contemporary flair with Jordan’s rich heritage.

Releasing on January 11, 2025, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025) comes with a retail price of $200. This updated edition remains true to its roots, cementing its place as a staple for collectors and sneaker fans who value iconic design and unmatched craftsmanship.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Orange Citrus (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Orange Citrus Womens brings a vibrant twist to a silhouette known for its balance of heritage and bold design. The white cement grey fire red multi color base is energized by orange citrus accents that add a fresh and expressive feel without overpowering the classic structure. Signature elements like the elephant print overlays and visible air unit remain front and center, grounding the shoe in its original identity.

This pair resonates with collectors who appreciate when Jordan Brand experiments within established frameworks. The added color brings a new personality to the Jordan 3 while still respecting the details that made it iconic. It feels lively and modern, offering a standout option that still connects to the lineage of the model. For those who enjoy mixing heritage with updated energy, this release delivers a strong balance.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Orange Citrus Womens was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair
description:
Air Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair feels deeply rooted in connection and legacy, using one of the most beloved Jordan silhouettes to tell a more emotional story. The Air Jordan 3 has always been about balance and heritage, and this colorway leans into that through thoughtful tones and subtle detailing that suggest unity and shared history rather than loud statement making.

Collectors are drawn to this pair because of its quiet confidence. The familiar shape anchors the design, while the Family Affair theme adds meaning beyond aesthetics. It appeals to fans who value Jordan releases that emphasize storytelling and emotional resonance, reminding everyone that the brand’s impact extends beyond performance and into culture and relationships.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair was released on10/25/2025with a retail price of $215.

title: Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air brings a fresh twist to a classic silhouette. Its black leather upper is complemented by grey suede overlays, replacing the traditional elephant print, and features mismatched Nike Air heel tabs, one reversed for a unique aesthetic. Accents of chile red, military blue, and coconut milk add vibrant pops of color, while the red Jumpman logo on the tongue ties the design together.

This release pays homage to early Jordan samples, embracing imperfections as marks of rarity. The combination of premium materials and unconventional details makes this sneaker a standout addition to any collection. Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the Jordan legacy, the Rare Air offers a distinctive style statement.

The Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air was released on May 30, 2025, at a retail price of $210. Its colorway includes black, chile red, neutral grey, military blue, and coconut milk. This pair checks every box: iconic shape, bold updates, and that rare, sample-inspired flair. Add in the custom packaging and you’ve got a drop that’s as memorable on the shelf as it is on foot. This release is a fresh chapter in the AJ3 story.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Black
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Black reimagines the timeless AJ3 through a rugged Denim and Black construction accented by Gym Red detailing. The denim upper adds texture and character, giving the silhouette a slightly worn in feel while preserving the signature shape that defines the Jordan 3. Red accents provide sharp contrast, emphasizing key design lines without overpowering the dark base.

This collaboration stands out because it merges classic American workwear with basketball heritage. The denim finish transforms the familiar silhouette into something more tactile and expressive, while still honoring its original structure. Fans of both brands appreciate when material innovation drives the update rather than dramatic redesign. It is a bold and collectible take on a model that continues to evolve through thoughtful partnerships.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Black was released on February 21, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women’s) is a stunning continuation of the celebrated partnership between A Ma Maniére and Jordan Brand. Known for its luxury aesthetics and storytelling, A Ma Maniére delivers yet another masterpiece with this black, violet ore, and flat pewter colorway. The sneaker, part of the larger "While You Were Sleeping" collection, stays true to the brand's signature style with premium materials and thoughtful design details. This release carries the same high standard that made the first A Ma Maniére Jordan 3 an instant classic.

This iteration features a black tumbled leather upper paired with premium suede overlays, creating a sophisticated yet edgy look. The violet ore accents subtly elevate the design, adding a unique touch that distinguishes it from other releases. A vintage-inspired midsole and outsole bring a worn-in, timeless vibe that fits perfectly with A Ma Maniére’s carefully curated aesthetic. Details like the Nike Air branding on the heel and the mix of Jumpman and A Ma Maniére logos on the tongues further emphasize the sneaker’s premium appeal. Inside, the diamond-quilted lining delivers that luxurious feel the brand is known for.

Released on August 20, 2024, the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG A Ma Maniére (While You Were Sleeping) edition retailed at $250. With its striking black, flat pewter, and violet ore colorway, this sneaker is the perfect fusion of luxury and heritage. As a highly anticipated drop, it showcases the elevated craftsmanship and storytelling that A Ma Maniére brings to every collaboration. Whether you’re a collector or someone looking to step up your style, this Jordan 3 is a must-have addition to any sneaker rotation.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Brazil
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Brazil celebrates the energy and color associated with Brazilian culture through one of the most beloved silhouettes in Jordan Brand history. The Air Jordan 3 remains iconic because of its visible Air unit, elephant print overlays, and direct connection to Michael Jordan’s late 1980s dominance, and this edition introduces a vibrant combination of Racer Blue, Lucky Green, Blue Void, and Varsity Maize that immediately stands out from more traditional Jordan palettes. The colorful presentation feels lively and expressive while still maintaining the recognizable structure and proportions that made the Jordan 3 a permanent staple within sneaker culture.

Fans gravitate toward international themed Jordan releases because they connect basketball heritage with global inspiration and storytelling. The Brazil concept brings warmth and energy to the silhouette through bright accent colors that reflect the country’s unmistakable visual identity without overwhelming the shoe’s classic design. Collectors especially appreciate how the Jordan 3 continues adapting to new themes while preserving the elements that made it revolutionary when first introduced by Tinker Hatfield. The bold palette gives the pair a celebratory personality that feels perfectly suited for warmer weather styling and standout summer sneaker rotations.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Brazil was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $225.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) brings back one of the most recognizable non-OG colorways in the Jordan 4 archive, first introduced in 2013 during a wave of bold, lifestyle-driven releases. Dressed in fire red with white, black, and cement grey accents, the sneaker leans into high-impact color blocking that instantly stands out. The red nubuck upper gives the silhouette depth and texture, while black wings and midsole hits ground the design with contrast.

The "Toro Bravo" nickname draws from Spanish bullfighting culture, a theme Jordan Brand explored during the early 2010s when experimenting beyond traditional Bulls-inspired palettes. Unlike OG Jordan 4s tied directly to on-court moments, this pair became a streetwear favorite for its unapologetic use of color and premium materials. Over time, it’s been embraced as one of the most memorable modern-era Jordan 4s, bridging the gap between retro heritage and bold expression.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) released, it retailed for $220. With its fire red, white, black, and cement grey colorway and its status as a fan-favorite return, this release reintroduces a defining Jordan 4 look that continues to resonate across sneaker culture.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) brings back one of the most understated icons in the Jordan lineup. Covered entirely in black with subtle touches of light graphite, the sneaker lives up to its namesake, a nod to one of Michael Jordan’s own nicknames from his playing days. The soft nubuck upper and tonal detailing give it a refined, stealth-like presence that feels effortlessly cool no matter how it’s styled.

Originally released in 2006, the "Black Cat" quickly earned a cult following for its minimalist design and unmatched versatility. The all-black finish strips the 4 down to its essentials, letting the shape and materials take center stage. For 2025, Jordan Brand brings back the clean construction fans have been waiting for, along with the "Nike Air" branding on the heel for an extra touch of authenticity that collectors love.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on November 28, 2025.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (2026)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow brings a vibrant, high visibility colorway into the beloved Jordan 4 silhouette, combining white, tour yellow, dark blue grey, and black into a genuinely striking presentation. The Rare Air naming ties this release to Michael Jordan's legendary competitive excellence, a phrase often associated with his singular, unmatched basketball talent. Tour yellow gives this pair significant standout presence, distinguishing it clearly from more common Jordan 4 color releases through its bold, energetic accent.

Rare Air as a concept has carried special significance within Jordan Brand's storytelling, celebrating Michael Jordan's singular basketball genius and the rarefied air of excellence he operated within throughout his career. This tour yellow execution gives the Jordan 4 genuine visual boldness, appealing to collectors who want their retro pairs to command serious attention. Fans of both Jordan Brand's storied competitive legacy and vibrant, high visibility colorways find this Rare Air release a compelling way to engage with the silhouette's continued evolution.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow was released on September 5, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

title: Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade covers the AJ4 in shades of yellow that make the collaboration recognizable at a glance. Croc textured leather adds depth across the upper, so the color does more than carry the design on its own. J Balvin’s upside down smiley face appears on one heel, while Nike Air branding marks the other, continuing the uneven branding details found in his Jordan releases.

Smaller touches connect the pair to Balvin’s Colombian roots. The lace dubraes carry "JUST DO IT." and "SOLO HAZLO.", and the color story draws on the vivid scenery associated with Medellín and Colombia’s Caño Cristales river. For collectors who have followed his previous Air Jordans, this marks his move to the Jordan 4 after collaborations on earlier models. Its bright treatment gives the partnership a new look while preserving the AJ4’s familiar structure.

It is a bold pair for Balvin fans and AJ4 collectors who enjoy color and close up details. The Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade releases September 25, 2026, with a retail price of $225.

title: Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club was one of the most anticipated kicks of early 2026, celebrating an early chapter of MJ fandom with a fresh take on a classic silhouette. Dressed in sail, black, and university red, this retro captures a crisp yet bold look that marries clean neutrals with eye-catching pops of color. The sail leather upper sets a natural base, while a black heel tab and wing eyelets give the sneaker structure and contrast that elevates even the simplest outfit. University red accents on the Jumpman logo bring that classic Jordan color energy to the mix.

This release channels the spirit of the original Air Jordan Flight Club, the fan membership program from the late 1980s and early 1990s that connected Jordan enthusiasts through newsletters, posters, and exclusive gear. That sense of community and shared passion is woven into this release, with Flight Club logos on the tongue and sockliner tapping into a deeper fan culture that goes beyond just the aesthetic. It’s a sneaker that nods to history while feeling right at home in today’s sneaker scene.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on January 17, 2026. With its refined palette, deep collector roots, and throwback Nike Air branding, it’s a standout addition to any rotation that values authentic story and timeless style.

title: Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick builds on Nigel Sylvester’s growing presence within Jordan Brand, translating his BMX-driven perspective into a storytelling-focused design. Dressed in sail with cinnabar, anthracite, and muslin accents, the sneaker carries a worn-in aesthetic that reflects Sylvester’s real-world riding style.

Nigel Sylvester has carved out a unique space within the Jordan ecosystem, blending street riding with sneaker culture in a way that feels authentic rather than manufactured. The "Brick After Brick" concept speaks to progression and repetition, themes that mirror both BMX culture and Jordan Brand’s legacy of iteration. Subtle distressing and tonal variation give the shoe a sense of lived-in character.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick released, it retailed for $230. With its sail, cinnabar, anthracite, and muslin colorway, this collaboration stands out as one of the more narrative-driven takes on the Jordan 4 in recent years.

title: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) is a certified legend reintroduced for a new generation. Revered since its 1989 debut, this Tinker Hatfield-designed icon is returning in its most accurate form yet. Expect a crisp summit white leather base with signature cement grey speckles on the midsole and wings, black accents on the mesh and heel, and hits of fire red that keep it rooted in Air Jordan DNA.

What sets the 2025 edition apart is the focus on shape and precision. Jordan Brand took the time to recreate the OG ‘89 cut, giving fans that perfect toe box, padded collar, and clean lines reminiscent of its original glory. Whether you’re a longtime collector or first-time buyer, this drop is poised to be a cornerstone of any sneaker rotation and yes, the Nike Air branding on the heel is back in full force.

The Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) released on May 24, 2025, for a retail price of $225. With its summit white, fire red, tech grey, and black colorway, this drop cements its place as one of the year’s most iconic retros.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo 2026 GS revives one of the most celebrated non original Air Jordan 4 colorways in a grade school sized release that keeps the bold energy of the classic intact. Fire Red suede covers the upper with an unmistakable intensity, while black detailing and Cement Grey accents give the sneaker the aggressive contrast that made the Toro Bravo colorway so memorable when it first appeared. The Air Jordan 4’s layered construction, visible Air cushioning, and mesh paneling all work perfectly with bright red palettes, giving the silhouette a loud but balanced presence.

Fans continue obsessing over Toro Bravo releases because they represent the era when Jordan Brand leaned fully into expressive lifestyle colorways outside traditional Chicago inspired blocking. The rich red suede instantly commands attention, making the sneaker feel energetic from every angle while still staying rooted in classic Jordan design language. Younger collectors especially connect with grade school versions like this because they preserve the exact personality and details of the adult release. For Jordan fans, the return of Toro Bravo always feels significant because it remains one of the defining red based colorways in the history of the Air Jordan 4.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo 2026 GS was released on May 30, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Lakers
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Lakers taps into one of basketball’s most iconic franchises with a bold, color-forward approach. Dressed in imperial purple with vibrant gold on the iconic Nike Air logo on the heel and black accents throughout the upper and midsole, this version immediately channels Los Angeles energy and the legacy of the Lakers. The premium suede upper gives the shoe a rich texture, while contrasting details across the wings, eyelets, and midsole add visual punch.

Rather than recreating a past on-court look, this release feels like a lifestyle tribute to the culture surrounding the team. The purple and gold palette has long symbolized excellence and showmanship, and applying it to the Jordan 4 creates a statement sneaker built for expression. It’s loud without being chaotic, designed to stand out whether styled casually or as a centerpiece of a fit.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro Lakers released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on March 7, 2026. With its bold colors and unmistakable inspiration, this pair delivers a confident take on a classic silhouette tied to basketball royalty.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone pairs rugged earth tones with iconic hoops heritage for a look that’s effortlessly modern. Dressed in Cave Stone, Black, and Moon Particle, this AJ4 layers a premium upper with tactile overlays, breathable black mesh panels, and sculpted eyestays that sharpen the silhouette. Classic TPU wings and a supportive midfoot cage echo the original design language, while the visible Air unit and plush foam underfoot deliver the cushioned ride the Jordan 4 is known for. The palette feels tailor-made for fall fits, grounding streetwear and denim with a refined, versatile edge.

Details matter, and this pair gets them right: the heel flaunts bold Nike Air branding, a heritage touch that resonates with longtime fans, paired with the FV5029-200 style code for easy reference. A padded collar, secure lacing system, and durable rubber outsole with grippy traction make it a dependable daily go-to as well as a collection-worthy standout. Whether you’re rotating it for lifestyle wear or styling it with minimalist layers, the Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone brings depth, texture, and timeless appeal to any lineup.

Our team loves this product because it blends season-ready tones, classic comfort, and heritage details into a versatile sneaker that elevates every outfit.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined
description:
Rediscover a classic with the Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined, dropping on February 17, 2024. This sneaker is a fresh take on the iconic Jordan 4, bringing a contemporary edge to a timeless design. This new release ditches the traditional nubuck, and incorporates a fresh take on the upper with a supple black leather.The Reimagined series, known for breathing new life into classic Air Jordans with innovative materials, makes this release a true collector's item.

The colorway in Black/Cement Grey/Varsity Red/Summit White perfectly balances boldness and tradition. This reinvention of the legendary "Bred" aesthetic combines the familiar with the unexpected, creating a sneaker that's both nostalgic and forward-looking. It's a must-have for both long-time Jordan fans and newcomers to the sneaker scene.

Priced at $210, the Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined is set to be a versatile addition to any collection. Whether you're hitting the streets or just showcasing your style, this sneaker blends history, innovation, and style in a way only Jordan Brand can. Don't miss out on this blend of past and future – grab your pair and step into a new era of sneaker culture.

title: Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy blends basketball heritage with skateboarding functionality, continuing the successful partnership between Nike SB and Jordan Brand. Following the hype of the "Pine Green" release, this edition swaps green for navy, adding a sleek and timeless twist to the SB-enhanced Air Jordan 4 silhouette. The upper features summit white leather with navy accents on the eyelets, heel tab, and midsole, delivering a clean yet bold aesthetic. A vibrant red Jumpman logo on the tongue and insoles provides a striking contrast, while the Nike SB branding on the heel cements this crossover’s skate-ready DNA.

Designed with performance in mind, the Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy incorporates subtle modifications tailored for skateboarding. The reworked sole offers enhanced grip and flexibility, while premium materials ensure durability whether you’re on the board or the streets. The signature mesh side panels and classic lace cage maintain the AJ4’s iconic look, seamlessly merging style and function. The gum yellow outsole adds a vintage-inspired touch while improving traction—essential for both skaters and sneakerheads alike.

Landing on March 18, 2025, for a retail price of $225, the Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy marks the next evolution of this crossover collaboration. With its blend of skate and basketball culture, this release is set to make waves among collectors and casual wearers alike.

title: Jordan 4 Retro London
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro London gives the AJ4 a look shaped by the city in its name. Dark Smoke Grey suede and textured overlays create a worn, concrete inspired appearance, with Hemp and Red Bark bringing earthy contrast. The darker palette keeps the shoe restrained from a distance, but its materials and small details make it rewarding to examine up close.

London references appear throughout the release. Nike LDN branding marks the heel tab and hangtag, while an upside down "SAY LESS" tag sits beneath the tongue. Red Bark laces are also included, giving collectors another way to wear the pair while keeping its original accessories together. The release was presented as a UK and European exclusive, making its regional identity central to the design rather than simply a nickname.

For AJ4 collectors, this pair offers a specific city story through color, texture, and branding. Those details give it a distinct place beside more widely released Jordan 4s. The Jordan 4 Retro London released September 12, 2026, with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue (2024)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue 2024 stands as a beacon of Jordan Brand's innovation and style. It features an off-white leather base contrasted with the striking military blue splashed on the eyelet wings, heel, and parts of the midsole, creating a look of disciplined yet daring design. The neutral grey touches on the forefoot and outsole balance the aesthetic, highlighting the sneaker's clean lines and geometric shapes.

Every detail is meticulously crafted, with the Jumpman logo on the tongue, the 'Flight' script on the tongue's underside, and a visible Air-Sole unit encased in the sole—all of which are hallmarks of the Jordan brand's dedication to quality and performance. The industrial blue mesh inserts not only offer breathability but also complement the sneaker's color scheme, adding both function and flair. The beloved Nike Air logo graces the heel and stays true to the original 1989 iteration.

Released on May 4, 2024, at a retail price of $215, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue quickly ascended to iconic status. Collectors and sneaker enthusiasts eagerly celebrated the revival of the military blue colorway on a timeless model.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (White Lettering)
Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) makes its return as one of the most striking holiday releases in the Jordan archive. The glossy black patent leather, tonal mesh upper, and glowing hits of gamma blue and varsity maize come together for a look that’s sleek and unmistakable. It’s bold but balanced, a perfect example of how simplicity and color placement can create instant impact.

Originally introduced in 2013, the "Gamma Blue" quickly became a modern favorite among collectors. Its darker, more mysterious palette stood apart from the typical Concord and Space Jam tones, signaling a new chapter for the silhouette. The 2025 edition stays faithful to that legacy while refining the details for a sharper, more premium finish. The result is a sneaker that captures the quiet confidence of Jordan’s later career, redefined for today’s scene.

When the Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) released, it retailed for $235 and dropped on December 13, 2025. More than a decade after its debut, it remains a standout in the Air Jordan story.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026) expands on one of Jordan Brand’s most popular modern color themes, pairing the iconic AJ11 low silhouette with a university blue, white, and black palette. The glossy patent leather mudguard in Carolina blue immediately draws attention, contrasting against the white mesh upper for a look that feels both clean and seasonal.

The Air Jordan 11, originally released in 1995, is widely regarded as one of the most influential sneakers ever created, known for introducing patent leather to performance basketball footwear. Low-top versions have since become a staple for spring and summer releases, often featuring lighter colorways and lifestyle-oriented designs. The use of university blue connects the model to Michael Jordan’s collegiate roots at UNC, a theme that continues to resonate strongly across Jordan Brand’s catalog.

When the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026) released, it retailed for $195 and dropped on April 18, 2026. With its university blue, white, and black colorway, this release blends heritage inspiration with seasonal wearability, making it a standout addition to the Air Jordan 11 lineup.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024), also known as the Columbia 11s, is easily one of the most well known and beloved colorways of the Jordan 11 ever produced. Dating back to 1996, this sneaker has only retro'd twice since then, with the latest version being 10 years ago in 2014.

The Legend Blue 11s feature an all white upper with white laces and an icy blue sole. The Jumpman logo pops in a Legend Blue accent as the finishing touch on this clean colorway. Jordan was famously spotted wearing these for the first time in the 1996 All-Star game, donning the now-iconic teal blue jerseys as the East defeated the West in San Antonio by a score of 129 to 118, in which Jordan was the game's MVP.

The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) released on December 14th, 2024, for a retail price of $230. Our experts love this sneaker due to its storied history and infrequent retro releases, making this sneaker likely to be ever-more collectible as the years go on.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Playoffs Bred (2019)
description:
Jordan Brand brings back a monument of Jordan hype with the Air Jordan 11 Retro Playoffs Bred, now available on StockX. These sneakers represent MJ’s comeback from retirement to win his fourth title with the Chicago Bulls and the 1996 Finals MVP. This is the fourth time this colorway has been retroed since it’s original debut.

This Jordan 11 features a black upper with shiny patent leather overlays and red detailing. A red translucent outsole, white midsole, and "23" insignia on the heel completes the design. These sneakers released in November of 2019 and retailed for $220.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low APB Binary Blue
Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (2025)
description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (2025) is a highly anticipated release that pays homage to a legendary colorway. This low-top version features a sleek black mesh upper complemented by glossy patent leather mudguards, creating a striking contrast. The bold varsity red accents add a pop of color, while the white midsole and translucent red outsole complete the classic design. Inspired by the PE pair Michael Jordan wore during the 1996 season, this sneaker captures a significant moment in basketball history. The combination of premium materials and iconic color scheme makes this release the truest remake of the Bred colorway on the Jordan 11 Low to date. Whether you're a seasoned sneaker collector or a casual enthusiast, these kicks are designed to turn heads on and off the court. Our team thinks this product is great for those who appreciate timeless style and basketball heritage, offering a perfect blend of performance and street-ready aesthetics.

title: Jordan 11 Retro DMP Gratitude (2023)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro DMP Gratitude (2023) is a nod to the illustrious heritage encapsulated in the Jordan brand. This iconic Jordan 11 model resurfaces with a touch of the famous Defining Moments colorway. This edition is a herald of the lauded "DMP" series, bringing back the nostalgia from 2006 when it was initially released with an Air Jordan 6, embodying a timeless treasure for the Jordan lineage​.

Delving into the aesthetics, the colorway is nothing short of iconic. The upper boasts a high-cut patent leather. The usual mesh is replaced with leather that not only elevates its look but its texture. The white midsole is balanced meticulously with a translucent rubber outsole, evoking a sleek, clean design that's synonymous with the Jordan brand's premium craftsmanship.

The Metallic Gold accents echo the legendary legacy of Jordan, adorning the embossed Jumpman logo on the lateral ankle and the iconic "23" on the heels. These distinctive embellishments reflect a heritage of victory and valor, encapsulated in a sneaker that's not just worn, but celebrated. The Jordan 11 Retro DMP Gratitude (2023) released on December 9, 2023, at a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Cherry (2022)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Cherry brings a Chicago colorway to the iconic patent leather sneaker. Cherry red patent leather mudguards surround the majority of the upper, alongside white leather and a matching Cherry red Jumpman. The lining features Cherry red cotton and with the signature 23 debossed on the heel tab. An icy blue outsole and Cherry red carbon fiber plate complete 2022’s Jordan 11 iteration.

The Air Jordan 11 Cherry was released on December 10, 2022 with a retail price of $225.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garçons Homme Plus Black
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garcons Homme Plus Black brings together Jordan Brand's storied silhouette with Comme des Garcons Homme Plus, the house's more experimental menswear line, translating that collaboration into a genuinely avant garde Jordan 11 finished entirely in black. Comme des Garcons has built enormous credibility within high fashion for its boundary pushing, conceptually driven design approach, giving this collaboration genuine artistic weight beyond a standard retro colorway release. The Jordan 11's patent leather detailing and signature silhouette remain intact beneath this high fashion reinterpretation.

Comme des Garcons Homme Plus specifically represents the house's more experimental, avant garde menswear output, giving this Jordan 11 collaboration genuine artistic credibility distinct from typical streetwear crossovers. Black keeps the design moody and sophisticated, letting the collaborative detailing and premium construction carry the primary visual interest. Fans of both Jordan Brand's storied silhouette history and Comme des Garcons' boundary pushing design philosophy find this collaboration a genuinely significant crossover piece.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garcons Homme Plus Black was released on September 5, 2026 with a retail price of $358.
secondary_title: Comme des Garçons Homme Plus Black

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 GS delivers a seasonal take on one of the most iconic Jordan silhouettes, translating the signature design into a lighter and more wearable low top form. The white upper keeps the look clean and crisp, while university blue patent leather wraps the base with a bold and recognizable pop of color. Black accents add contrast, helping frame the design and maintain the balance that defines the Air Jordan 11.

This pair stands out because it captures the essence of the original model while adapting it for everyday wear. Fans of the Air Jordan 11 appreciate how colorways like this highlight the patent leather and sleek shape without overwhelming the design. It feels fresh and energetic, making it a strong option for those who want a classic silhouette with a vibrant twist that still feels grounded in Jordan history.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 GS was released on April 18, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Green Screen Monstars
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Green Screen Monstars draws inspiration from the filmmaking process behind Space Jam, bringing a vivid green treatment to the familiar silhouette. The concept references the green-screen environment used to bring Michael Jordan and animated characters together, giving the sneaker a behind-the-scenes connection to the film. Gym Green, Lucky Green, and Orange Peel establish an expressive palette within the multicolor design.

The green direction gives this edition a different identity from the traditional black Space Jam Jordan 11. Orange accents introduce another visual reference, connecting the design to Bugs Bunny’s familiar carrot imagery. For collectors who follow film-related Jordans, the appeal lies in exploring the production story through footwear. Neutral trousers or dark denim allow the bright colors to become the focal point, while a Space Jam-focused collection provides a natural setting for displaying the pair alongside other releases associated with the movie.

Scheduled to release on November 16, 2026, the Jordan 11 Retro Green Screen Monstars has a retail price of $255.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Cool Grey (2021)
description:
Since its debut in 2001, the Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey has become one of the most celebrated colorways in the Jordan 11 catalog.

The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) features a Cool Grey Durabuck upper with patent leather overlays and a signature Jumpman embroidery on the collar. From there, a white midsole and an icy blue translucent outsole complete the design.

The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) released in December of 2021 and retails for $225.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (2025) returns with subtle swagger and bold heritage. Dressed in deep royal blue, fire red, sail, black and muslin, the standout feature is the high-shine patent leather mudguard in the royal blue hue, a signal that this isn’t just another run of the AJ11. Classic white leather above gives it that clean contrast while fire red hits and a muslin-tinted translucent outsole add vintage flavor.

Lore plays a major role here: part of the "Rare Air" series that nods to sample-model aesthetics and collector culture, this drop adds "JORDAN" spelled across the eyestays and revisits some prototype styling cues. It feels like a sneaker built not just to wear, but to appreciate, ideal for someone who respects design story, Jordan history and statement kicks.

When the Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (2025) released, it carried a retail price of $235 and hit on November 5, 2025. With its mix of bold colors and nods to the AJ11 legacy, this release becomes a fit-friendly icon, a buy for both wearers and collectors alike.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low Space Jam
description:
Introducing the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Space Jam', an iconic silhouette that brings the nostalgia of 1996 straight to the streets. These sneakers are a modern twist on a classic, combining historical significance with contemporary style. The sneaker integrates the cherished Space Jam colorway, traditionally seen on higher-cut models, onto the Jordan 11 Low for the first time, making it a groundbreaking release for collectors and new fans alike.

This rendition of the Jordan 11 Low features a sleek black upper composed of high-quality patent leather and ballistic mesh, perfectly complementing the Varsity Royal accents that can be found on the iconic Jumpman logo & portions of the outsole. Contrasted with a crisp white midsole and a translucent outsole, the design maintains the aesthetic integrity of the original high-top version. This shoe celebrates Michael Jordan's larger-than-life influence both on and off the court.

Released on May 18, 2024, at a retail price of $190, the 'Space Jam' Jordan 11 Retro Low is a piece of basketball heritage. As it hits the shelves, it brings with it stories of victories, cultural moments, and a legacy of innovation. Whether stepping out on the court or walking the streets, these sneakers offer a timeless style combined with unmatched comfort. Don’t miss out on owning a piece of history with the Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Space Jam', a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts around the globe.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) (2025)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) (2025) revives a legendary color story in a sleek, kid-friendly silhouette. Dressed in Black/White-Varsity Red, this pair pairs a glossy patent leather mudguard with breathable ballistic-style mesh for that unmistakable Air Jordan 11 look, reimagined for everyday wear. A crisp white midsole sits above a bold Varsity Red rubber outsole for confident traction, while classic rope laces and a Jumpman hit deliver the heritage details fans love. Designed with comfort in mind, the cushioned setup and supportive shape make this GS edition an easy go-to for school, weekends, and game day alike. Style code FV5121-006 and a 2025-04-26 release date make this a standout pick for collectors shopping youth sizing.

Beyond its timeless appeal, the Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) offers reliable performance features that keep up with active kids. The low-cut profile promotes natural movement, and the durable outsole helps grip courts and sidewalks with ease. Subtle branding and the iconic patent shine elevate outfits from sport to street, giving this pair a versatile edge that works with jeans, shorts, and team gear. Whether you’re drawn to the storied Tinker Hatfield design language or the legendary "Bred" palette, this release captures everything that made the AJ11 a cultural icon, now tailored for younger sneaker fans who want style and substance in one package.

Our team loves this product because it blends the iconic Bred look with all-day comfort in GS sizing, making it a polished, versatile staple for growing sneaker rotations.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda
description:
From the school-spirited College Colors Program to the vibrant Nike CO.JP collection, Nike Dunks have seen many colorways since the design’s inception in 1985. But with each new colorway, the Dunk’s classic color-blocking has remained in some capacity. Nike put its timeless color-blocking to work with the Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black.

The upper Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black is constructed of white leather with black leather overlays and Swooshes. Classic Nike branding is featured on the nylon tongue, nodding to traditional Dunk design elements. A white midsole and black outsole complete the design.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black released in January of 2021 and retailed for $100.

To shop all Nike Dunks, click here.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White (Women's)
description:
Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens brings a grounded, lifestyle focused palette to one of Nike’s most versatile silhouettes, leaning into balance rather than flash. The mix of khaki, team red, and pearl white feels intentional and wearable, giving the Dunk Low a calm presence that still carries classic attitude. This colorway taps into the Dunk’s roots as an everyday shoe, built for rotation and personal style rather than hype driven moments.

What makes this pair resonate with collectors is how effortlessly it fits into modern wardrobes. The muted tones highlight the Dunk Low’s timeless paneling and proportions, letting the shape speak for itself. For fans who appreciate understated color stories, this release feels like a reminder of why the Dunk remains relevant decade after decade, adapting naturally to shifting tastes without losing its core identity.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens was released on 10/01/2025 with a retail price of $130

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (Women's)
description:
The Nike Dunk Low White Black 2021 women’s sneaker features a white and black leather upper with perforations on the toe box. The base of the upper starts with white leather, and black leather wraps around it in an even pattern. A black Nike Swoosh logo adorns either side of the upper and wraps around the ankle to complete the design.

The Nike Dunk Low White Black 2021 women’s sneaker released in March of 2021 and retailed for $100.

To shop all Nike Dunks, click here.
