title: Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum is a sleek and stylish addition to the iconic SB Dunk line. Featuring a classic color combination, this shoe boasts a black leather upper with contrasting white accents on the Swoosh, heel tab, and midsole. The gum rubber outsole adds a touch of warmth and provides excellent traction, making it perfect for skateboarding or casual wear.

Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the Nike Dunk Low Pro SB incorporates premium materials and advanced cushioning technology. The padded collar and tongue offer enhanced comfort and support, while the Zoom Air unit in the heel delivers responsive cushioning. The durable construction ensures long-lasting wear, whether you're hitting the skate park or navigating city streets. Us at StockX believe this product is great for skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike, offering a versatile and timeless design that can elevate any outfit.

title: Nike Dunk Low Cacao Wow (Women's)
description:
Nike did it again on July 28, 2023, when they dropped the Dunk Low in the enticing Cacao Wow colorway. This shoe is a surefire hit for those who crave unique kicks.

Crafted with buttery smooth leather, the upper sports a cool Cacao Wow finish, delivering a potent mix of style and comfort. This Dunk Low uses a light, creamy hue for contrast, adding just the right amount of pop.The Cacao Wow Dunk Low is set to turn heads and start conversations

This Nike Dunk in the Cacao Wow colorway was released on July 28, 2023, coming in at a retail price of $110.

title: Nike Dunk Low White Light Smoke Grey
description:
The Nike Dunk Low White Light Smoke Grey offers a fresh take on the classic silhouette, combining timeless design with contemporary colorways. This sleek sneaker features a pristine white leather base, complemented by light smoke grey overlays that add depth and dimension to the shoe. The iconic Nike Swoosh stands out in crisp white, creating a subtle yet striking contrast against the grey panels.

Crafted with premium materials, these Dunks boast a comfortable fit and durable construction, making them ideal for everyday wear. The low-top design provides flexibility and ease of movement, while the padded collar ensures enhanced comfort around the ankle. The rubber outsole features a classic traction pattern, offering reliable grip on various surfaces. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that effortlessly blends with both casual and semi-formal outfits, making it a must-have addition to any footwear collection.

title: Nike Dunk Low UNC (2021)
description:
Nodding to the University of North Carolina Tarheels, the Nike Dunk Low UNC is constructed of a white leather upper with University Blue overlays and Swooshes. From there, a white and University woven Nike tongue label completes the design.

The Nike Dunk Low UNC released in June of 2021 and retailed for $100.

title: Nike Dunk Low SE Wolf Grey
description:
The Nike Dunk Low SE Wolf Grey embraces restraint through a tonal execution that highlights form over contrast. Wolf grey covers the upper almost entirely, giving the shoe a calm and cohesive look that emphasizes the Dunk’s shape and paneling. The simplicity feels intentional, allowing texture and proportion to define the design rather than color variation.

This pair connects with fans who appreciate minimalism done right. The tonal approach makes it a natural choice for everyday wear, while still feeling considered and polished. Collectors value how special edition releases like this can feel elevated through restraint, reinforcing the idea that the Dunk Low does not need bold color to make an impact. It is a quiet and confident interpretation of a classic silhouette.

The Nike Dunk Low SE Wolf Grey was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (GS)
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (GS) silhouette comes in a stark black and white colorway and is made from premium leather materials throughout. Additionally, white Nike lettering complements the rear ankle support of the silhouette while the Nike Air text along with the customary company Swoosh logo adorns the tongue. In keeping with the color scheme, a white midsole resting atop a black outsole rounds out the look of this Dunk Low Retro shoe.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (GS) released in March of 2021 and retailed for $85.

title: Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom blends running inspired color cues into the familiar Dunk framework. Linen and Phantom tones set a soft and layered base, while Neutral Olive and Dark Hazel accents add subtle depth. The low cut shape remains true to the original, preserving the clean lines that made it iconic.

The Pegasus Pack concept brings performance heritage into lifestyle territory, and this Dunk interpretation feels cohesive rather than forced. The earthy palette keeps it understated and versatile, making it an easy everyday option. For collectors who enjoy thematic packs with wearable color blocking, this release offers a refined spin on a classic.

The Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom was released on January 9, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lower Merion Away
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lower Merion Away brings Kobe Bryant’s high school legacy into the Dunk silhouette, using a full team red colorway that reflects the intensity of Lower Merion’s away uniform. The Protro update keeps the classic Dunk structure intact while refining it for a more modern feel, allowing the color and story to take center stage. The tonal red approach gives the shoe a bold and unified presence.

What makes this pair stand out is its connection to Kobe’s early journey. Lower Merion represents the foundation of his career, and translating that into a Dunk creates a strong emotional link for fans. The design remains clean and focused, letting the colorway carry the tribute without distraction. It is a meaningful release that blends basketball history with a timeless silhouette.

The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lower Merion Away has a retail price of $135.

title: Nike Dunk Low St. Johns (2025)
description:
The Nike Dunk Low St. Johns (2025) revives an iconic hoops-to-street silhouette with a crisp White/University Red palette that never misses. Smooth leather panels, bold varsity blocking, and the classic Swoosh deliver instant recognition, while the perforated toe box and padded collar keep every step breathable and secure. Grounded by a grippy rubber outsole with heritage pivot circles, this Dunk blends retro basketball DNA with modern comfort for everyday wear. From denim and tees to tailored joggers, the clean two-tone design makes outfit building effortless and timeless.

Rooted in the legendary "Be True To Your School" lineage, this 2025 take stays true to the original spirit while refining the details. The low-cut profile offers easy, all-day versatility, and the sturdy cupsole construction adds durability for regular rotation. Subtle hits like the woven tongue label, stitched overlays, and crisp contrast stitching showcase Nike’s attention to craft. Whether you’re collecting classic colorways or refreshing your daily rotation, the Nike Dunk Low St. Johns (style code HF5441-104, release date 2025-01-06) is a standout pick that captures vintage attitude with modern appeal.

Our team loves this product because it pairs heritage style with dependable comfort and standout color blocking, perfect for everyday wear and seasonless rotation.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Light British Tan Cinnamon Corduroy
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Light British Tan Cinnamon Corduroy reimagines the classic Dunk Low silhouette through a premium corduroy build, combining light British tan, cargo khaki, baroque brown, and cinnamon for a genuinely warm, richly layered earth toned palette. Corduroy construction gives this pair a distinctly tactile, cozy quality rarely seen on the Dunk Low, setting it apart from the silhouette's usual leather or canvas executions. This multi tone brown combination creates genuine visual depth, letting the corduroy's ribbed texture interact with the layered color story throughout.

Premium material executions like this corduroy build appeal specifically to collectors who appreciate texture and craftsmanship as much as colorway design, giving the Dunk Low a genuinely different tactile identity. This rich, multi tone brown palette works especially well through cooler months when corduroy's cozy texture feels most fitting, offering deeper color complexity compared to more monochromatic corduroy releases. This release represents Nike's continued willingness to experiment with unconventional materials on one of its most iconic and adaptable silhouettes.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Light British Tan Cinnamon Corduroy was released on January 1, 2023 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy
description:
The Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy is a two-toned Dunk Low dressed in a classic colorway of Midnight Navy and Clean White.

The all-leather construction infuses the White Midnight Navy Nike Dunk Low with a premium feel while paying tribute to the Dunk Low’s basketball roots. Although the base comes in Crisp White, a section of Midnight Navy color-blocking provides contrast on the eyelets, the forefoot and heel overlays, the heel counter, the padded collar, and the flat tongue. In addition, the signature leather Swoosh logo, the rubber outsole, and the laces come in Midnight Navy. In terms of branding, ‘NIKE’ is embroidered on the heel counter, and the tongue’s woven tag showcases ‘NIKE’ and a Swoosh logo in white.

Our experts at StockX like that the stitching comes in a tonal hue, blending into the leather panels. The Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy was released on January 1, 2025, and sold for $115.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Filbert Light Chocolate
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Filbert Light Chocolate combines earthy colors with contrasting materials across the familiar skate silhouette. Filbert provides the lighter foundation, while Light Chocolate introduces richer brown panels. Black adds definition around the layered upper and sole, giving the sneaker a grounded appearance. Burgundy Ash completes the listed palette, adding another muted tone to the overall arrangement.

Beige nubuck contrasts with brown leather and black suede, creating differences in texture as well as color. Those material changes give the traditional Dunk panel layout added depth, with the darker sections framing the lighter base. The low-cut shape preserves the proportions associated with the SB Dunk, while the black sole provides a continuous foundation beneath the upper. The design’s character comes primarily from its color blocking and mix of surfaces.

This edition offers a restrained interpretation of the SB Dunk Low, with the neutral shades making its textures especially noticeable. The combination of nubuck, leather, and suede gives collectors several finishes to appreciate. Released on October 1, 2026, the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Filbert Light Chocolate retailed for $120.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha brings a fresh, nature-inspired take to a classic skateboarding silhouette. Inspired by the shades of green found in matcha, this sneaker blends earthy tones across its premium suede and leather upper. Deep legion green and burnt sienna accents add contrast, while the light khaki base keeps the design grounded and wearable.

Designed with skaters in mind, the sneaker features a padded collar for extra ankle support, a durable rubber outsole for superior grip, and responsive cushioning for impact protection. Yuto Horigome’s signature details are subtly placed throughout, honoring his influence in the skateboarding world.

Releasing on April 5, 2025, the Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha retailed for $135. Whether you’re hitting the skatepark or just looking for a unique colorway, this Dunk Low offers style and performance in equal measure.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Nardwuar
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Nardwuar feels like one of those rare collaborations that makes perfect sense the moment you see it, blending skate culture, music history, and personality into a single expressive sneaker. Nardwuar’s unmistakable aesthetic brings playful chaos to the Dunk Low, turning the shoe into a visual mixtape of references that feel personal rather than forced. It captures the spirit of crate digging, underground interviews, and cultural curiosity that Nardwuar represents so well.

What makes this pair special to collectors is how authentic it feels. The SB Dunk Low silhouette already carries deep roots in skate and counterculture, and this collaboration builds on that legacy instead of overwriting it. Every design choice feels intentional, rewarding fans who appreciate storytelling through detail. It stands as a reminder that the best collaborations celebrate individuality and shared history rather than hype alone.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Nardwuar was released on 12/09/2025 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low The Wizard of Oz Poppy Field
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low The Wizard of Oz Poppy Field is a stunning homage to the timeless 1939 classic The Wizard of Oz. Inspired by the iconic poppy field scene where Dorothy and her friends fall under its magical spell, this sneaker transforms vivid storytelling into wearable art. Its unique design features a special print showcasing a floral tapestry of orange, red, yellow, green, and black, bringing the vibrant poppy field to life.

True to Nike SB’s legacy, the Poppy Field Dunk Low blends nostalgic details with contemporary craftsmanship. The heel features Dorothy’s legendary line, "There’s no place like home," embroidered in bold lettering. A second hidden layer of red leather peeks through the upper for added depth, while custom insoles include an image of the Wicked Witch of the West, making these sneakers a collector’s dream. Satin finishes, a lush red outsole, and the iconic "Wizard of Oz" text on the tongue complete the story-driven design.

Set to release on December 23, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low The Wizard of Oz Poppy Field will retail for $135. Whether you’re a sneaker enthusiast or a fan of the beloved film, this pair masterfully merges cinematic nostalgia with modern skate culture, offering a wearable tribute to Dorothy’s unforgettable journey.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum draws inspiration from Thai street food culture, translating the vibrant and layered nature of som tum into a detailed and expressive sneaker. The mix of canvas, Vachetta Tan, and Parachute Beige creates a textured base, while Bright Crimson and Legend Dark Brown accents add contrast that feels both earthy and energetic. Subtle metallic silver hits bring a slight edge, tying the design together without overpowering the concept.

Fans of SB Dunk releases appreciate how storytelling drives each colorway, and this pair stands out through its cultural reference and material mix. It feels thoughtful and intentional, offering more depth than a standard release. For collectors, it represents the continued creativity within Nike SB, where inspiration can come from unexpected places and still translate into strong design.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum was released on April 11, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low White Black
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black is a leather upper low-top sneaker featuring an optic White and Black color palette. The upper’s overlays and underlays are both White, connecting to a white midsole. The Nike Swoosh in Black accents the sides and coordinates with the tongue label logo, heel tab, and outsole, all done in Black.

While American sneaker brand Nike originally developed the Dunk Low as part of a university sports team outfitting initiative, it gained a new audience of skateboarders in the 1990s for its grippy sole and comfortable performance. Nike’s skateboarding division, Nike SB, began releasing a skateboarding-engineered Dunk in the early 2000s, and the White Black’s aesthetic harks to its origins as a style designed to feature team colors.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the SB Dunk Low is its perfectly balanced, high-contrast colorway. The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black was released on March 1, 2025, and retailed for $115.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec (style IH3211-200) blends skate-ready function with head-turning style, delivering a color story that stands out on and off the board. The Khaki, Amber Brown, Rough Green, Rust Pink, Black, and Sail palette is thoughtfully balanced across smooth panels and textured overlays, creating depth and contrast from every angle. A plush, padded tongue and supportive collar enhance lockdown and comfort, while the low-profile cupsole design promotes stable footing for technical sessions and everyday wear. Underfoot, a grippy rubber outsole with a classic pivot pattern offers confident traction, making these Dunk Lows as practical as they are striking.

Details matter on the Arts-Rec edition, from the crisp stitching that frames each panel to the clean Swoosh lines that anchor the sidewalls. Four lace options, White, Green, Orange, and Pink, let you personalize the look in seconds, whether you want to lean into earthy tones or highlight the Rust Pink accents. The balanced cushioning provides responsive impact protection without sacrificing board feel, and the streamlined silhouette pairs effortlessly with denim, cargos, or skate shorts. Whether you’re collecting the latest Nike SB releases or rotating a daily skate shoe, this Dunk Low delivers standout style with versatile performance.

Our team loves this product because it offers customizable style, dependable traction, and day-long comfort in a distinctive colorway that elevates any sneaker lineup.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards brings a layered and color rich approach to the SB Dunk line, combining black, marina, and court blue tones with hits of campfire orange and orange horizon that give the shoe a strong visual rhythm. The mix of colors feels intentional rather than chaotic, highlighting the paneling that defines the Dunk while adding energy tied to the Bluetile Skateboards collaboration. It keeps the classic low profile shape intact while letting the palette carry the story.

This pair stands out because it reflects skate culture through color and detail rather than heavy branding. SB Dunks thrive on collaborations that feel connected to real scenes, and this release captures that through its bold but balanced execution. It is a strong option for collectors who appreciate both storytelling and standout design.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards was released on May 12, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Green Noise Watermelon
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Green Noise Watermelon channels a genuinely vivid, fruit inspired palette that calls back to the San Antonio Spurs' beloved Fiesta throwback uniforms and the multicolor jerseys worn during the 1996 NBA All Star Game. A super soft suede upper built for long skate sessions carries Green Noise hues across the mudguard, eyestay, heel overlay, and sockliner, while Light Curry tones cover the toebox, tongue, midfoot panel, and collar for genuine tonal contrast throughout. Pops of Watermelon pink hit the leather Swoosh, cotton lace set, and both the Nike and Nike SB branding at the heel tab and tongue.

Inside, the Watermelon theme continues onto the insole, where SB and Air Zoom logos appear rendered in Light Curry rather than a standard single tone. A black rubber midsole finished with green accent stitching grounds the vibrant upper, while a Light Curry rubber outsole keeps the design cohesive from top to bottom. Extra laces included with the release give skaters and collectors added ways to customize the look. For fans of Nike SB's ongoing tradition of bold, nostalgically inspired Dunk Low colorways, this Green Noise Watermelon edition stands as one of the more energetic seasonal releases on the calendar.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Green Noise Watermelon carries a retail price of $120.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster comes toned in a mixture of three main colors: electro orange, orange frost, and white.

This Low Nike SB Dunk features a nubuck upper with varying orange tones, softly speckled overlays, and a tonal Swoosh accented in white. The interior lining is embellished with a bib-inspired pattern, and the white mesh tongue is embellished with a woven Nike SB tag. The shoe boasts an orange rubber outsole and a cupsole with black sidewalls.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster was set to retail at $120 at its market launch on December 20th, 2022.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop is a striking collaboration that pays homage to the vibrant skateboarding culture. This men's sneaker features a rich mahogany base, complemented by dark beetroot, team red, sail, and night maroon accents, creating a visually captivating design. The premium materials and expert craftsmanship ensure both style and durability, making it an ideal choice for skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike.

Designed with skateboarding in mind, these shoes offer superior comfort and performance. The low-top silhouette provides flexibility and freedom of movement, while the padded collar and tongue offer enhanced support. The shoe comes with both red and black laces, allowing for customization to suit individual preferences. With its unique colorway and attention to detail, the Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop is set to become a coveted addition to any sneaker collection.

Us at StockX believe this product is great for both skateboarding enthusiasts and fashion-forward individuals looking for a versatile, eye-catching sneaker that stands out from the crowd.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Jordan Copperhead
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Air Jordan Copperhead brings a layered and expressive take to the Dunk, reflecting Dashawn Jordan’s creative influence through a mix of tones and textures. String and black create a grounded base, while bright spruce, fierce purple, and dark russet accents add unexpected bursts of color that shift across the upper. The result feels dynamic and slightly unconventional.

This pair stands out because it blends skateboarding identity with broader design references. The Copperhead theme gives it a distinct personality, while the mix of colors keeps it visually engaging from every angle. Fans of SB releases appreciate how it pushes beyond simple color blocking into something more narrative driven.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Air Jordan Copperhead was released on March 17, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup
description:
Embrace the bold and daring with the Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup. This edition captures Buttercup's fearless and tough personality, reflected in the Mean Green/Black/Lotus Pink colorway. The design elements of the sneaker are as dynamic and powerful as Buttercup herself, making a strong statement.

The sneaker's striking color palette is complemented by its high-quality construction and attention to detail, embodying the spirit of the fierce Powerpuff Girl. This Dunk Low is not just a shoe; it's an expression of Buttercup's unyielding energy and charisma.

Released on December 14 at skate shops and on SNKRS, and priced at $135, the Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup is a perfect mix of style and attitude. Sneaker enthusiasts and fans of the show will not want to miss this unique and spirited sneaker.​

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet brings rich color to the skate driven silhouette, pairing a deep violet palette with the Dunk Low’s timeless shape. The result feels grounded and expressive, capturing a mood that feels both regal and rooted in counterculture attitude. It is a straightforward yet striking colorway that highlights how color alone can transform a familiar silhouette.

This release resonates with collectors because the SB Dunk Low continues to be a core canvas for mood and personality. Persian violet doesn’t need graphics or flash to stand out; it carries presence through hue and simplicity, appealing to fans who appreciate subtle impact and everyday wearability. It fits naturally into skate and lifestyle rotations alike.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet was released on 10/07/2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua
description:
Step into a world of art and innovation with the Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua. This sneaker is a masterpiece, blending iconic street art with top-tier skateboarding functionality. The canvas upper features a vibrant mix of Bleached Aqua, Geode Teal, and White, adorned with the dynamic strokes and splashes reminiscent of Futura's signature street art. The design reflects a seamless fusion of creativity and urban edge, with Futura's distinctive signature and the "FL" emblem proudly displayed on the heel

Designed for both visual appeal and performance, this collaboration with Futura Laboratories enhances the SB Dunk Low with a lightweight, durable canvas that supports both casual wear and skateboarding demands. The responsive cushioning and stable, low-profile outsole ensure comfort and functionality without compromising the sneaker's artistic flair. It's a tribute to both Futura’s revolutionary artistry and Nike’s commitment to quality.

Released on May 18, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua retailed for $135. This release captivated both art aficionados and sneakerheads alike, offering a unique piece of wearable art that stands out in any collection. Each step in these sneakers is a step in a modern art gallery, showcasing the enduring legacy of Futura and the innovative spirit of Nike SB.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 QS Uno
description:
The Air Force 1 Low 07 QS Uno is a low-cut shoe released to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the UNO card game. This particular shoe is a product of the collaboration between Mattel and Nike.

The Air Force 1 Low 07 QS Uno is dressed in a black, blue, green, yellow, red, and white color scheme, with each of the mentioned colors coloring a leather panel on the shoe’s upper. It features a UNO logo on its heel, a UNO 50th anniversary logo on its blue insole, a padded collar, and a full-length rubber outsole.

The Air Force 1 Low 07 QS Uno was released on 1st February 2022. Originally, its retail price was $120.

Nike Air Max 1 atmos Elephant (2007)
description: One of the most sought after sneakers of all time is the atmos x Nike Air Max 1 "Elephant" print design from 2007. The design came from the creative minds at Japanese based retailer atmos and has survived the test of time thanks to a tasteful combination of popular elements and of course, a limited production number. Though an official number of pairs was never given, the release of the Elephant Print Air Max 1 by atmos has become more valuable over the years because its design is considered much more "wearable" than other Air Max designs of the era, giving it a broader appeal. The Elephant Print around the mud guard had rarely been seen on the Air Max 1 prior to atmos’ design in 2007 but it is the shape of the mud guard, wider and more true to original than many retro AM1 colorways, that really helps this colorway remain at the top of wish lists. The leather toebox might not typically be a popular option for the AM1 but the atmos x Nike Air Max 1 "Elephant" colorway has proven that it can be well received.

title: Nike Air Max 1 CMYK Pack Silver
Nike Air Max 1 BHM (2012)
Nike Air Max 1 Cave Purple
Nike Air Max 1 Monotones Vol 1
Nike Air Max 1 Bred
description: Paying homage to an incredible colorway and an important holiday, the Nike Air Max 1 "Bred" dropped for Valentine’s Day in 2015. Traditionally, Air Max 1 colorways stand on their own but that’s not to say that the black and red colorway of this version doesn’t. This Bred AM1, however, gets a colorway and material options that most sneakerheads will find familiar from another type of sneaker, the Air Jordan 1. From a distance, the black and red, or "bred" for short, color combo looks rather simple but a closer look at the leather upper reveals a very unique detail, not found on any other Air Max 1. The Bred Air Max 1 features the Nike Air logo embossed in the heel, and not on the rear of the shoe as is customary. Instead, Nike Sportswear opted to place it on the lateral heel side of this AM1. Because this Air Max 1 released around Valentine’s Day, it was also give the same nickname. However you want to say it, the Valentine’s Day Nike Air Max 1 "Bred" is a combination of two of the most important sneakers in history and demand for it was high from the day it released.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Recraft New Maroon
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Recraft New Maroon shoe has a color palette of White, New Maroon, Phantom, and Black. 

This shoe is made of a variety of materials, with suede and rubber accenting the panels and predominantly mesh and leather on the upper. A three-tone rubber midsole and outsole support the shoe. Maroon highlights the Nike branding on the tongue, while its heel features a white Nike Air Max printed on it. Additional branding includes white Swooshes on the lateral and medial sides, and Air Max text in black on its tongue. The sneaker also features a translucent cream Air bubble on its midsole, while its upper eyestay is covered in black. Rounding off the sneakers' appearance is the maroon inner lining of the padded tongue, the maroon lower eyelets, and the toe tips.

The  Nike Air Max 90 Recraft New Maroon released on 6th May 2020, retailed at the price of $140.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Livestrong
Nike Air Max 90 Powerwall Lemonade
Nike Air Max 90 UK Camo
Nike Air Max 90 Home Turf Milan
description: In February of 2013 Nike introduced the Nike Air Max Hometurf Milan Pack to help pay homage to its long-loved Air Max range, as well as the fashion influences that many of the leading cities in the world had on them. Included as part of other city-inspired Hometurf packs, the Milan Air Max Pack incorporated 4 different Air Max models which included the Air Max 90 Milan. The Milan Air Max 90 was composed of a deep grey suede upper and midsole, both which were accented by an orange sock liner and outsole. The Milan Air Max Ninety was also accompanied by unique Milan and Air Max branding on the tongue and a lower Hometurf lace stay. The Milan AM90 featured above-the-norm materials and a unique color palette that had rarely been seen used before. Retailing at a price of $120, the AM90 Milan was originally available only at the Nike Sportswear Accounts represented by the different Hometurf packs. However, later in 2013, additional top-tier NSW retailers received the Home Turf packs. The Nike Air Max 90 Hometurf Milan used its wearable, but highlighted, colorway to appeal to sneaker enthusiasts and cement itself as a standout in the Home Turf pack.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Black Croc Infrared
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Black Croc Infrared takes a classic runner and gives it a sharp textural twist. Built in Black with subtle croc detailing across the upper, the design is elevated by unmistakable Infrared accents and clean White hits that frame the midsole. The Air Max 90 shape remains timeless, with its layered panels and visible Air window anchoring it firmly in early nineties heritage.

What makes this pair memorable is the balance between stealth and flash. The all black base keeps it versatile, but the Infrared detailing brings that iconic spark that longtime Air Max fans instantly recognize. The croc texture adds depth without straying too far from the DNA, making it a standout for collectors who appreciate classic silhouettes with a slight edge.

The Nike Air Max 90 Black Croc Infrared was released on May 21, 2015 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike Air Max 90 atmos Duck Camo
Nike Air Max 90 VT Tokyo (Women's)
Nike Air Max 90 Infrared Velvet (Women's)

Nike Air Max 90 Triple White
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Triple White is a special colorway of the iconic Air Max 90 which debuted back in 1990. This classic shoe features an all-white color scheme from the upper to the midsole and outsole, creating a minimalist look.

The upper of the Air Max 90 Triple White is constructed with a combination of leather, mesh, and synthetic overlays, with its design showcasing distinct paneling, including the iconic Swoosh logo on the sides and a visible Air Max unit in the heel. It also has a padded collar and cushioned midsole. Other than the Swoosh, other branding details on this shoe include the Nike Air logo on the heel tab, a classic Nike logo on the tongue and Air Max branding on the lateral ankle.

The Air Max 90 Triple White was first released for retail at the price of $120 on 17th May 2019.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple Black
description:
The Nike Vomero 5 Triple Black is part of Nike’s Vomero 5 lineup, which includes sneakers with a technical silhouette and a variety of function-first details.

The "Triple Black" comes with an all-black, mesh base and leather overlays. Like other editions of the Vomero 5, the sneaker features motifs of Bill Bowerman, a famous University of Oregon coach, on the insole. 3M reflective detailing along the overlays provides extra visibility during low lighting, while Zoom Air cushioning adds comfort and support. The sneaker’s all-black colorway makes it stand out from other versions of the Vomero 5 and gives the shoe a sleek appearance.

Something our experts love is the plastic heel counter. It features a grid-like design and complements the plastic paneling on the side of the sneaker. The Nike Vomero 5 Triple Black was released on July 20, 2023, and retailed at $160.

title: Nike Vomero Premium SP Skeleton Black
Nike Vomero Premium Black Bright Crimson
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Black Bright Crimson elevates the Vomero's plush, max cushioned running platform through premium materials and construction, finished in a bold black and bright crimson colorway. Black dominates the base, while bright crimson accents cut through with striking contrast, giving the shoe genuine visual presence alongside its comfort focused design. The Vomero line has built its reputation on delivering some of the softest, most cushioned rides within Nike's running catalog, and this Premium version reflects an elevated take on that already comfort driven formula.

The Vomero has earned a devoted following among runners and lifestyle wearers alike who prioritize plush cushioning without sacrificing a considered aesthetic. Premium executions like this one appeal to collectors who want the added craftsmanship and material quality beyond standard retail versions, giving the shoe a more elevated presence both on foot and in a broader sneaker rotation. Black and bright crimson together create a striking, versatile palette that keeps the shoe bold without straying into overly loud territory.

The Nike Vomero Premium Black Bright Crimson was released on July 1, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Off-White Grey Fog Dark Obsidian
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Off White Grey Fog Dark Obsidian elevates the Vomero's plush, max cushioned running platform through premium materials and construction, finished in a muted, sophisticated palette of off white, grey fog, wolf grey, and dark obsidian. The Vomero line has built its reputation on delivering some of the softest, most cushioned rides within Nike's running catalog, and this Premium version reflects an elevated take on that already comfort driven formula. The neutral, layered color story keeps the design versatile while showcasing the shoe's premium material upgrades.

The Vomero has earned a devoted following among runners and lifestyle wearers alike who prioritize plush cushioning without sacrificing a considered aesthetic. Premium executions like this one appeal to collectors who want the added craftsmanship and material quality beyond standard retail versions, giving the shoe a more elevated presence both on foot and in a broader sneaker rotation. This muted, neutral toned palette offers a sophisticated alternative to bolder Vomero Premium releases, appealing to fans who prefer understated luxury within their performance footwear.

The Nike Vomero Premium Off White Grey Fog Dark Obsidian has a retail price of $230.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon takes a softer and more elevated approach, using a pale ivory sanddrift jade horizon black spruce palette that feels calm and layered. The premium construction enhances the overall look, giving the shoe a more refined presence while maintaining the cushioning and support that define the Vomero line.

Collectors gravitate toward premium iterations like this because they offer a balance between performance and lifestyle appeal. The color palette feels natural and easy to style, while the materials add depth that becomes more noticeable up close. It works across different settings, delivering both comfort and a polished aesthetic.

The Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Volt Tint Lime Blast Sapphire
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, Sapphire, and Black Spruce is the most chromatically energetic and visually bold colorway in the Vomero Plus April 2026 release window, pairing the near-neon brightness of volt tint and lime blast with the deep and saturated richness of sapphire to create a color combination that makes the platform's substantial cushioning architecture feel as visually dynamic and high-energy as its physical stack height suggests it should be. Volt tint leads the palette with the slightly softened neon quality that distinguishes it from full-intensity volt while maintaining the attention-commanding brightness that makes the shoe immediately distinctive in any environment, while lime blast adds a complementary yellow-green energy that keeps the palette vivid across multiple color registers simultaneously. Sapphire provides the cool and deep contrast that prevents the volt and lime combination from reading as flat or two-dimensional, the rich blue creating a visual weight and tonal counterpoint that completes the color story with genuine sophistication.

Vomero Plus releases in multi-color bold palette directions appeal to the running lifestyle collector who wants their daily wear footwear to carry maximum visual energy and color confidence, understanding that the platform's premium cushioning and construction quality provides the functional foundation that allows even the most chromatically ambitious colorways to succeed as serious daily wear acquisitions rather than display-only collector pieces. Volt tint and sapphire is a particularly successful color pairing for a cushioned running lifestyle silhouette because the two tones occupy completely opposite ends of the color temperature spectrum, the warm neon and cool deep blue creating the kind of high-contrast chromatic tension that makes a shoe visually memorable from any distance and in any lighting condition. At one hundred and eighty dollars the Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, and Sapphire delivers the platform's premium daily wear credentials in its most visually bold and chromatically committed seasonal expression.

The Nike Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, and Sapphire was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print (Women's)
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print (Women’s) gives Nike’s cushioned road-running shoe an animal-print finish. Black cow markings cover much of the upper and tongue, while Sail Swooshes add texture. A Light Orewood Brown midsole softens the palette, and University Red details beneath the shoe provide a final contrast. The print makes this edition easy to recognize even among the Vomero Plus’s more colorful releases.

Under the pattern, the shoe retains the features that make the Vomero Plus suited to everyday runs. A tall, full-length ZoomX foam midsole delivers a soft feel with responsive rebound, while the breathable upper helps keep the foot comfortable. Durable rubber underfoot provides traction on the road. The combination lets the unusual design sit on a functional running shoe, giving wearers the option to take it on a run or make its cow-print pattern the focus of a casual outfit.

Released on August 6, 2026, the Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print (Women’s) retailed for $190. With its all-over print, textured Swooshes, and plush ZoomX cushioning, this pair puts a distinctive look on a daily running silhouette.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Black
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Black delivers max comfort in a stealth driven execution built for everyday mileage. Dressed in Black with Anthracite and Cool Grey accents, the layered upper keeps the silhouette sleek while highlighting the cushioned midsole beneath. The sculpted platform reinforces the Vomero line’s reputation for plush responsiveness and smooth transitions.

All black runners remain staples in any rotation, and the Vomero Plus enhances that versatility with elevated cushioning and a modern stance. Subtle grey detailing adds depth without disrupting the monochrome feel. It stands as a refined and dependable option for those who prioritize comfort with a clean athletic edge.

The Nike Vomero Plus Black was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson (Women's)
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson Womens brings bold energy to a silhouette built around comfort and endurance. The Vomero Plus design prioritizes cushioning and smooth transitions, and the hyper pink and bright crimson palette amplifies that experience visually. It feels fast, expressive, and modern, turning a performance rooted runner into something that confidently crosses into lifestyle wear.

Fans love this release because it blends softness and intensity so well. The cushioning focused build makes it ideal for long wear, while the vivid colorway gives it standout personality. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to push running silhouettes into expressive territory, offering shoes that feel just as relevant on the street as they do in motion. It is a confident and energetic take on comfort driven design.

The Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson Womens was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: Nike Vomero Plus SP Cheat Day
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Anthracite White Wolf Grey pairs a neutral colorway with a running silhouette built around maximum cushioning. Anthracite, Summit White, Pure Platinum, and Wolf Grey give the shoe a layered appearance, while the sculpted midsole creates its distinctive profile. An engineered mesh upper uses soft, breathable yarns to provide comfort during everyday road runs.

A tall stack of full-length ZoomX foam forms the foundation of the Vomero Plus, delivering lightweight cushioning and a responsive feel underfoot. The generous midsole gives the design its substantial proportions, while a high-abrasion rubber outsole provides durable traction. Above the cushioning platform, the mesh construction allows airflow and adds texture to the understated palette. The combination places cushioning and breathable comfort at the center of the shoe’s design.

The contrasting neutral shades highlight the transition from the mesh upper to the pronounced foam platform. Released on January 1, 2026, the Nike Vomero Plus Anthracite White Wolf Grey retailed for $180.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print brings a playful, animal print concept into this elevated Vomero Plus platform, combining sail, university red, and light orewood brown into a genuinely distinctive, spotted pattern presentation. Cow print has grown increasingly popular within contemporary sneaker design, offering a fun, textural alternative to standard solid color or gradient releases. The Plus designation continues to reflect enhanced technical or material upgrades compared to standard Vomero models, giving this cow print execution genuine premium substance beyond just visual novelty.

The Vomero has earned a devoted following among runners and lifestyle wearers alike who prioritize plush cushioning without sacrificing a considered aesthetic, and this cow print treatment gives the silhouette a genuinely playful, distinctive personality. University red accents add unexpected pops of color against the spotted base pattern, giving this pair standout visual complexity. Fans of both the Vomero's renowned cushioning and fun, pattern driven colorways find this Cow Print release a compelling, genuinely eye catching addition to their rotation.

The Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print was released on August 20, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Volt Tint Sapphire
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Volt Tint Sapphire pushes the line into a more vibrant direction, combining volt tint and sapphire tones that create a bold and energetic look. The bright palette contrasts with black spruce accents, adding depth and structure across the upper. The silhouette remains focused on cushioning and support, giving the design a strong foundation beneath its more expressive colorway.

Collectors and runners gravitate toward versions like this because they bring personality into a performance model without compromising function. The mix of bright and dark tones makes it stand out while still feeling cohesive. It is a sneaker that captures the evolution of the Vomero line, offering a high energy option for those who want both comfort and visual impact.

The Nike Vomero Premium Volt Tint Sapphire was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse delivers the same comfort focused foundation in a colorway that feels fiery and dynamic. Orange pulse and hot lava tones dominate the upper, creating a sense of motion and heat that matches the Vomero Plus name. The layered construction and smooth lines keep the silhouette balanced, ensuring the bold colors feel intentional rather than chaotic.

Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels alive. The Vomero Plus is built for long wear and support, and this colorway gives it personality that stands out in rotation. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses color to transform performance models into expressive lifestyle pieces, making this a sneaker that feels energetic, wearable, and aligned with modern design trends without sacrificing comfort.

The Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange introduces a brighter contrast within the premium Vomero lineup, using a white lapis total orange palette that feels fresh and dynamic. The clean white base allows the lapis and orange accents to stand out, creating a design that feels both energetic and balanced.

Fans appreciate how this version combines the comfort of the Vomero platform with a more expressive color story. The premium materials elevate the look, while the color placement keeps it visually engaging. It stands as a versatile option that still carries enough personality to separate it from more neutral releases.

The Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange was released with a retail price of $150.
