adidas Samba OG Molly-Mae Matcha (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Molly Mae Matcha Womens offers a softer and more refined take on the classic Samba, blending influencer driven styling with a silhouette that has long defined casual footwear. The magic lime upper introduces a muted green tone that feels fresh and understated, paired with off white accents that keep the look balanced and easy to wear. The gum sole remains a constant, grounding the design in its original indoor football roots.

What makes this version stand out is its ability to feel elevated without losing the everyday versatility that defines the Samba. Fans of Molly Mae’s aesthetic appreciate the clean and minimal approach, while sneaker enthusiasts recognize the strength of the silhouette itself. It fits naturally into a wide range of outfits, offering a subtle color shift that adds personality without overwhelming the rest of the look.

The adidas Samba OG Molly Mae Matcha Womens was released on April 9, 2026 with a retail price of $132.

title: adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black
description:
The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (Women's) represents a contemporary take on a timeless style, emanating an aesthetic charm that goes beyond its original athletic purpose.​
​​
​Crafted from full-grain leather, the upper of the Cloud White Core Black adidas Samba OG (Women's) offers a sturdy and resilient construction. A gray suede, paired with a contrasting black heel tab, introduces an element of sophistication to the overall design. The iconic serrated 3-Stripes appear in black on both the lateral and medial sides, creating a visually striking contrast. Enhancing the shoe's unique identity, a Bluebird tongue label and a foil logotype mark its distinctive DNA. Underneath, a brown gum rubber outsole ensures both traction and durability, underscoring the shoe's practicality and style.​
​​
​The standout characteristic of the adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (Women's) lies in its signature T-toe design. This element pays homage to football pitches of the past, while embracing a forward-looking approach with its entirely vegan composition. The shoe debuted for $100 on December 1st, 2023.

title: adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's)
description:
Take on a unique look with the adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's). The sneaker gives you a second-life design with a striking pattern. Expect a distinct, worn-in appearance with contrasting colors and a cool design.

The Preloved Red Leopard Samba OG by adidas combines a leather upper with a variation of orange accents. Reddish orange leopard print overlays take up most of the space, with white 3 Stripes, laces, and a heel to add contrast and make the print stand out more. The shoe retains the classic Samba design, including the reinforced T-toe. The outsole uses gum rubber for grip. The design's history originates from indoor football shoes of the mid-20th century.

As the StockX experts, something we love about the adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's) is the natural variation in the texture; each pair has a unique appearance. The slightly worn gum sole adds to the vintage appearance. The shoe retailed at $110 when it was released on the 29th of January, 2025.

title: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver (Women's)
description:
adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver Womens reimagines a global classic through a fashion forward lens, adding sparkle and attitude to one of adidas’s most enduring silhouettes. The black base keeps the look grounded and timeless, while rhinestone detailing introduces contrast that feels expressive and bold without overwhelming the shoe’s heritage. It transforms the Samba from a purely utilitarian icon into something playful and elevated.

What makes this release resonate is how confidently it blends sport history with modern style. The Samba OG shape remains untouched, preserving its cultural credibility, while the rhinestones add personality that feels designed for self expression. Collectors appreciate this version because it shows how subtle embellishment can refresh a classic without stripping away what made it iconic in the first place.

The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver Womens was released on 12/04/2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: adidas Samba OG Molly-Mae Slate (Women's)
adidas Samba OG Mule Black Dark Brown (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Mule Black Dark Brown (Women's) brings an open-back construction to the recognizable Samba profile. Its Core Black/Core Black/Dark Brown palette keeps the look restrained, combining a dark upper with a warmer secondary shade. The mule format changes the shoe’s presentation around the heel, giving fans a distinctive alternative within a lineup associated with low-profile lace-up footwear.

The design offers a straightforward way to explore the Samba through a different silhouette while keeping the color scheme adaptable. Black works naturally with denim, tailored casual trousers, or skirts, and dark brown complements earth-toned accessories. Cropped hems can highlight the open back, while longer trousers create a more relaxed presentation. For collectors interested in variations on established adidas models, the appeal lies in that change of format. The neutral colors allow the shape to stand out without requiring a bright treatment, making the pair easy to build into everyday outfits.

Released on October 1, 2026, the adidas Samba OG Mule Black Dark Brown (Women's) retailed for $130.

title: adidas Samba OG Mule Preloved Brown White (Women's)
adidas Samba OG Black White Gum
description:
The adidas Samba Black-White Gum shoe, style B75807, is a product made from kangaroo leather with an innovative lightweight upper and gum rubber sole for grip. It features adidas stripes on its sides.

Of course, as their name suggests, the shoes are black and cloud-white and come with white or black shoelaces made of polyester and plastic. adidas Samba Black-White Gum’s tongue is branded with the adidas logo. Samba branding is just beneath the collar, close to the stripes on the sides of the sneakers.

The adidas Samba OG Black White Gum was originally released on January 6, 2018 at a retail price of $80, and now sits at a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Maroon Warm Vanilla (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Maroon Warm Vanilla (Women's) adds a sparkling treatment to the familiar low-profile Samba silhouette. Its Maroon/Warm Vanilla/Gum 5 palette combines a deep red tone with creamy contrast and a warm sole color. Rhinestone detailing gives this edition its defining visual feature, bringing a decorative finish to a model associated with understated everyday styling.

The combination of rich color and reflective accents makes the pair an expressive option within a Samba rotation. Maroon works naturally with blue denim, black trousers, and cream-colored clothing, while Warm Vanilla provides another shade to coordinate through accessories. Keep the rest of an outfit simple to emphasize the rhinestones, or incorporate the pair into a look built around decorative details. For collectors exploring variations on the Samba OG, the appeal comes from seeing its recognizable shape presented through a finish that catches the light and changes its overall character.

Released on October 1, 2026, the adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Maroon Warm Vanilla (Women's) retailed for $130.

title: adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's) takes the classic Samba silhouette design and applies a rich colorway of maroon with Metallic Gold details.

The upper construction boasts smooth leather in maroon, while the toecap is made of soft suede in tonal maroon. The difference in textures creates subtle contrast and a luxury feel. The signature serrated 3-Stripes logo on the side panels is made of white leather. ‘SAMBA’ in Metallic Gold lettering runs along the 3-Stripes logo on the lateral side panel and complements the gold adidas logo printed on the tongue tag. Both the tongue and heel collar come in Cream White, which adds to the sneaker’s vintage appeal.

Our experts at StockX like the use of gum rubber on the durable outsole. The women’s size adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's) was released on February 9th, 2024, and retailed at $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Bambi Brown Desert (Women's)
description:
The Adidas Samba OG Bambi in Brown Desert Warm Vanilla Wonder Mauve is a women's Samba OG colorway with style code KJ7447 that applies a warm, earth-toned and dusty mauve palette to the iconic indoor soccer shoe silhouette first introduced in 1949, combining a brown desert leather upper with warm vanilla and wonder mauve accents in a color story that references the gentle, sun-warmed tones associated with the Bambi name and Disney's 1942 animated deer character and the organic earth palette of a forest in warm, golden light. The Bambi name is applied to the colorway as a character coding that connects the warm brown, cream, and soft mauve color family to the visual world of the Disney fawn, a specific art direction approach that adidas has used across its broader Samba catalog to give colorways emotional and cultural reference points that communicate their identity beyond purely descriptive color names. The construction follows the standard Samba OG specification that has made the silhouette one of the most sustained and culturally significant footwear releases in adidas's catalog across its contemporary revival: full-grain leather upper, contrasting suede T-toe overlay, serrated Three-Stripes on the lateral side, reinforced toe detail, synthetic leather lining, cushioned insole, and a gum rubber cupsole that provides the low-profile outsole traction and visual grounding characteristic of the original indoor soccer heritage construction.

The Samba OG's ongoing dominance in the adidas lineup since its mainstream cultural resurgence beginning in 2022 and 2023 has produced a catalog of hundreds of colorways across men's and women's releases, with women's-specific colorways like the Brown Desert Warm Vanilla Wonder Mauve occupying the softer, more fashion-forward end of the Samba color spectrum that has generated particular collector and fashion interest for its ability to coordinate naturally with contemporary wardrobe aesthetics centered on warm and dusty neutral tones. Adidas has positioned the Samba as their most important lifestyle silhouette for the ongoing period, and the Bambi colorway specifically participates in the brand's pattern of applying character-coded names and palettes from cultural references including Disney, wildlife, and seasonal imagery to give individual Samba colorways a narrative identity and desirability that pure color names cannot achieve alone. The women's sizing specification of this release makes it the targeted entry point for the Samba's most engaged contemporary demographic.

title: adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's) updates the classic Samba silhouette with a straightforward colorway and premium materials.

Although the base color is Cream White, Sand Strata and Core Black add to the sneaker’s retro appearance. Originally an indoor soccer shoe, the Samba OG Sand Strata Cream White features a rubber outsole that provides traction without reducing flexibility. The upper is made of premium leather in Cream White with suede overlays in Sand Strata. The laces, the serrated 3-Stripes, and the collar come in Core Black. In terms of branding, ‘SAMBA’ is printed along the 3-Stripes in Metallic Gold lettering, while the trefoil in gold can be found on the tongue’s logo tag.

Our experts at StockX appreciate the inclusion of metallic elements in a way that doesn’t overwhelm the shoe. The women’s size adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's) was released on January 10th, 2024, and retailed at $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Brown Putty Grey
description:
The adidas Samba OG Brown Putty Grey covers the classic Samba construction in a warm yet neutral colorway of brown, Putty Grey, and Gold Metallic.

Although the silhouette maintains its original form, the color blocking gives the brown putty grey adidas Samba OG a contemporary upgrade. For instance, the base, eyelets, and thin tongue come in a rich brown hue, while off-white covers the heel mustache, the signature 3-Stripes logo, and the collar lining. Adding a third color contrast, the suede T-shaped toe box overlay is gray. The shoe features several branding details, including "SAMBA" in gold lettering on the outer side panel and an off-white adidas logo on the tongue. Like other Samba models, this version boasts a gum rubber outsole underfoot.

Our experts at StockX like that the use of gray on the toe box overlay brings out the suede’s velvety texture. The adidas Samba OG Brown Putty Grey was released on September 30, 2024, and sold for $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Cow Print (Women's)
description: Step into style with the adidas Samba OG Cow Print, a playful twist on the classic silhouette designed exclusively for women. This eye-catching sneaker features a unique cow print pattern on the upper, blending dark brown and off-white hues for a bold, fashion-forward look. The iconic gum 3 outsole provides excellent traction and durability, while staying true to the Samba's timeless aesthetic. The Samba OG Cow Print combines comfort and style effortlessly. Its soft leather upper offers a premium feel and excellent support, while the cushioned insole ensures all-day comfort. The signature T-toe overlay and serrated 3-Stripes maintain the shoe's classic appeal, making it a versatile option for both casual wear and statement-making outfits. Us at StockX believe this product is great for fashion-conscious individuals looking to add a unique, conversation-starting piece to their sneaker collection.

title: adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's) is a women’s sized low-profile silhouette that blends vintage football heritage with street-ready flair.

This women’s adidas Samba OG is all dressed up as it shimmers with a metallic cracked leather upper. The iconic t-toe on this model is accentuated by delicate stitching. The 3-Stripes in a jagged-edged crisp white adorn both sides of the shoe for a classic look. A padded white heel counter, white tongue, and white laces allow the silver patch on the tongue to shine. White Samba branding is next to the 3-Stripes on the lateral side. A gum-colored outsole finishes the elegant aesthetic.

We think the standout feature of the adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's) has to be the metallic cracked leather. It adds just the right amount of shimmer to elevate everyday outfits while staying true to the Samba’s timeless appeal. Originally released on April 1, 2025, this shoe sold for $120 retail.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Solar Gold
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Solar Gold brings a warm yellow treatment to the artist’s ongoing adidas collaboration. Inspired by the golden light of a Caribbean sunset, the design pairs a honey-yellow suede upper with Core Black accents and a gum outsole. The material and color combination gives the familiar Gazelle Indoor profile a vivid identity while maintaining its connection to classic adidas styling.

The collaboration’s sunset reference ties the colorway to themes of growth and change within Bad Bunny’s creative journey. For collectors, that concept adds context beyond the palette itself, connecting the release to the wider partnership. Solar Gold works well as the main accent alongside dark denim, black trousers, or cream-colored clothing, allowing the upper to stand out. The gum sole reinforces the warm tones, making the pair appealing to fans who enjoy recognizable archival silhouettes presented through an artist’s perspective.

Scheduled to release on October 17, 2026, the adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Solar Gold has a retail price of $140.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny is part of a collaboration between adidas and Bad Bunny, a Puerto Rican rapper and singer known for his contributions to the Latin trap genre.

Introduced initially during adidas’ Summer/Fall 2024 lineup, the Bad Bunny adidas Gazelle Indoor features a minimalist aesthetic with an understated colorway of off-white, black, and light grey. The upper is crafted from premium leather in off-white with suede overlays in a light grey hue. Including black on the leather 3-Stripes, tongue, and collar creates a monochromatic contract that emulates Bad Bunny’s personal style. Perforations across the toebox allow the foot to breathe, while thin, white laces provide a secure front closure, and the gum rubber outsole provides traction under the foot.

Our StockX experts like the side panel's dual Bad Bunny and adidas branding. It reads "adidas benito," which pays tribute to the performer’s first name. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny was launched on April 27, 2024, and sold for $120.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo (style JS5052) reimagines a terrace classic with bold color and street-ready flair. Dressed in the Wonder Clay/Wonder Quartz/Ash Pink palette, this pair pairs plush suede with tonal overlays and soft pastel hits for a look that’s both expressive and easy to style. The signature T-toe, serrated 3-Stripes, and low-profile silhouette honor the celebrated Gazelle lineage, while co-branded touches nod to the Bad Bunny collaboration in a way that feels confident and modern. Underfoot, a translucent gum sole delivers timeless indoor-court traction with a smooth, grippy ride, and a cushioned insole keeps every step comfortable from first wear to last call.

Thoughtful details elevate the overall experience. The semi-translucent outsole showcases classic Gazelle Indoor DNA, complementing the supple upper and giving the shoe a distinctive glow in natural light. Included Pink Laces and a White Dustbag add versatile styling options and a premium unboxing moment. Whether you’re pairing them with relaxed denim, track pants, or tailored shorts, the neutral-leaning Wonder Clay base and Ash Pink accents slot seamlessly into rotations year-round. With its balanced mix of heritage sport design and contemporary color execution, this Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo edition lands as a standout choice for collectors and everyday wearers alike.

Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Gazelle Indoor craftsmanship with eye-catching color and day-long comfort, making it a go-to for elevating daily outfits without sacrificing versatility.

title: adidas Gazelle Bold Cardboard Black Gum (Women's)
description:
The adidas Gazelle Bold Cardboard Black Gum Womens reimagines a terrace classic with elevated proportions and a grounded Cardboard Core Black Gum palette. The stacked sole gives the Gazelle a confident lift, while the mix of warm brown and deep black tones keeps the look rooted in heritage. Suede construction across the upper reinforces that vintage football energy, and the gum outsole ties everything together with timeless contrast.

This version stands out because it amplifies a subtle icon rather than reinventing it. The bold platform adds modern attitude, making the silhouette feel more fashion forward without losing its archive identity. Fans of the Gazelle appreciate when adidas experiments with shape while staying loyal to texture and color blocking. It feels versatile yet expressive, easy to pair with relaxed tailoring or everyday denim, offering a fresh take on a model that has defined casual cool for decades.

The adidas Gazelle Bold Cardboard Black Gum Womens was released on August 31, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Core Black
description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Core Black is a sleek and stylish update to the classic Gazelle silhouette. This men's sneaker features a premium black suede upper, complemented by the iconic adidas three-stripe branding in contrasting white. The gum rubber outsole adds a touch of retro flair while providing excellent traction for indoor surfaces. With its low-profile design and cushioned insole, this shoe offers both comfort and versatility for everyday wear. Drawing inspiration from its athletic heritage, the Gazelle Indoor maintains the timeless appeal of its predecessor while incorporating modern elements for enhanced performance. The reinforced toe cap and padded collar ensure durability and support, making it an ideal choice for both casual outings and light indoor sports activities. The Core Black colorway offers a sophisticated look that pairs effortlessly with various outfits, from jeans to chinos. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that combines classic style with contemporary comfort, perfect for both athletic pursuits and everyday casual wear.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet reimagines the classic Gazelle silhouette with a bold colorway of Better Scarlet with accents in Cloud White that give the sneaker a vintage, varsity athletics look.

The use of suede on the upper provides depth of color and richness to the Better Scarlet, while the white leather 3-Stripes logo and heel tab give the Better Scarlet adidas Gazelle Indoor a timeless feel. The cotton laces, the trefoil on the heel, and the texturized tongue come in Better Scarlet, while the adidas branding on the tongue boasts Cloud White. The semi-transparent gum rubber outsole bears adidas branding beneath the heel and provides traction on a variety of surfaces.

Our experts at StockX like the way this sneaker blends heritage and modern elements to create a retro-inspired shoe with a contemporary twist. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet was released on May 30, 2024, and retailed at $120.

title: adidas Gazelle Bold Earth Strata Aurora Coffee (Women's)
description:
The adidas Gazelle Bold Earth Strata Aurora Coffee (Women's) takes the familiar Gazelle shape and gives it a taller, more pronounced sole. Earth Strata and Aurora Coffee keep this colorway in a range of browns, with Gold Metallic listed as its third color. The result is a warm take on a recognizable adidas Originals silhouette that can anchor an outfit without relying on a bright color.

The Gazelle Bold has a different presence from a standard low profile Gazelle. Its stacked sole gives the shoe extra visual weight, while the classic shape keeps it tied to adidas’ long running casual footwear line. That balance is part of the appeal for someone who likes the Gazelle but wants a pair with a more prominent profile. The brown palette also works well with denim, cream, black, and other neutral pieces.

For collectors, the exact Earth Strata and Aurora Coffee combination distinguishes this women's release from the many other Gazelle Bold colorways. It is a versatile pair with a clear place in an Originals rotation. The retail price is $120.

title: adidas Gazelle Bold Grey White (Women's)
description:
The adidas Gazelle Bold Gray White (Women's) was originally crafted as an all-around training show. However, it’s attention to comfort along with its minimalist design have made it a footwear favorite in both sports and casual lifestyle alike.

It features a suede upper in a solid gray hue, which provides a versatile and neutral base for the shoe. Contrasting white details pop in the iconic three stripes on the sides, the heel, the lacing system, and the tongue. The low-top design and cushioned insole deliver all-day comfort and freedom of movement. A padded collar and tongue offer additional support around the ankle, and a durable rubber outsole with a textured pattern provides reliable traction.

What our experts love most about the adidas Gazelle Bold Grey White (Women's) is the subtle branding, from the Trefoil logo on the tongue to the embossed "adidas" on the sole, to the metallic "Gazelle" running adjacent to the three stripe pattern on the sides. These shoes originally retailed for $120 when they first released on December 13, 2022.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green brings a bold contrast to one of adidas’ most timeless silhouettes, blending rich shadow red with deep shadow green for a look that feels both vintage and fresh. The pairing creates a layered color story that stands out without overwhelming the clean lines of the Gazelle Indoor. Wonder white accents help balance the design, keeping it grounded in the classic indoor aesthetic.

What makes this pair hit is how effortlessly it combines strong color with a familiar shape. The Gazelle Indoor has always been about simplicity and versatility, and this version builds on that by adding depth through contrast. It is a colorway that feels expressive but still easy to wear, making it a strong option for collectors who want something with personality.

The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green was released on April 22, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum (Women's)
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W upper is adorned with premium suede while showcasing the titular Blue Fusion. This women’s-sizing silhouette arrives in a Blue Fusion/Footwear White/Gold Metallic colorway.

The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W features a textured tongue with white branding. The signature minimizes its branding features. Other significant features of this low-top sneaker include white lace, Cloud White sock liners, and unbranded heel tabs. Meanwhile, the lateral and medial panels reveal sawtooth-edged Cloud White 3-Stripes. The lateral sides of the shoe, above the 3-Stripes, display the "Gazelle" branding. The gum sole unit is designed in caramel color to round out the sneaker's design.

What we think stands out in the adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W is its archival design that brings out a brilliant and vibrant colorway. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W was released at a retail price of $90 on December 15th, 2022.

title: adidas Gazelle Cream White Core Black Sand Strata (Women's)
secondary_title: Cream White Core Black Sand Strata (Women's)

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Aurora Coffee White
adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin pushes the classic Gazelle silhouette further into luxury fashion territory through a textured reinterpretation that feels both vintage inspired and unapologetically bold. Grace Wales Bonner continues her celebrated partnership with adidas by layering exotic visual cues onto one of the brand’s most culturally important indoor football shoes. The Dusty Rust upper paired with Wonder White and Core Burgundy creates a warm and sophisticated palette, while the snakeskin treatment gives the shoe a dramatic presence that immediately separates it from traditional suede Gazelle releases. The result feels rooted in heritage while carrying the confidence of high fashion styling.

Fans of Wales Bonner collaborations appreciate how each release introduces subtle but meaningful changes that completely shift the personality of familiar adidas classics. The Gazelle Indoor silhouette already holds deep connections to terrace culture, vintage sport style, and global streetwear history, and the snakeskin finish gives that legacy a more elevated and experimental edge. Collectors especially value the collaboration because it consistently merges craftsmanship, storytelling, and fashion credibility without sacrificing the wearable simplicity that makes adidas indoor models timeless. The textured finish and earthy tones make this pair feel especially distinctive within the broader Gazelle lineup.

The adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin was released on April 17, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

title: adidas Gazelle Bold Cream Night Indigo (Women's)
description: The adidas Gazelle Bold Cream Night Indigo (Women's) is a modern platform interpretation of the classic indoor trainer silhouette. The colorway features a clean juxtaposition of Cream White and Night Indigo. The upper, typically suede, is rendered in a smooth Cream White tone. The defining feature is the dramatically stacked, triple-layer gum sole unit, which provides an exaggerated, fashion-forward lift while rooting the shoe in its heritage design via the Gum texture. Released on November 24, 2024, this bold sneaker was priced at $120 retail. The Night Indigo provides a deep, sophisticated contrast on the Three Stripes and heel tab. This design successfully transforms the low-profile Gazelle into a statement piece, blending the shoe's timeless simplicity with contemporary, exaggerated proportions. Our experts commend the dramatic height achieved by the triple-stacked platform sole, which boldly reinterprets the classic profile while showcasing the deep Night Indigo accents against the Cream White suede.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum is a casual sneaker featuring a suede upper in rich Collegiate Green, accented by adidas’ signature 3-Stripes in Cloud White. Gazelle text branding in metallic gold appears alongside the stripes.

Germany’s adidas has been producing footwear and sneakers since 1924, and the brand’s Gazelle indoor football shoe was first released in 1966. The Gazelle represents the first time that adidas produced a shoe using a suede fabrication, a tradition that continues to the modern era and remains current. At the Collegiate Green Cloud White adidas Gazelle Indoor, the Gazelle text branding in metallic gold appears alongside the stripes. A transparent gum sole displays the adidas Trefoil logo, which coordinates with the Trefoil-branded Cloud White rear heel tab.

Our StockX experts feel that the best feature of the Gazelle Indoor is its gum sole, which amps up its sporty Collegiate Green color palette. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum was released on June 10, 2024, and retailed at $120.

title: adidas Campus 00s Core Black
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Core Black was launched as part of the sports collection sneakers in the adidas brand.

The adidas Campus 00s Core Black is covered in core black and white colorways at the upper, footwear white midsole, and brown outsole. This sneaker is a product of suede, rubber, and leather materials that completes the texture. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black features the adidas logo on the tongue and the heel with campus branding at its quarter.

The adidas Campus 00s Core Black got released at a suggested retail price of $100 on February 17, 2023.

title: adidas Campus 00s Bape World Cup Pack Black White
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Bape World Cup Pack Black White merges a classic adidas silhouette with one of the most recognizable names in streetwear. The Campus 00s already carries a chunky and nostalgic feel, and adding Bape’s influence brings a bold and graphic driven edge that elevates the entire design. The black and white palette keeps it grounded while allowing the collaboration details to stand out clearly.

Fans of both brands are drawn to this release for its crossover appeal and cultural weight. Bape collaborations consistently carry strong presence, and pairing that with a timeless adidas model creates something that feels both familiar and refreshed. It is a shoe that fits seamlessly into modern streetwear while still nodding to the history behind both brands.

The adidas Campus 00s Bape World Cup Pack Black White was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $160.
secondary_title: Bape World Cup Pack Black White

title: adidas Campus 00s Better Scarlet Cloud White
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Better Scarlet Cloud White is a standalone sneaker that was released by the German sport company.

The Campus 00s Better Scarlet Cloud White has a lace-up design, making them easy to put on and take off. The laces are made from high-quality material, allowing for easy adjustment to ensure that the sneakers fit your feet. The heel is also well-cushioned to support your feet, making them ideal for individuals who stand or walk for long periods. The outsole is made from rubber, and the pattern is designed to provide a good grip on all surfaces.

We think that the standout feature of the adidas Campus 00s Better Scarlet Cloud White sneakers is its classic design that combines Better Scarlet and Cloud White colorways. Additionally, the high-quality suede material used in the upper part of the sneakers makes them durable. The shoe was released on April 26th, 2023 at a retail price of $110.

title: adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black Core Black Core Black doubles down on early 2000s skate and street nostalgia with a fully monochrome Core Black execution. The chunky proportions and padded tongue reflect the era that made the Campus 00s a staple, while the triple black color story keeps it versatile and understated. Suede textures add depth across the upper, giving the shoe that familiar broken in feel fans associate with the model.

What keeps this pair in rotation is its balance of attitude and simplicity. The exaggerated shape nods to skate culture and baggy denim aesthetics, yet the all black finish makes it easy to style with almost anything. It carries that relaxed confidence that defined a generation of streetwear without feeling costume driven. For collectors who appreciate adidas heritage silhouettes reworked through a nostalgic lens, this version captures the essence of the Campus revival.

The adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black Core Black Core Black was released on May 28, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

title: adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown
description:
The adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is a notable collaboration between adidas and the Latin music superstar – Bad Bunny. The sneaker adopts a classic low-top silhouette with clean lines in a blend of and beige, brown, and Cream White hues.

The Bad Bunny Chalky Brown adidas Campus Light incorporates a brown suede upper with a textured finish, complemented by matching 3-Stripe branding. It also features a unique double-tongue construction. The shoe boasts an updated cream-colored rubber mudguard that transitions seamlessly from a wavy pattern into a sturdy rubber cup sole. Underneath, the outsole showcases a herringbone traction pattern for reliable grip. The branding is minimalistic, with the iconic adidas 3-Stripes on the sides and Bad Bunny's recognizable logo on the tongue.

What our experts find most impressive about the adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is the collaboration between the giant sportswear brand and the Latin music superstar Bad Bunny. This sneaker represents a fusion of Bad Bunny's distinctive style and the classic adidas Campus silhouette, making it ideal for fans of both fashion and music. The adidas sneaker debuted for $160 on July 29th, 2023.

title: adidas Campus 00s Dark Green Cloud White
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Dark Green Cloud White comes in a dark green, cloud white, and off-white color scheme.

The Dark Green Cloud White adidas Campus 00s has an upper that is constructed from dark green suede. The shoe's padded collar offers support and comfort. The sneaker's rubber outsole is durable and provides traction and stability. The perforated ventilation holes on the sides of the upper of the shoe provide breathability. In addition, the shoe has an EVA midsole for padding and support. The shoe features the signature 3-Stripes logo on the lateral sides, "CAMPUS" text on one side, and Trefoil branding on the tongue and heel.

The adidas Campus 00s Dark Green Cloud White was released on March 15, 2023, and sold for a retail price of $110.

title: adidas Campus 00s Grey White
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Grey White comes in a grey three, footwear white, and off-white color scheme.
​
​The Grey White adidas Campus 00s has a grey and white upper with a subtle pattern. The shoe's upper is constructed with suede for durability and style. The sneaker has a durable rubber outsole for stability and traction. The sneaker's EVA wedge midsole provides comforting cushioning. The side perforations of the shoe provide ventilation and comfort. The shoe features the classic adidas 3-Stripes branding on the lateral sides. The sneaker has a "CAMPUS" inscription on one side. The shoe's design is completed with the adidas Trefoil logo on the tongue and heel.
​
​The adidas Campus 00s Grey White was released at a retail price of $100 on March 1, 2023.

title: adidas Campus 00s Core Black White
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Core Black White is an elegant, stealthy lifestyle shoe that originally debuted in the '80s but now rocks a Y2K retro vibe.

The Core Black / Cloud White colorway of the adidas Campus 00s features an upper of black suede with a black suede overlay on the eye stays. The signature adidas three stripes are serrated black matte leather and feature white stitching that stands out. The heel tab is the same matte black leather with singular white stitching. adidas trefoil branding graces both the heel tab and the tongue tag. The lining is a black textile, and the laces and insole are also black. Campus branding appears along the top of the third side panel stripe.

The aspect of this shoe our StockX experts enjoy the most is the unrelieved black of the sole unit. The foam midsole is black with tonal stitching, and it sits on top of a black rubber outsole with a herringbone traction pattern. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black White was released on December 22, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

title: adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Cream
description:
adidas and Bad Bunny are back again in 2023 with a new collaboration on the adidas Campus model. Bad Bunny originally previewed his adidas Campus sneaker in his El Apagón music video.

Bad Bunny did not disappoint with his first adidas Campus model which comes in a cream and cloud white colorway. The sneakers come with a longer suede material, and feature a stacked heel tab and tongue with Bad Bunnys logo located on the tongue. The sneakers also come with extra white laces and a dustbag.

The adidas Campus Bad Bunny Cream released January 28, 2023, with a retail price of $150.

title: adidas Campus 00s Camp Earth Strata Cloud White Gum

title: adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink
description:
The adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink represents a wild collaboration between designer Jeremy Scott and the iconic sneaker company. By dressing an iconic silhouette with imagination and whimsy, adidas x Jeremy Scott create a singular pair of kicks.

The Jeremy Scott Bones Pink adidas Campus 80s features an upper of leather covered in bright pink faux fur with black animalistic striping. Black leather is used to form the serrated 3-Stripes that run across the side panel. This same black leather is used for the heel tab, which sports white adidas trefoil branding. A faux fur tongue with long and wild fur at the top matches the laces and textile sock liner. A black rubber sole unit grounds this shoe, and the outsole features a herringbone traction pattern.

The most distinguishable standout details of this shoe are the large white bone lace dubrae, which can be affixed to the laces, giving this shoe a prehistoric vibe. The adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink was released on February 15, 2023, for $140 retail.

title: adidas Campus 00s Semi Lucid Blue Cloud White
description:
Inspired by the nostalgia of the 2000s, the adidas Campus 00s Semi Lucid Blue Cloud White shoes made their iconic debut. The release saw the classic silhouette rejuvenated with a fresh take on a favored colorway

Adidas sticks to its roots with premium suede on the uppers, detailed with classic Adidas stripes in Cloud White. The off white midsole and Lucid Blue outsole complete this visually appealing colorway. It's a nod to the past, designed for the present. Bringing back the vintage vibes with a modern twist, these shoes capture the true essence of 00's style and Adidas' timeless design language. Whether you're out and about or chilling with your friends, these kicks will ensure your style game is always on point.

adidas Campus 00s Semi Lucid Blue Cloud White dropped with a retail price of $110.

title: adidas Campus 00s Winter Low Black Carbon (Women's)
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Winter Low Black Carbon Womens adapts the oversized Campus look for colder days with a Core Black Core Black Carbon palette that feels sleek and weather ready. The low cut silhouette keeps its chunky stance, while darker tones emphasize the sculpted shape and layered construction. Built with seasonal durability in mind, this version leans into a more grounded aesthetic without losing the identity that made the 00s revival resonate.

Fans gravitate toward winterized releases like this because they maintain cultural relevance while offering practical appeal. The triple black inspired execution makes it easy to pair with heavier layers, cargos, or oversized outerwear. It keeps the skate influenced attitude intact, just refined through a more muted and functional lens. For those who want the Campus 00s presence year round, this iteration delivers familiarity with a colder season edge.

The adidas Campus 00s Winter Low Black Carbon Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Campus 00s Core Black True Pink (Women's)
description:
The adidas Campus 00s Core Black True Pink (Women's) is a retro-inspired sneaker that takes cues from adidas’ early 2000s catalog and skateboarding style.

This low-top sneaker features a slightly bulk silhouette with extra padding on the tongue and around the collar. Another feature that sets it apart from the Campus 80s is the trefoil logo on the tongue. Like the shoe’s proportions, the trefoil is oversized and resembles branding from the 2000s. The upper is made of soft suede in Core Black, while True Pink details add a subtle pop of color. The serrated 3-Stripes logos on the side panels and the trefoil on the tongue come in True Pink. However, the trefoil on the heel tab and the ‘CAMPUS’ lettering along the 3-Stripes feature Cloud White.

Our StockX experts like the durable rubber outsole that contributes to the sneaker’s skater aesthetic. The women’s size adidas Campus 00s Core Black True Pink (Women's) was released on December 1st, 2023, and retailed at $110.

title: adidas Campus 00s Better Scarlet (Kids)
adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga
description:
Just in time for summer adidas and Kanye West delivered the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga, a revamped version of the classic Beluga colorway. The iconic partnership continues to defy expectations and redefine sneaker culture.

With the Carbon Beluga colorway, this drop showcased a fresh take on the beloved Beluga. The Primeknit upper wrapped around the Boost midsole is swathed in this cutting-edge colorway, infusing a familiar design with bold, modern energy. It screams street-ready while maintaining that sleek Yeezy aesthetic we all know and love. This is a sneaker that not only speaks to your style but also pushes it to new levels.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga stomped onto the scene on May 31, 2023, with a retail price of $230.

title: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx
description:
The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx features a PrimeKnit canvas characterized by a combination of black and gray tones, all of which sit atop a black sole equipped with cushioning Boost technology.

The Slate Onyx adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT showcases a neutral colorway with an upper woven from black and gray threads, boasting an engineered 3D knit construction that offers lightweight support and a snug fit. Moreover, it boasts a flexible sock-like collar and easy-to-wear no-tie elastic laces for added convenience. The sneaker's foundation consists of a full-length Boost midsole, enclosed within a semi-translucent TPU cage, and reinforced by a robust rubber outsole – delivering both durability and comfort for a satisfying footwear experience.

What our experts love about the adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx is its 3D knit upper, which not only provides a unique and eye-catching aesthetic, but also offers a lightweight and supportive fit. The sneaker was released on August 4th, 2023, for $230.

title: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Panda
description:
The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Panda comes with the style, comfort and the distinction of Kanye West's Yeezy line. The Slate White colorway infuses a unique blend of contrasting colors, featuring a compact, knitted upper with a monofilament side stripe.

Staying true to its roots, the shoe showcases the iconic Yeezy Boost technology within a translucent outsole for comfort that's as stellar as its look. The lace-up design, coupled with the minimalist aesthetic, makes these sneakers a trend-setting piece in any sneaker collection.

The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Panda dropped on June 2, 2023, retailing at $230.

title: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Bone
description:
The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Bone was a collaborative sneaker added to both of the brands' catalogs.

This sneaker features an all-gray Primeknit upper with the trademark stretchy sock-like ankle collar. The upper is highlighted by a cream shade that runs throughout the exterior. Branding in this Yeezy Boost version, which only features the signature Yeezy on the insoles. Gray laces and a full-length Boost cushion used on the off-white sole finish off the design. 

The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Bone was made available on September 23rd, 2022. Initially, it retailed at $230.

title: adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (Kids)
description:

Constructed with injected EVA foam, this slip-on shoe features a single-strap upper dressed in a monochromatic Resin hue. Plush cushioning is used on the footbed for comfort. What our experts love about this Yeezy slide is its design and comfort. The injected EVA foam provides lightweight durability, while the footbed cushioning provides comfort. Strategic flex groove placement on the outsole offers optimal traction and comfort. The versatile Light Green Resin colorway gives this slip-on shoe a unique and eye-catching look. title: adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Infants)
description:
During his time with adidas, Kanye West created slides in a handful of different styles. The adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Infants) was a miniature version of the Yeezy Slide done up in a desert sand color.

These Yeezy Slides were constructed out of an EVA material that made them more flexible than rubber. They also featured a hook-and-loop strap that went around the heel and made them easy to put on and take off. They had a thick seamless midsole with a sawtooth pattern on the bottom as well, which gave them a rugged look and provided them with excellent traction.

But our favorite thing about these Yeezy Slides was that they were incredibly soft, which made them an ideal choice for infants. At the same time, they didn’t force parents to sacrifice style for comfort since they included all the same features as the Yeezy Slides available in adult sizes. The adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Infants) was released on December 6, 2019, for a $35 retail price.

title: adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Kids)
description:
The adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Kids) presents a simplistic and chic sandal design suitable for casual wear.

The kid-sized adidas Yeezy Slide features a subtle tan hue, contributing to its clean and uncomplicated appearance. Fashioned from robust EVA foam, the upper ensures enduring comfort and durability. The only visible branding comes from adidas' three-stripes logo debossed onto the soft footbed. Additionally, the outsole is engineered with strategically positioned horizontal grooves, enhancing both traction and comfort. This slide serves as a testament to the collaborative effort between adidas and Kanye West, seamlessly merging comfort with understated elegance.

The notable attribute of the adidas Yeezy Slide Desert Sand (Kids) resides in its sturdy construction using EVA foam. This aspect guarantees prolonged comfort and resilience, making the slide not only a stylish choice but also a practical option for everyday casual attire. The slide debuted on December 6, 2019, for $45.

The slide also features a wide strap across the top with a ribbed texture. The outsole of the Yeezy Slide Bone Infants is made of the same foam material as the rest of the slide, with a series of grooves strategically placed for added grip and stability.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Bone (I) was released on December 6th, 2019 at a retail price of $35.

title: adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (Infants)
description:
The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (Infants) is part of the Yeezy line, which is a collaboration between adidas and the rapper Kanye West. It was designed specifically for babies and toddlers.

The Yeezy Slide Resin for infants has an all-Resin colorway and a slip-on design, ensuring that parents can get them onto the feet of their infants with ease. The slide has a cushioned footbed that provides ample support for the baby’s sensitive feet. The outsole is made with high-quality rubber, providing a sturdy grip and durability for infants learning to walk.

We think that the outstanding feature of the adidas Yeezy Slide Resin is its construction. The slide is made with a durable and lightweight resin upper that is easy to clean and maintain, making it perfect for kids who are always on the go. The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (Infants) was released on December 6th, 2019, at a retail price of $35.

description:
The New Balance 550 White Grey features a white leather upper with monochromatic perforated leather overlays and puffed New Balance logos. From there, a woven New Balance Basketball tongue label and matching sole completes the design.

description:
Taking cues from the 1989 New Balance P550, the New Balance 550 White Black features a smooth white leather upper with perforated overlays and black piping. Puffed New Balance logos decorate the quarter panel. At the base, a matching white and black sole completes the design.

title: New Balance 550 Sea Salt Pack Marsh Green
description:
The Sea Salt Pack Marsh Green New Balance 550 offers a modern interpretation of classic basketball shoes by combining clean color tones with an age-old design. This low-top sneaker stands out with its Marsh Green accents against a crisp white base.

The Sea Salt Pack Marsh Green 550 iteration features a leather upper in a Sea Salt white tone with Marsh Green detailing on the heel tab, "N" branding, and outsole. The shoe has perforated panels for breathability, a sturdy rubber sole, and a lace-up closure for a secure fit​. New Balance branding is on the sole, with a marsh green "550" on the upper below the laces.

One thing we, the experts, like about the Sea Salt Pack Marsh Green New Balance 550 is the leather upper's perforated texture, which adds design depth. Another is the Marsh Green accents on the white and cream base. This sneaker retailed for $110 when it was released on May 24, 2024​.

The majority of the shoe’s upper is white, but has pink details around the toes, heels, and on the big "NB" New Balance logo that appears on both sides.

title: New Balance 550 Sea Salt True Red
description:
The New Balance 550 Sea Salt True Red presents a blend of classic 1980s charm with contemporary design, offering both style and comfort.

This iteration of the New Balance 550 Sea Salt True Red revitalizes the vintage ’80s basketball shoe with a fundamental two-toned appearance. Adorned in layered white leather, the sneaker incorporates black and red textile elements within the padded collar. Improved airflow is facilitated through a nylon tongue, while support for the rearfoot is delivered by a TPU heel clip. Notable branding features encompass an elevated "N" on the quarter panel and embossed on the heel overlay is a flying NB logo. Atop a rubber cup sole, the low-top structure displays an exposed EVA wedge on the medial sidewall.

The standout quality of the New Balance 550 Sea Salt True Red lies in its premium leather upper. Combined with the striking Sea Salt/True Red color scheme, this attribute contributes to the shoe's distinctive and fashionable appearance. The sneaker retailed for $120 when it was released on February 5, 2023.

title: New Balance 550 White NB Navy
description:
The New Balance 550 White NB Navy revives one of basketball footwear's most beloved retro silhouettes, combining a clean white base with NB navy and quarry blue accents for a classic, understated color story. The 550 has found tremendous crossover appeal within sneaker culture, prized for its chunky, retro basketball construction that has translated seamlessly into contemporary streetwear rotation. This white and navy combination keeps the design versatile while still carrying the silhouette's distinctive vintage basketball heritage.

The 550 has experienced a significant resurgence in recent years, driven by its clean, retro basketball aesthetic that appeals to both sneaker collectors and casual wearers alike. White and navy together create a classic, easy to style palette that works well across countless outfit combinations, making this pair a versatile addition to any rotation. Fans of the 550's continued revival appreciate how New Balance keeps finding fresh, wearable colorways that honor the silhouette's basketball roots while ensuring broad everyday appeal.

The New Balance 550 White NB Navy was released on January 1, 2024 with a retail price of $109.

title: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Sea Salt
description:
The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Sea Salt features a Sea Salt textile upper with tonal jagged suede overlays and unfinished edges. From there, a cream Nrgy midsole and grey outsole complete the design.
