title: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Black
description:
The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Black leans fully into deconstructed aesthetics, highlighting raw edges and layered textures that have defined the Protection Pack identity. The all black execution gives the shoe a stealthy and industrial feel, letting the torn suede panels and sculpted sole speak for themselves. It feels rugged and deliberate, emphasizing imperfection as a design choice rather than a flaw.

Collectors love this release because it represents a turning point in modern New Balance culture. The Protection Pack reframed how people viewed unfinished design, and this black version amplifies that philosophy through restraint and depth. Fans appreciate how it feels durable, expressive, and timeless, making it a sneaker that holds visual interest long after first wear while remaining comfortable and versatile in rotation.

The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Black was released on November 3, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: New Balance 2002R Off White
description:
The New Balance 2002R Off White is a running shoe that comes in a Beige Off White colorway.

This sneaker features an upper constructed with mesh, leather and suede with grey tones around the collar. Other details include jersey lining, a padded tongue and collar, the "N" logo on the sides, and the "2002R" on the lateral just below the collar. Rounding out the design is a textured ACTEVA LITE rubber midsole that utilizes the ABZORB cushioning technology and a black treaded N-ergy rubber outsole.

The New Balance 2002R Off White was released on September 2nd, 2022, retailing at $120.

title: New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey blends urban looks with technical capabilities that offer a smart, quieted sneaker for versatile use. This edition leverages New Balance’s expertise in ergonomic design and long-lasting construction with refined, contemporary fashion.

The Black Dark Grey 2002R by New Balance features a suede and mesh upper in dark tones for breathability and structure. The ABZORB midsole technology offers shock absorption and comfort, while the N-ergy outsole gives you extra stability. Released as part of New Balance’s 2000 series, which originally debuted in 2010, this model maintains classic running-shoe elements with modern updates to give you a shoe that highlights the brand’s renowned craftsmanship and futuristic design.

What we love about the New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey are its ABZORB cushioning for lasting comfort and the sturdy N-ergy outsole for added stability. Released at $145 on July 3, 2024, these features combine seamlessly for an everyday sneaker.

title: New Balance 2002R Gore-Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R Gore Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey Castlerock builds on the rugged identity of the Protection Pack with a weather ready upgrade that feels purpose driven from the ground up. The slate grey and castlerock palette leans into tonal layering, giving the jagged suede overlays a more understated but still textured presence. Combined with Gore Tex construction, the shoe feels equipped for unpredictable conditions while maintaining the signature deconstructed aesthetic that defines the series.

Fans of the Protection Pack gravitate toward pairs like this because they balance visual edge with real functionality. The distressed look is not just for style, it reinforces the idea of durability and wear over time. With its muted colorway and technical backing, this version fits seamlessly into daily rotation while still offering something distinct for collectors who appreciate evolution within familiar silhouettes.

The New Balance 2002R Gore Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey Castlerock was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

title: New Balance 2002R Black Metallic
description:
The New Balance 2002R Black Metallic pushes the silhouette into a more modern and slightly futuristic direction, using black tones paired with metallic accents to create depth and contrast. The layered upper highlights the technical structure of the 2002R, giving it a dynamic look that shifts depending on lighting. It stays rooted in performance design while leaning into lifestyle appeal.

Fans appreciate how this colorway adds energy without sacrificing versatility. The metallic elements elevate the design just enough to make it stand out, while the black base keeps it wearable across different styles. The 2002R continues to thrive as a crossover model, and this version reinforces its place in both comfort and design focused rotations. It is a strong option for those who want a subtle but distinctive sneaker.

The New Balance 2002R Black Metallic was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

title: New Balance 2002R Triple Black Suede
description:
The New Balance 2002R Triple Black Suede elevates everyday style with a stealthy, monochrome palette and rich materials. Wrapped in plush suede with tonal mesh underlays, this all-black take on the 2002R blends modern cushioning with classic running DNA for a look that’s clean, versatile, and easy to wear. The Black/Magnet colorway keeps branding subtle and refined, while layered paneling and precise stitching add depth and texture. A sculpted midsole and streamlined silhouette deliver a contemporary edge that pairs just as well with technical gear as it does with pared-back streetwear.

Underfoot, the 2002R is engineered for comfort and stability from first step to last lap. ABZORB cushioning in the midsole softens impact, N-ergy heel pods add responsive shock absorption, and a Stability Web shank helps keep transitions smooth and supported. Durable Ndurance rubber targets high-wear zones for long-lasting traction, making this pair a dependable daily driver. Finished with the style code U2002RBL and releasing on 2025-03-01, this Triple Black Suede edition is a go-to for anyone who wants refined design, premium feel, and all-day comfort in one effortless package.

We're seeing major traction on this drop since it delivers stealth looks, plush materials, and dependable 2002R comfort that fits seamlessly into any rotation.

title: New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue
description:
The New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue represents a collaboration between the world-renowned sneaker company and the Montreal-based design studio. This running and lifestyle shoe combines colors and textures in subtle, stormy hues.

The JJJJound x New Balance 2002R Storm Blue sports an upper with a base of gray mesh. Overlays of gray suede, perforated blue leather, and silvery synthetic leather course across the upper giving the shoe style and support. A black leather N on the side panel ties into the black sock liner, insole, and black rubber outsole. Cream-colored laces match the cream-colored foam in the heel of the midsole. New Balance branding adorns the heel tab while JJJJound branding accents the tongue and insole.

What our sneaker experts enjoy most about this shoe is the technology that provides cushioning and energy return in the midsole. ABZORB in the forefoot and ABZORB SBS in the heel provide cushioning and impact absorption while N-ergy specializes in springy energy return. Stability Web technology beneath the midfoot provides arch support. The New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue was released on October 26, 2023, for a retail price of $170.

title: New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal
description:
The New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal is a performance running shoe with interior technical features inspired by the MR2002.

The sneaker boasts a breathable mesh upper with cut-out suede and leather overlays. Suede detailing can also be found on the heel and forming the mudguard. Although the shoe features ABZORB SBS pods in the heel for increased energy return and an ABZORB midsole for added cushioning, it appears light. Another element that makes the sneaker stand out is the black-on-grey colorway of Gunmetal, Phantom, and Black, which creates a stealthy look. In terms of branding, the New Balance "N" graces the lateral side panel, and "2002R" can be found on the mesh upper.

Our experts like how the white midsole contrasts the dark tones of the upper. The New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal was released on October 21st, 2022, and retailed for a price of $140.

title: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey comes in an all-grey color scheme.

The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey has an upper constructed from a blend of synthetic and breathable mesh materials. The sneaker has a midsole featuring responsive foam for padding and stability. The outsole is made of rubber, making it durable and slip-resistant. The shoes include a sturdy toe cap and a sturdy heel counter for further protection. The shoe features an "N" logo and "2002R" lettering on either side. The sneaker also has "NB" branding on the heel.

The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey was released on February 14, 2023, and retailed for $170.

title: New Balance 2002R White Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R White Grey brings a clean, understated palette to this beloved retro running silhouette, combining white and grey for a genuinely versatile, easy to style presentation. The 2002R has become one of New Balance's most celebrated retro revivals, prized for its layered construction and vintage inspired proportions that appeal to sneaker collectors well beyond the running community. This white and grey combination keeps the design grounded and adaptable across countless outfit combinations.

The 2002R's resurgence has been driven largely by its intricate, technical aesthetic reminiscent of early two thousands running design, giving it crossover appeal similar to other retro silhouettes gaining traction in recent years. This neutral toned execution offers a dependable, versatile alternative to bolder 2002R colorways, appealing to collectors who want a foundational pair within their rotation. Collectors of the 2002R line appreciate how each new colorway finds fresh ways to highlight the shoe's complex paneling and layered construction.

The New Balance 2002R White Grey was released on January 15, 2023 with a retail price of $145.

title: New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey arrives in a monochrome suede with a leather and mesh construction.

The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey has got the "N" logo placed on both sides of the shoe and also on the front part of the shoe's outsole. The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey mesh uppers have overlays of black leather and suede engulfing the silhouette. The design includes a grey and black sole unit, a bright white midfoot motif, and metallic silver rears. 
  
  The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey was released in June 2022 and retailed for $140.

title: New Balance 9060 Triple Black
description:
The New Balance 9060 Triple Black exemplifies the essence of simplicity and versatility in a sports shoe.

Constructed with a breathable mesh and soft suede upper, the Triple Black New Balance 9060 prioritizes both comfort and temperature regulation, preventing overheating. Predominantly black, the mesh upper introduces a slightly softer dark charcoal hue, creating a balanced contrast. The iconic midfoot "N" motifs seamlessly integrate with the understated sole units, contributing to a unified aesthetic. The tongue logo pays homage to the original 991 lace jewel. Underneath, the sculpted pod midsole incorporates ABZORB, ENCAP, and SBS cushioning for optimal comfort.

The most noteworthy feature of the New Balance 9060 Triple Black is its sculpted pod midsole, which includes ABZORB, ENCAP, and SBS cushioning. This aspect ensures enduring comfort, establishing the shoe as an excellent choice for everyday wear. The sneaker was originally sold for $150 on September 22nd, 2023.

title: New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock Grey
description:
The New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock Grey was inspired by a 90s model and comes in a grey, black, and red colorway.

This Black New Balance 9060 sneaker consists of a black mesh base with monochromatic pigskin suede and leather overlays. The shoe is designed with "N" branding on the side panel, a plush tongue, and flat laces. The model has a CR device at the heel. The design is completed by a chunky, dual-density midsole equipped with ABZORB and SBS cushioning.

The New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock Grey was released on September 2nd, 2022, at a retail price of $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud Grey
description:
The New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud Grey takes on an early 2000s design by the American brand.

The sneaker displays tones of grey and off-white. It features a mixed-material upper that combines pigskin suede overlays with mesh, and the "N" emblem is accented with multiple silver details. The medial logo has a deconstructed appearance made up of parallel lines, while the"N" is solid on the lateral. The dual-density midsole, which sits on top of the diamond-shaped outsole, combines SBS cushioning and ABZORB technology.

The New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud Grey debuted on September 2nd, 2022, and originally retailed at $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado
description:
The New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado embraces tonal depth, wrapping the sculpted silhouette in a cohesive Mono Cortado shade that feels rich and grounded. The layered upper blends mesh and suede seamlessly, allowing subtle texture differences to shine through the single color execution. The bold midsole design keeps the shoe futuristic while the monochrome palette refines its presence.

Mono treatments often highlight the architecture of a sneaker, and the 9060 benefits from that focus. Without heavy contrast, the flowing lines and chunky sole unit become the centerpiece. Fans who appreciate understated but distinctive footwear will find this pair especially appealing for its balance of modern design and versatile color.

The New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado was released on January 7, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

title: New Balance 9060 Mushroom Timberwolf
description:
The New Balance 9060 Mushroom Timberwolf puts a futuristic spin on classic New Balance designs, including the 99X, the 991, and the 860.

The Mushroom Timberwolf colorway of the New Balance 960 sports an upper of lightweight and breathable white mesh with pig suede overlays in complementary shades of gray, tan, and brown. The classic side panel N logo is constructed from pale embroidered dashed lines that match the cream-colored shoelaces. The heel features a semi-translucent CR device as well as NB branding. The sock liner is cream-colored and the black insole and gray tongue each sport New Balance branding. The outsole is black rubber with a red diamond traction pattern.

What we love most about this sneaker is the high-performance sole unit. The midsole is constructed of ABZORB in an exaggerated wavy pattern with ABZORB SBS in the heel for cushioning and impact absorption. The New Balance 9060 Mushroom Timberwolf was released on September 22, 2023, for a retail price of $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Black Cement
description:
The New Balance 9060 Black Cement is a sleek and stylish addition to the popular 9060 line. This men's sneaker features a predominantly black colorway with subtle cement accents, creating a versatile and sophisticated look. The upper is crafted with a combination of premium materials, including mesh and suede overlays, providing both durability and breathability. The shoe's chunky sole unit incorporates New Balance's innovative cushioning technology, ensuring superior comfort and support for all-day wear.

Designed with both fashion and function in mind, the 9060 Black Cement boasts a modern silhouette that pays homage to New Balance's heritage while embracing contemporary aesthetics. The shoe's distinctive design elements, such as the exaggerated heel and sculpted midsole, offer a unique visual appeal that sets it apart from other sneakers in its class. With its blend of style, comfort, and quality craftsmanship, the New Balance 9060 Black Cement is an excellent choice for sneaker enthusiasts and casual wearers alike. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a versatile, comfortable sneaker that effortlessly transitions from casual outings to more dressed-up occasions.

title: New Balance 9060 Sea Salt White
description: The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt White is a sleek and stylish sneaker that combines modern design with classic elements. The upper is made of premium leather and mesh, providing durability and breathability. The sea salt white colorway gives the shoe a clean and minimalist look, making it a versatile addition to any wardrobe. The release date for this shoe is January 14th, 2023, and with a retail price of $150. The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt White is perfect for those who want a comfortable and fashionable sneaker that can be worn for any occasion. With its high-quality materials and attention to detail, this shoe is sure to impress.

title: New Balance 9060 Triple White
description:
The New Balance 9060 Triple White takes the classic 9060 silhouette and adds an all-white colorway. Including white on the upper, outsole, midsole, and lining allows the sneaker’s design elements to stand out.

This version of the 9060 finds inspiration in the 990 and the 860, giving the lifestyle shoe an early 2000s aesthetic. It features wavy leather overlays on the upper that complement the wavy pattern on the thick midsole. The upper is made of breathable mesh, while the heel displays a transparent CR device. This feature can be found on other 9060 models and supports heel stability. Although the curving logo on the tongue resembles the lace jewel on the 991, the diamond-like pattern of the outsole finds inspiration in the 860.

Our StockX experts like how ABZORB cushioning and pods in the midsole contribute to the sneaker’s chunky appearance. The New Balance 9060 Triple White was released on January 12th, 2024, and retailed at $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Chocolate
description:
The New Balance 9060 Chocolate brings a rich, monochromatic treatment to this popular retro running silhouette, combining deep chocolate tones throughout for a genuinely warm, cohesive presentation. The 9060 has built its reputation on chunky, layered construction that channels New Balance's dad shoe aesthetic while still feeling considered and design forward. This chocolate execution gives the shoe a distinctly warm, autumnal quality that stands apart from brighter or cooler toned 9060 releases.

The 9060's oversized, technical looking build gives this chocolate colorway genuine visual depth, appealing to collectors who want their New Balance pairs to carry a rich, sophisticated presence. This monochromatic treatment lets the silhouette's complex paneling and layered construction take full visual precedence without competing color elements. Fans of both the 9060's chunky retro construction and warm, cohesive color palettes find this Chocolate release a compelling addition to their collection.

The New Balance 9060 Chocolate was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Reflection White
description:
The New Balance 9060 Reflection White pushes the brand’s retro running DNA into more futuristic territory through exaggerated proportions and sculpted design language inspired by archival performance models. The 9060 quickly became one of New Balance’s most popular modern silhouettes because it combines familiar heritage elements with oversized midsoles and layered construction that feel experimental and fashion forward. The Reflection and White color palette enhances that identity through soft neutral tones that give the shoe a clean and highly versatile atmosphere while allowing the dramatic shape and flowing lines of the silhouette to remain the focus.

Fans appreciate the 9060 because it represents a bold evolution of classic New Balance aesthetics without abandoning the comfort and wearability that define the brand. The lighter colorway creates a softer and more lifestyle oriented personality compared to darker technical runner releases, making the silhouette easier to integrate into modern casual wardrobes. Collectors especially gravitate toward neutral 9060 colorways because they highlight the sculptural midsole and layered upper construction without overwhelming the design through excessive contrast. The result feels futuristic, comfortable, and highly aligned with the growing popularity of chunky retro inspired runners within contemporary sneaker culture.

The New Balance 9060 Reflection White was released with a retail price of $160.

title: New Balance 9060 Rose Sugar Angora
description: The New Balance 9060 Rose Sugar Angora is a stunning addition to the popular 9060 lineup, offering a fresh and sophisticated colorway for sneaker enthusiasts. This men's shoe features a harmonious blend of rose sugar, angora, and ice wine hues, creating a soft and elegant aesthetic that's perfect for both casual and semi-formal occasions. The upper combines premium materials, including plush suede and breathable mesh, ensuring both style and comfort throughout the day. Built on New Balance's innovative 9060 silhouette, this sneaker boasts a chunky sole unit that provides exceptional cushioning and support. The distinctive midsole design incorporates New Balance's signature ABZORB and SBS cushioning technologies, offering superior shock absorption and energy return with every step. The Rose Sugar Angora colorway adds a touch of refinement to the bold 9060 design, making it a versatile option for fashion-forward individuals seeking a balance between retro inspiration and modern aesthetics. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those who appreciate a blend of comfort and style in their footwear, perfect for all-day wear and making a subtle yet impactful fashion statement.

title: New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock
description:
New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock blends futuristic proportions with heritage running cues, creating a silhouette that feels bold yet grounded. The black and castlerock palette gives the shoe a clean and versatile identity, allowing the exaggerated midsole and layered upper to stand out without overwhelming the design. It feels modern and confident, reflecting New Balance’s evolution into contemporary lifestyle culture.

Collectors gravitate toward the 9060 because it represents experimentation done right. The shoe pushes form and scale while still feeling wearable, making it a favorite among fans who appreciate innovation rooted in brand DNA. It fits naturally into rotations built around comfort and design, reinforcing why New Balance continues to resonate with a new generation of sneaker enthusiasts.

The New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock was released on 09/02/2022 with a retail price of $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black
description:
The New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black is an athletic shoe featuring multiple layers on the upper. A Grey mesh fabric base is overlaid with Black suede that borders the midsole. Grey and White leather caging creates the soft geometry of the upper, accented by the linear N logo in White and Grey. The layered, textured mid- and outsole repeat the White, Grey, and Black colors, echoing the upper's layered aesthetic. New Balance branding appears on the tongue and rear heel.

Primarily known for running shoes, American sneaker brand New Balance has been honing its performance styles in Boston, Massachusetts, since 1906. The brand has attracted legions of devotees for its running-focused shoes. The 9060 made its debut in the 2020s, and its vintage-inspired early 2000s aesthetic has proved to be a versatile canvas for colorway improvisation.

Our experts believe that the 9060 Grey's best feature is its substantial sole, which lends it a modern throwback look. The New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black was released on March 8, 2025, and retailed for $150.

title: New Balance 9060 Breakfast Tea Angora
description:
The New Balance 9060 Breakfast Tea Angora gives the 9060’s bold proportions a soft, warm-toned finish. Its Angora and Breakfast Tea color combination lets the layered upper and sculpted sole stand out without relying on bright color. The result brings a calmer look to a silhouette known for its oversized shape and references to New Balance running designs.

Mesh and suede overlays create depth across the upper, while the expanded midsole shapes make the shoe immediately recognizable as a 9060. ABZORB and SBS cushioning contribute to its substantial underfoot feel. Details inspired by the 99X series sit alongside a more expressive, early-2000s-influenced profile, giving collectors plenty to notice from the side panels to the outsole. The neutral colors also make this pair easy to work into everyday outfits despite its striking proportions.

Released on May 27, 2026, the New Balance 9060 Breakfast Tea Angora retailed for $160. With its layered materials, gentle color palette, and distinctive 9060 shape, it offers a versatile take on one of New Balance’s more expressive sneakers.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Graphite Grey
description:
Blending retro runner style with modern comfort, the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Graphite Grey delivers a clean, versatile look that works from morning miles to weekend fits. The airy mesh base is layered with glossy synthetic overlays in Graphite Grey, framing the streamlined silhouette while enhancing structure and durability. Underfoot, signature GEL cushioning in the heel and forefoot pairs with a responsive midsole to soften impact and keep strides smooth, while the TRUSSTIC support system helps stabilize transitions. A padded tongue, plush collar, and breathable lining round out a supportive, easy-wearing feel you’ll reach for daily.

Designed for everyday wear with performance pedigree, this men’s ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 nods to the late-2000s original with its sculpted lines and technical detailing. The White/Graphite Grey colorway keeps styling effortless, pairing with athletic gear or tailored casual looks. Durable rubber on the outsole grips city streets, and the streamlined last offers a snug, secure fit without bulk. Style ID 1203A537-110 and a June 6, 2025 release underscore its timely appeal, while the approachable $150 retail price makes it a smart pick for rotation-ready comfort.

Our team thinks this product is great for anyone who wants dependable cushioning, stable support, and a timeless look in one pair, our experts love how the GEL setup, TRUSSTIC stability, and breathable materials come together for all-day wearability.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver is a running shoe that pays homage to the style of the late 2000s with updated materials and construction.

This version of the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 is made with a black mesh upper for breathability. Synthetic leather overlays can be seen across the midsole in black and silver forming the classic ASICS design. There are also black overlays around the toebox and heel for extra support. The ASICS logo appears in silver on the cushioned tongue, and GEL branding appears in silver on the heel. The shoe is equipped with a TRUSSTIC support system and trademark Gel cushioning for comfort and shock absorption.

What makes these shoes stand out is the black colorway. The black with a few accents of silver elevates these shoes from a simple running shoe to a stylish fashion choice. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver was released on January 1, 2024, for a price of $150.

title: ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink
description:
The ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink is a technical running sneaker boasting metallic silver and Sweet Pink accents.

While the Cream Sweet Pink ASICS GEL-Kayano 14’s mesh construction, including the web of faux-leather overlays and mesh underlays, pays homage to GEL-Kayano models from the early 2000s, the use of shiny metallic silver gives the sneaker a futuristic upgrade. In addition, Sweet Pink accents add pops of color on the midsole pods, the ASICS branding, and the rubber outsole. Toshikazu Kayano didn’t design this version of the GEL-Kayano; however, the shoe still maintains its iconic layered construction and GEL technology underfoot. This cushioning system provides advanced shock absorption without weighing down the foot.

Our experts at StockX appreciate the sneaker’s sustainable features, including the sockliner, which is crafted using a dyeing process that reduces water consumption by 33 percent and carbon emissions by 45 percent. The ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink was released on May 1, 2024, and retailed at $150.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cream Black Metallic Plum
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cream Black Metallic Plum is a running shoe that was released as part of the ASICS Gel-Kayano series.

The upper of the Cream Black Metallic Plum ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 is crafted with a combination of leather and mesh materials, offering both durability and breathability. The shoe comes in a cream-and-black colorway and has a traditional lace-up closure that ensures a snug and secure fit. The outsole features a vertical flex groove that enables the foot to move more naturally, reducing stress on the foot and the potential for injury.

We think that one of the most notable features of the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cream Black Metallic Plum is the dynamic DuoMax support system on the sole. This system provides stability and support for the foot, reducing pronation and enhancing the overall efficiency of your stride. The Gel technology used in the heel of the shoe also provides additional cushioning to absorb impact and help prevent injuries and fatigue. The sneaker was released on May 30th, 2023, at a retail price of $150.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Carrier Grey Black
ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey is a premium running shoe that combines style and performance. Featuring a sleek white upper with fjord grey accents, this sneaker offers a clean and versatile look suitable for both athletic pursuits and casual wear. The Gel-Kayano 14 incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the heel and forefoot, providing superior shock absorption and cushioning for a comfortable stride.

Built with durability and support in mind, the Gel-Kayano 14 boasts a robust construction that caters to various foot types. The engineered mesh upper ensures breathability, while the reinforced heel counter promotes stability during movement. With its blend of cutting-edge technology and timeless design, this shoe is ideal for runners seeking a reliable and stylish option for their daily training or long-distance runs. Our experts state this product is great for athletes looking for a perfect balance of comfort, performance, and aesthetic appeal in their running footwear.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Metropolis Jasper Green
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Metropolis Jasper Green draws elements from heritage models to create a technical sneaker with shiny metallic-silver accents and splashes of bright Jasper Green.

The mesh construction of the Metropolis Jasper Green ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 comes in Metropolis, a dark-gray hue that serves as a subtle backdrop for the leather overlays in metallic silver. Hits of Jasper Green cover the branding details on the mesh tongue and heel and add pops of color on the otherwise white midsole. Gel technology in the heel provides responsive cushioning, while the Trusstic system in the arch increases stability and reduces twisting motions. Finally, the sock liner was made using a dyeing method that reduces water consumption by up to 33 percent.

Our experts at StockX like that even though this version of the Gel-Kayano wasn’t designed by Toshikazu Kayano, it retains design elements drawn from the early 2000s. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Metropolis Jasper Green was released on June 3, 2024, and sold for $150.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Ivory
description:
The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Ivory refines the silhouette through a softer and more understated palette, using white and ivory tones to highlight the intricate paneling of the upper. The colorway leans into minimalism, allowing the structure and layering of the shoe to take center stage without distraction. It feels clean, balanced, and closely aligned with the lifestyle direction the Kayano 14 has taken in recent years.

Collectors appreciate this version for its versatility and quiet confidence. The neutral tones make it easy to integrate into everyday outfits, while the detailed construction ensures it still holds visual interest up close. ASICS has found a strong rhythm with the Kayano 14 by pairing performance heritage with modern styling, and this release reinforces that approach. It is a dependable choice for those who value subtle design and long term wearability.

The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Ivory was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Cream
description:
The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Black Cream brings a sleek, contrasting colorway to one of ASICS' most beloved and technically respected running silhouettes. Black dominates the base, paired with cream accents that add warmth and softness against the darker foundation. The Kayano 14 has found significant crossover appeal within sneaker collecting circles, prized for its intricate, layered construction and genuine running heritage that predates its current lifestyle popularity.

The Kayano line has built decades of trust among serious runners for its stability focused technology, and the 14th iteration in particular has become a favorite among collectors drawn to its technical, complex silhouette. Black and cream together give this pair a sophisticated, easy to style palette that works well across both athletic and casual settings. Fans of ASICS' deep running heritage appreciate how the Kayano 14 continues finding new audiences well beyond its original performance focused purpose.

The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Black Cream was released on July 1, 2023 with a retail price of $170.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Pure Silver
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Pure Silver is a stunning addition to the iconic Gel-Kayano line, offering a perfect blend of style and performance. This men's sneaker features a sleek design with a birch and pure silver colorway, creating a versatile look that seamlessly transitions from the track to the streets. The upper is crafted with premium materials, ensuring durability and breathability for all-day comfort.

Engineered for optimal support and cushioning, the Gel-Kayano 14 incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the midsole. This innovative feature provides excellent shock absorption and enhances the overall comfort of the shoe. The responsive cushioning system adapts to your stride, making it an ideal choice for both casual wear and athletic activities. Us at StockX believe this product is great for runners and sneaker enthusiasts alike, offering a perfect balance of performance and style in one package.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Light Navy
description:
The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Light Navy builds on the silhouette’s growing popularity with a colorway that introduces just enough contrast to elevate a clean base. White dominates the upper, creating a crisp foundation, while light navy accents add depth and definition across the overlays and detailing. The result is a look that feels classic yet slightly more dynamic than fully tonal versions.

This pair resonates with fans who want a balance between subtlety and distinction. The light navy elements provide visual structure without overpowering the design, making the shoe feel both polished and versatile. The Kayano 14 continues to thrive as a crossover model between performance and lifestyle, and colorways like this highlight why it remains in demand. It is a strong addition for collectors who appreciate refined updates to a proven silhouette.

The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Light Navy was released on March 13, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver
description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Pure Silver is a sleek and stylish running shoe that offers both comfort and performance. The shoe features a white and pure silver colorway that is perfect for those who want a clean and minimalist look. The upper is made of a breathable mesh material that allows for maximum airflow, keeping your feet cool and dry during even the most intense workouts. The Gel Kayano 14 also features ASICS' signature Gel technology, which provides superior cushioning and shock absorption. This technology is located in the heel and forefoot of the shoe, ensuring that your feet stay protected and comfortable throughout your entire run. The shoe's outsole is made of a durable rubber material that provides excellent traction on a variety of surfaces. This makes the Gel Kayano 14 a great choice for runners who like to switch up their terrain. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Pure Silver was released on April 22, 2022, and retails for $150. Something we love about this shoe is its combination of style and performance. Our experts think the best features of the Gel Kayano 14 are its Gel technology and breathable mesh upper. Overall, we think the standout feature of the ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Pure Silver is its ability to provide both comfort and performance in a stylish package.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige
description:
The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige refines the retro runner formula with a calm and balanced color story. White mesh sets a crisp base, while Hinoki Beige overlays add warmth and subtle contrast across the layered upper. The metallic accents and visible cushioning remain true to the Kayano 14 original design language, preserving its early 2000s performance identity.

Kayano 14 has become a staple in modern rotations thanks to its mix of technical detail and lifestyle appeal. This White and Hinoki Beige pairing feels especially versatile, offering a soft neutral look that works year round. Fans of understated runners appreciate when ASICS keeps the color blocking clean, allowing the intricate panel work and shape to do the talking without relying on loud hues.

The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige was released on January 3, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey Sage
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey is a running shoe that is part of ASICS' Gel-Kayano series, known for its stability and support features.

The shoes have a predominantly grey color scheme with silver overlays. The upper is crafted using mesh and synthetic materials for their breathability and lightweight properties. It also uses FluidFit technology, which is designed to adapt to the runner's foot for a personalized fit. The midsole of the shoe is white with green gel units and the outsole fully black with a pattern to improve grip and traction when running on different surfaces.

One thing we like about the shoes is the midsole, which uses a combination of Gel cushioning and ASICS' FlyteFoam technology, a lightweight and responsive foam, to provide cushioning without adding extra weight to the shoe. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey was released for retail on the 26th of January, 2023, priced at $150.
secondary_title: White Pure Silver Slate Grey Sage

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 Vandy The Pink Vanilla
description:
The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Vandy The Pink Vanilla brings artist Vandy The Pink's distinctive creative vision into the respected Kayano 121 silhouette, finished in a clean antique white throughout. Vandy The Pink has built a reputation for thoughtful, considered sneaker customization and collaborative design work, giving this partnership genuine artistic credibility beyond a standard colorway release. The Kayano's technical, stability focused running heritage provides a strong foundation for this collaborative execution.

Vandy The Pink's collaborations consistently draw attention within sneaker collecting circles for the artist's distinctive approach to reworking established silhouettes through subtle, considered design choices. This antique white execution lets the Kayano 121's technical construction and detailing take center stage, appealing to collectors who appreciate understated, artistically driven collaborations. Fans of both ASICS' running heritage and Vandy The Pink's creative reputation find this release a compelling crossover between technical performance footwear and considered artistic collaboration.

The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Vandy The Pink Vanilla was released on August 14, 2026 with a retail price of $195.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver
description:
Initially debuting in 2008, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver sneakers draw inspiration from the design elements of the GEL-KAYANO 14. This lifestyle running sneaker incorporates a variety of advanced materials to achieve a contemporary look and feel, including technology like GEL cushioning and TRUSSTIC support.

The Black Pure Silver ASICS Gel-1130 features black and pure silver mesh panels, with a logo patch located on the side. It has a rounded toe and employs a front lace-up fastening for secure closure. It also features polished side stripes and a mesh upper. The design is completed with a chunky rubber sole that offers durability and style.

What our experts love about the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver is its distinctive retro aesthetics. This sneaker is characterized by its chunky silhouette and the fusion of modern design elements with nostalgic, vintage-inspired style. The sneaker released on 31st May 2023 for $110.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver is a performance running sneaker that finds inspiration in the ninth version of the Gel-1000 and the GEL-KAYANO.

Synthetic overlays in black and metallic Pure Silver replace traditional leather and give the sneaker a contemporary look. The sneaker boasts a mesh upper in white with a loose weave. This loose weave allows the foot to breathe and is lightweight. The bulky midsole features Gel technology in the heel, which delivers responsive cushioning. ASICS, in black lettering, runs diagonally down the tongue and is one of the few visible branding elements. Like other ASICS Gel-1130 models, the White Pure Silver iteration features an adjustable lace closure.

Our experts at StockX like the way the black details on the overlays complement the black tread on the rubber outsole. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver was released on February 15, 2024, and retailed at $95.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Grey
description:
Celebrating the ninth installment of the GEL-1000 series, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Gray sneaker reflects decades of design evolution.

The upper section of the Black Graphite ASICS Gel-1130 is crafted from over 20% recycled material, showcasing ASICS' dedication to sustainability. Its color scheme harmoniously blends black and Graphite Gray, presenting a versatile and modern aesthetic. The shoe has undergone a transformation, incorporating synthetic leather paneling to update its traditional materials and achieve a more contemporary aesthetic. With GEL technology in the heel, the shoe offers cushioning and comfort. The inclusion of a TRUSSIC support arch enhances stability.

The most prominent feature of the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Gray lies in its GEL technology embedded in the heel. This ensures enduring comfort, making the shoe an exceptional choice for both sports activities and everyday wear. The runner was originally sold for $80 on April 30th, 2022.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Mule White Clay Canyon
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 Mule White Clay Canyon reworks the retro running silhouette into a slip on mule format, offering a more relaxed, low effort way to wear one of ASICS' most popular models. White serves as the clean base, complemented by clay canyon accents that bring warmth and contrast to the design. The mule construction removes the traditional heel counter, making the shoe easy to slide on and off, a detail that appeals to fans looking for comfort focused footwear without sacrificing the Gel 1130's recognizable silhouette.

Mule variations have grown in popularity across sneaker culture as collectors look for more casual, low commitment ways to wear their favorite silhouettes throughout the day. The clay canyon accent color keeps this pair grounded and easy to pair with a range of casual outfits, staying in line with ASICS' recent run of earthy, muted colorways across the Gel 1130 line. For fans who already appreciate the model's retro running heritage, this mule execution offers a fresh, comfort forward way to keep the silhouette in regular rotation.

The ASICS Gel 1130 Mule White Clay Canyon was released on May 18, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Cream
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 Black Cream taps directly into the early 2000s running revival, delivering layered paneling and breathable mesh in a colorway that feels effortless. Black dominates the base, giving the upper a sharp and grounded look, while Cream accents soften the contrast and highlight the flowing lines across the silhouette. The result is a pair that balances performance heritage with everyday wearability.

The Gel 1130 has become a quiet staple in rotation for those who appreciate technical runners without chasing hype. Its retro design language, complete with visible cushioning and sweeping overlays, gives it that authentic archival feel. In Black and Cream, the shoe feels versatile and mature, the kind of pair that works seamlessly with relaxed tailoring or casual street fits while still nodding to ASICS deep performance roots.

The ASICS Gel 1130 Black Cream was released on December 12, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Cloud Grey
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Cloud Gray is a running shoe inspired by past versions of Gel models, including the Gel-1000 and the Gel-Kayano 14, for a late 2000s running aesthetic.

This iteration of the ASICS Gel-1130 features a white mesh base for the upper, allowing for breathability and flexibility. Synthetic leather overlays appear in the traditional ASICS design in white, black, and Cloud Gray across the midsole. The cushioned tongue features the ASICS logo, while "GEL" can be found running diagonally down the heel in gray and black. Gel technology cushioning and the lining on the inside provide extra comfort and shock absorption.

Our favorite feature of this running shoe is the chunky beige outsole, which adds another touch of modernity and style to the design of the functional shoe. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Cloud Gray was released on March 1, 2024, for a price of $100.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver (GS)
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver (GS) brings heritage running style to the everyday pace of growing feet. Inspired by late-2000s performance silhouettes, this grade-school design pairs breathable mesh with sturdy synthetic overlays in a sharp Black/Pure Silver colorway for a sleek, versatile look that moves from classroom to playground with ease. A cushioned midsole with signature GEL technology softens each step, while the supportive build helps keep strides stable during long days on the go. Reflective accents and a layered panel construction add visual depth, delivering a modern twist on a beloved classic.

Underfoot, a durable rubber outsole with reliable traction grips sidewalks and gym floors alike, making this model a smart pick for active routines and weekend adventures. The padded tongue and collar enhance all-day comfort, and the streamlined profile slips easily into school and sport rotations. Finished with ASICS branding and the style code 1204A169-001, the Gel-1130 offers an elevated blend of comfort, support, and street-ready appeal that complements everything from uniforms to athletic wear. Whether it’s daily wear or after-school practice, this pair balances stability and cushioning so kids can focus on fun, not foot fatigue.

Our team thinks this product is great for young wearers who need dependable comfort, standout style, and day-to-day durability in one easy choice.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Clay Canyon
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 in White Clay Canyon is a shoe with its design inspired by the Gel-KAYANO 14 sneaker, with a similar look and updated technology. The shoe was originally released in 2008 and received a makeover in 2023.

This running shoe is constructed from a mix of synthetic leather and light textile materials that allow for breathability and flexibility. White mesh makes up the base of the shoe, while silver and brown synthetic leather cross on the midsole, creating ASICS’ signature style. The ASICS Gel-1130 sneaker has gel cushioning for comfort and shock absorption. The lining also contains cooling pads to keep your feet from overheating.

What our StockX experts appreciate most about this shoe is its classic colorway. The White Clay Canyon colorway works well to make this unique shoe suitable for wear with any outfit. The ASICS Gel-1130 in White Clay Canyon was first released on July 21st, 2023, at a retail price of $95.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Black
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Black is a performance running shoe with a design rooted in the technical running sneakers from the early 2000s.

The "White Black" version of the ASICS Gel-1130 finds inspiration in the GEL-KAYANO 14 and the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series. Although the model was first introduced in 2008, this version features an all-white base with black and silver accents. The upper is made of lightweight mesh with a loose weave that gives the sneaker an airy feel. Synthetic leather overlays cross the mesh base and contribute to the shoe’s technical silhouette. In terms of technology, gel cushioning in the heel reduces impact without weighing the shoe down. ASICS’ signature TRUSSTIC support system also improves stability and is a throwback to the early 2000s.

Our StockX experts like the dope-dyed sockliner. This dyeing technique reduces water usage by 33 percent. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Black was released on January 1st, 2024, and retailed at $95.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Grey
description:
Built on a silhouette originally launched in 2008, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Gray is a stability running shoe that exudes retro vibes infused with more modern details.

The Black Glacier Gray ASICS Gel-1130 begins with an upper of black mesh. Leather strips course across the upper, in shades of gray, black, and white. These overlays offer an early 2000’s running shoe aesthetic, as well as support, enhanced at both the toe cap and heel. The black foam midsole features GEL technology in the heel for ultimate comfort cushioning. An incorporated TRUSSTIC support system improves stability with every step. Rounding it out, a black rubber outsole helps provide impact absorption and traction.

Our favorite detail of this sneaker is the reflective detailing that enhances the side panel overlays in order to help make you more visible when you run in low-light conditions. The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Gray was released on April 15, 2024, for $100 retail.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Mule Cement Lake Grey
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 Mule Cement Lake Grey reworks the retro running silhouette into a slip on mule format, offering a more relaxed, low effort way to wear one of ASICS' most popular models. Cement grey and lake grey combine into a muted, tonal palette that keeps the design understated and versatile. The mule construction removes the traditional heel counter, making the shoe easy to slide on and off, a detail that appeals to fans looking for comfort focused footwear without sacrificing the Gel 1130's recognizable silhouette.

Mule variations have grown in popularity across sneaker culture as collectors look for more casual, low commitment ways to wear their favorite silhouettes throughout the day. This tonal grey combination keeps the shoe grounded and easy to pair with a range of casual outfits, staying in line with ASICS' recent run of muted colorways across the Gel 1130 line. For fans who already appreciate the model's retro running heritage, this mule execution offers a fresh, comfort forward way to keep the silhouette in regular rotation.

The ASICS Gel 1130 Mule Cement Lake Grey was released on May 18, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's)
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) gives the Gel-1130 a contemporary upgrade with a colorway of Pure Silver and light pink.

Drawing design inspiration from version nine of the Gel-1000 series and the Gel-Kayano 14, the Gel-1130 was initially launched in 2008. The "White Pure Silver Pink" colorway repurposes genuine leather overlays with synthetic leather for a more durable finish. The white mesh upper is lightweight and serves as a backdrop for the Pure Silver and pink overlays. Padding in the collar and the gel technology in the heel contribute to the sneaker’s slightly bulky, technical silhouette, while the front lace closure provides a secure fit.

Our experts like the combination of pink, Pure Silver, black, and white colors on the rubber outsole because they complement the hues on the upper. The women’s size ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) was originally released on June 1, 2024, and sold for $95.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Mule Black Graphite Grey
description:

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Glacier Grey Pure Silver
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 Glacier Grey Pure Silver leans into a cooler, more metallic take on the silhouette, pairing Glacier Grey with Pure Silver accents for a design that feels sleek and technical without losing the model's retro running charm. The Gel 1130 has earned a strong following for its clean lines and comfortable, low profile build, and this colorway emphasizes that technical identity through its reflective silver detailing and icy grey base. It is a pair that photographs with a subtle shimmer, giving it a slightly more elevated feel than a standard grey execution.

Collectors drawn to ASICS' running heritage appreciate how the Gel 1130 continues to serve as a canvas for both bold and understated color stories, and this Glacier Grey and Pure Silver pairing sits firmly in the latter camp. The metallic accents give the shoe just enough edge to stand out in a crowded retro running market. This release appeals to fans who want performance inspired design with a cooler, more technical color mood.

The ASICS Gel 1130 Glacier Grey Pure Silver was released on July 1, 2023 with a retail price of $110.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Dried Leaf Green (Women's)
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 White Dried Leaf Green Womens introduces soft earth tones to the retro runner formula. A White mesh base is accented by Dried Leaf Green overlays, creating a balanced and nature inspired contrast. The layered construction and signature Gel cushioning maintain the silhouette’s early two thousands performance identity.

This women’s edition feels light and easy to style, with the muted green tone adding depth without overwhelming the design. The 1130 continues to thrive as a lifestyle favorite thanks to its comfortable build and nostalgic appeal. It captures that sweet spot between sporty and understated, making it a strong everyday option.

The ASICS Gel 1130 White Dried Leaf Green Womens was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Black Silver Cloud
description:
The Salomon XT 6 Vanilla Ice Black Silver Cloud brings a cooler, more neutral palette to the beloved trail silhouette, pairing Vanilla Ice tones with Black and Silver Cloud accents for a look that feels versatile without sacrificing the shoe's technical identity. The XT 6's aggressive, layered construction remains fully intact, giving this colorway the same rugged, trail ready aesthetic that has made the silhouette a favorite among both outdoor enthusiasts and streetwear collectors. This muted execution offers a quieter alternative to the model's bolder color releases.

Collectors who appreciate the XT 6's technical design language will find this Vanilla Ice colorway a fitting addition for those who prefer understated, everyday wearable tones over louder color combinations. The Silver Cloud accents add subtle depth without overwhelming the shoe's overall neutral palette. Fans of Salomon's growing lifestyle presence will find this pair a versatile option within their trail inspired sneaker rotation.

The Salomon XT 6 Vanilla Ice Black Silver Cloud was released on July 1, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

title: Salomon XT-6 Black Coffee Burro Bitter Chocolate
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Black Coffee Burro Bitter Chocolate brings a rich, earthy palette to this technical trail inspired silhouette, combining black coffee, burro, and bitter chocolate for a genuinely warm, sophisticated presentation. The XT-6 continues to carry Salomon's reputation for serious trail running technology, translated into a lifestyle friendly package that appeals equally to outdoor enthusiasts and sneaker collectors. This coffee and chocolate inspired combination gives the shoe a distinctly grounded, autumnal quality compared to the model's more common bold or bright colorway releases.

Salomon has experienced significant crossover appeal within sneaker culture in recent years, as trail running technology has become increasingly fashionable within broader streetwear circles. This warm, café inspired palette gives collectors a sophisticated, earthy alternative to the model's more technical or vibrant color stories. Fans of the XT-6's futuristic, trail ready aesthetic find this release a compelling way to engage with Salomon's continued colorway exploration through a genuinely cohesive, richly toned execution.

The Salomon XT-6 Black Coffee Burro Bitter Chocolate was released on August 18, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

title: Salomon XT-6 Coffee French Roast
description: The Salomon XT-6 Coffee French Roast is a performance trail shoe that utilizes a deep, warm monochromatic colorway. The shoe is predominantly colored in Coffee and French Roast, with accents of Vanilla Ice. This iteration is built for technical terrain, featuring an abrasion-resistant mesh upper and the full-length Agile Chassis System (ACS) for stability. The Quicklace system ensures a precise, secure fit with one-pull tightening. Slated for release on October 1, 2025, this rugged model carries a retail price of $180. The rich, deep Coffee and French Roast tones provide a subtle, earthy contrast, giving the technical silhouette a refined, mature aesthetic. The pop of Vanilla Ice on the sole unit brightens the look. Our team emphasizes the reliable stability provided by the Agile Chassis System and the durable, abrasion-resistant mesh upper, wrapped in the sophisticated tones of Coffee and French Roast.

title: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Silver
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Silver takes Salomon’s signature trailing running technologies and applies them to a city-inspired sneaker.

This lightweight runner boasts an upper made of synthetic mesh, which is designed to keep debris from entering the shoe. Gore-Tex bonds to the mesh upper and creates a protective layer that is waterproof and windproof yet also breathable. The sneaker features an all-black construction with reflective stripes that form triangular shapes and spell out SALOMON. The EnergyCell midsole provides responsive cushioning on concrete, compact soil, and rough terrain, while the rubber tread provides traction. A toggle lace closure with thin, durable laces secures the shoe and allows for easy adjustments. Branding details can be found on the inner side panel and the tongue tag.

Our StockX experts like that the reflective details match the silver accents on the black midsole. The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Silver was released on January 27, 2024, and retailed at $200.

DISCLAIMER: Salomon heel logo may vary depending on the production date of the product that you receive.

title: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari adds sand-colored hues to the rugged Salomon silhouette. Originally designed as a trail running shoe, this sneaker has evolved to meet the needs of urban environments.

Released to celebrate the XT-6 GTX’s 10th anniversary, the Safari Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex features a waterproof membrane and an anti-debris mesh construction. Although the colorway is subtle, the tongue tag has a bright, multicolor design with hits of yellow, red, and blue. The Quicklace system allows for fast adjustments of the no-slip laces by squeezing the "S" button on the buckle. Another technical feature is the Agile Chassis midsole, which provides dual-density foam cushioning and absorbs impact. Finally, the Contagrip rubber outsole houses lugs that provide traction on rough terrains.

Our experts at StockX like the bold branding in black letters, including "SALOMON," "GORE-TEX," and "XT6." The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari was released on January 27, 2024, and sold for $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Icy Pink Dawn Pink
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Icy Pink Dawn Pink brings genuine GORE-TEX weatherproof technology into this technical trail inspired silhouette, combining black with icy pink and dawn pink for a genuinely striking, cool toned presentation. GORE-TEX represents one of the most respected and technically advanced waterproof fabric technologies in outdoor apparel, giving this XT-6 genuine functional performance beyond typical fashion driven lifestyle sneakers. This black and pink combination gives the shoe a distinctive, feminine edge compared to more subdued GORE-TEX equipped XT-6 releases.

Salomon has experienced significant crossover appeal within sneaker culture in recent years, and this GORE-TEX equipped version gives collectors genuine confidence in the shoe's weatherproof performance alongside a genuinely eye catching pink accented colorway. Icy pink and dawn pink together create a soft, distinctive palette that offers a fresh alternative to the model's more common neutral or dark toned GORE-TEX releases. Fans of both the XT-6's trail ready aesthetic and genuine weatherproof technology find this GORE-TEX Icy Pink release a compelling way to engage with Salomon's technical innovation through a distinctly feminine color story.

The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Icy Pink Dawn Pink was released on August 12, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 White Lunar Rock
description:
The two main hues that define the appearance of the Salomon XT-6 White Lunar Rock include lunar rock and white.

This White Lunar Rock Salomon XT-6 shoe features a sturdy and breathable mesh upper, strengthened with TPU overlays. It is equipped with a convenient quicklace system that works alongside SensiFit technology and an ergonomic tongue. Additionally, the shoe includes an EnergyCell midsole made of EVA material and a Contagrip TA outsole with a rubberized texture.

The Salomon XT-6 White Lunar Rock had $190 as the market price during its initial market entry on January 27, 2022.

DISCLAIMER: Salomon heel logo may vary depending on the production date of the product that you receive.

title: Salomon XT-6 Earth Brown Walnut
description:
The Salomon XT 6 Earth Brown Walnut embraces earthy tones across one of the most recognizable trail silhouettes in modern rotation. The streamlined shape and Quicklace system preserve the XT 6 signature identity.

title: Salomon XT-6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun
description:
The Salomon XT 6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun channels desert inspired tones into a performance driven silhouette, creating a warm and cohesive color story. Coyote brown sets the base, while safari and sahara sun accents introduce lighter and brighter elements that reflect natural landscapes. The structure remains technical, built for stability and endurance across different environments.

Fans are drawn to this pair because it feels rooted in outdoor exploration while still carrying strong lifestyle appeal. The earthy palette makes it versatile, while the subtle contrast keeps the design interesting. It stands as a colorway that highlights the connection between performance footwear and nature inspired aesthetics.

The Salomon XT 6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk is a high-octane sneaker fit for challenging speed hikes over trails of various terrain. These sneakers also offer style and panache with every step.

This rough and ready trail shoe begins with an upper base made of a single layer of mesh in Creamy White. TPU film in Creamy White and beige runs over the upper, adding both style and structural support. The toecap and heel are especially fortified. A Quicklace lacing system offers one-pull tightening for a secure fit. Dual-density EVA cushioning in beige and cream creates a midsole to offer springy comfort over rugged terrain. The downhill chassis construction and the lugs geometry of the white rubber outsole complete the look and capability of this shoe.

The detail we enjoy most about this Creamy White sneaker is the multicolored Salomon branding tag that runs down the tongue, adding signature brightness. The Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk was released on February 1, 2024, for $200 retail.

title: Salomon XT-6 White/Ftw Silver
description:
High-performing running shoes meet high fashion with the Salomon XT-6 White/Ftw Silver sneaker. This shoe has become a trendsetter in style circles. With a daring street edge without losing rugged appeal, these sneakers elevate running games and wardrobes alike.

These trainers have a lightweight mesh upper in crisp white with subtle silver overlays. The tongue sports a pop of color with the yellow, blue, and red Salomon branding, while the back heel brands technical specs in silver text. The XT 6’s use a Quicklace system that avoids tying, and the midsole is cushioned with an EVA shock absorber. Outsoles have Contragrip tread to keep you stable and balanced, no matter the surface.

We love this look that Salomon has perfected. Known as "gorpcore," it is a mix of highly functional clothing that has celebs and influencers in its trendy grips. These clean white trainers will keep you hitting parties as easily as a mountain trail. The Salomon XT-6 White/Ftw Silver sneakers were released on August 23, 2024, and retailed at $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey is a performance sneaker that started as a trail shoe but has become a lifestyle staple for many wearers.
       
This iteration of the Salomon XT-6 has an upper made mostly of Ghost Grey mesh for breathability and flexibility. Polyurethane overlays in different shades of grey cross the upper for support in key areas, zigzagging across the sides supporting the eyelets and forming the toe cap, mudguard, and heel area. Salomon branding is found on the lateral heel, while S-Lab XT-6 branding is found on the inner side. More lab branding is found on the lateral toe. A colorful Salomon branding strip runs down the middle of the tongue under the laces, and the laces themselves have a Quicklace fastener instead of being traditional tie laces.

What we like best about this shoe is its monochrome look with different shades of grey, which allows the functionality and versatility of the shoe to stand out. The Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey was released on March 21, 2024, at a price of $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Aspargus Green Tea
description:
The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Aspargus Green Tea adds weather ready functionality to the silhouette, incorporating Gore Tex construction for enhanced protection while maintaining the model’s signature look. The aspargus and green tea tones create a soft and natural palette, while chocolate accents add depth and contrast. The design stays cohesive, balancing performance features with visual appeal.

Fans appreciate this version because it extends the usability of the XT 6 into more demanding conditions without sacrificing style. The Gore Tex element reinforces its technical credibility, making it suitable for varied environments. It stands as a practical and thoughtful evolution of the model, blending durability with a refined color approach.

The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Aspargus Green Tea was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $25.

title: Converse Chuck 70 Hi Dragon Ball Z Shenron
description:

The Chuck 70's premium construction and thicker midsole give this collaboration a more elevated foundation compared to the standard All Star, while the Dragon Ball Z theming adds genuine anime fandom appeal throughout the design. Shenron's association with wish granting and legendary power gives this release deep symbolic resonance for fans of the franchise.

Dragon Ball Z has remained one of the most influential and beloved anime franchises worldwide, and collaborations tied to its most iconic characters consistently generate significant excitement among both anime fans and sneaker collectors. Shenron specifically holds legendary status within the franchise, often associated with the story's most dramatic and pivotal moments, giving this shoe genuine narrative weight beyond a simple character graphic. Fans of both Converse's Chuck 70 line and Dragon Ball Z find this release particularly compelling for how thoughtfully it translates the character's mythical presence into wearable sneaker design.

The Converse Chuck 70 Hi Dragon Ball Z Shenron was released on July 23, 2026 with a retail price of $100.
