title: Vans Old Skool 36 Harris Tweed Blue Multi
description:
The Vans Old Skool 36 Harris Tweed Blue Multi combines Scottish textile heritage with decorative details on a familiar skate silhouette. Its Harris Tweed upper uses virgin wool dyed and spun in the Outer Hebrides, bringing a textured surface to the blue based colorway. Jewels, pins, and studs introduce contrasting accents that give the traditional fabric an unexpected setting.

Contrast stitching and a lightly greased finish add to the shoe’s deliberately worn appearance. The signature Sidestripe remains visible within the composition, preserving the Old Skool identity beneath the embellishments. A padded collar and Sola Foam ADC insole provide comfort, while vulcanized construction, glossy sidewalls, and the waffle outsole maintain recognizable Vans features underfoot.

For collectors, the attraction is the combination of wool texture and hardware, with different details becoming apparent as the shoe is viewed from each side. The Blue Multi palette connects those elements without losing the fabric’s character. Released on September 24, 2026, the Vans Old Skool 36 Harris Tweed Blue Multi retailed for $140.

title: Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Asphalt
description:
The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir in Asphalt is a June 2026 release of the Old Skool 36 LX — Vans' luxury-positioned premium tier of the Old Skool silhouette that applies upgraded materials, construction specifications, and design details above the standard Old Skool's core canvas and suede construction — in an Asphalt colorway that applies the dark, slightly warm grey of pavement to the LX format's premium material palette, creating the most urban and most street-contextually grounded expression of the Souvenir design concept. The Old Skool 36 LX designation combines the model's 36th anniversary lineage with the LX (Luxury) premium specification that Vans applies to its most elevated material expressions of heritage silhouettes, with the LX format typically featuring premium suede, leather, or textile combinations and refined construction details that distinguish it from the standard Old Skool's everyday construction. The Souvenir concept adds a travel and memory-referential dimension to the Asphalt LX, suggesting a shoe that commemorates a specific place, moment, or cultural reference with the kind of collector-specific meaning that makes souvenir objects among the most emotionally charged and most personally significant items in collections. Released June 25, 2026 at $125 retail through Vans and authorized lifestyle footwear retailers globally.

The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Asphalt was released on June 25, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

title: Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Warm Brown
description:
The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Warm Brown brings refined craftsmanship to a timeless silhouette, pairing the iconic side stripe with a rich, earth-toned palette that complements everything from raw denim to tailored joggers. The supple, warm brown upper highlights classic Old Skool lines, while subtle textural contrasts and precise stitching underscore the 36 LX’s premium build. A cushioned collar and supportive footbed deliver day-long comfort, and the reinforced toe area adds durability for daily wear. Underfoot, the signature waffle outsole ensures confident traction and that unmistakable board-ready feel, rounding out a sneaker that balances heritage styling with modern comfort.

Designed for versatility, this Vans staple transitions effortlessly from casual weekends to creative workspaces. The low-profile shape and clean proportions make it easy to dress up or down, while the Souvenir Warm Brown colorway taps into a vintage-inspired mood that feels fresh and elevated. Style ID VN000D9RENB and the July 2025 release align this pair with the latest Vans lineup, making it a smart pick for collectors and minimalists alike. Whether you’re building a capsule wardrobe or refreshing your rotation, the Old Skool 36 LX offers a polished, go-anywhere look backed by dependable materials and a time-honored construction.

Our team thinks this product is great for adding a sophisticated, wear-with-anything brown hue to your lineup while delivering the comfort, grip, and durability that make Vans a perennial favorite.

title: Vans Old Skool Black White
description:
If you are looking for a staple pair of black and white Vans for your rotation, the Vans Old Skool Black White is a popular choice. It arrives with a low-top black canvas upper with white leather Vans stripe detailing on lateral and medial sides. At the base, a white and gum waffle cup sole with a red, branded heel patch adds the finishing touch.

This model of the Vans Old Skool Black White released in 2017 and retailed for $70.

title: Vans Old Skool Travis Barker Dues Paid White
description:
The Vans Old Skool Travis Barker Dues Paid in White features a pre-scuffed white canvas upper with black stains smearing across the toe box, eyestays, laces, side panels, and entire heel, with the classic Old Skool's black side stripe, padded collar, metal top eyelets, and waffle outsole all present in the vintage design. Half of "Dues" and "Paid" wraps across each toe box in black Gothic font, tied together by black barbed wire along the midsole foxing, with "Trials" and "Verder" written across the heels and the insoles branded with both Vans and Travis Barker's names. A translucent crystal rubber waffle sole reveals a hidden graphic of the "Self Made" tattoo inked on Barker's hands peeking through the bottom, a detail that connects the shoe directly to the Blink-182 drummer's personal tattoo identity throughout the design. The White version reverses the color blocking of the initial Fall 2025 Black collaboration, carrying over all the main hallmarks of the first drop on a white foundation that gives every detail more contrast against the lighter backdrop.

Released June 18, 2026 at $85 retail through Vans and Journeys with style code VN000E9TCJ7.

The Vans Old Skool Travis Barker Dues Paid White was released on June 18, 2026 with a retail price of $85.

title: Vans Old Skool V KPop Demon Hunters Black Purple (PS)
description:
The Vans Old Skool V KPop Demon Hunters Black Purple PS brings playful energy and pop culture flair to a kids friendly version of the Old Skool. The black and purple palette feels bold and fun, while the KPop Demon Hunters theme adds character driven excitement that resonates with younger fans. The hook and loop closure keeps it practical and easy to wear.

Fans love this release because it blends style and accessibility. The design feels expressive without being overwhelming, making it exciting for kids while still recognizable as a Vans classic. Collectors appreciate Vans’ ability to adapt core silhouettes for different audiences, creating themed releases that feel thoughtful rather than purely novelty driven.

The Vans Old Skool V KPop Demon Hunters Black Purple PS was released on December 8, 2025 with a retail price of $55.

title: Vans Old Skool Triple Black
description: The Vans Old Skool Triple Black is a classic sneaker that has been updated with a sleek and modern design. The shoe features a black canvas upper with black suede overlays, giving it a monochromatic look that is both stylish and versatile. The iconic Vans side stripe is also black, adding to the shoe's understated aesthetic. Released on January 1st, 2019, the Vans Old Skool Triple Black is a must-have for any sneakerhead looking for a timeless and versatile shoe. The retail price of $70 makes it an affordable option for those looking to add a classic sneaker to their collection. The shoe is made with high-quality materials, including a durable canvas upper and a rubber sole that provides excellent traction and support. The cushioned footbed ensures all-day comfort, making it perfect for everyday wear. Something we love about the Vans Old Skool Triple Black is its ability to complement any outfit, from casual to dressy. Our experts think the best features of the shoe are its sleek design, durable materials, and comfortable fit. The standout feature of the Vans Old Skool Triple Black is its monochromatic colorway, which gives it a modern and sophisticated look. Our experts especially love how versatile the shoe is, making it a great addition to any sneaker collection.

title: Vans Old Skool Anderson .Paak Soulito
description:
Vans revealed Anderson .Paak was becoming the brand's first official global music ambassador in 2020. They followed up this announcement by introducing a collaborative capsule collection that included the Vans Old Skool Anderson .Paak Soulito sneaker.

This Vans x Anderson .Paak sneaker takes the iconic Old Skool silhouette and turns it on its head. It has a lavender upper constructed out of soft corduroy with wide wales situated on the toe and heel. It also features white leather stripes on the side panels of the sneaker, and it has a bright green waffle outsole on it that delivers a loud pop of color while providing superior traction at the same time.

The thing our experts like best about this Vans x Anderson .Paak sneaker, though, is the "Yes Lawd" printed on the inside of the shoe's heels. It's a nod to the album .Paak put out with producer Knxwledge in 2016 when they got together to form the duo NxWorries. The Vans Old Skool Anderson .Paak Soulito was released on December 11, 2020, and retailed for $90.

title: Vans Old Skool Navy White
description:
The Vans Old Skool sneaker is one of the shoes that helped put Vans on the map back in the 1970s. To celebrate this, Vans has continuously released new Old Skool colorways over the years, including the Vans Old Skool Navy White.

Like other Vans Old Skool options, this one featured a low-top design and an upper that had a mixture of suede and canvas. It also included a blend of navy blue and black along with Vans' iconic white Sidestripe. Additionally, it had everything from reinforced toe caps and padded collars to a lace-up closure and Vans' patented rubber waffle outsoles.

All of this kept this Vans Old Skool looking similar to many of the Old Skools that came before it, but that became what we loved about it so much. It stayed true to the original Vans vision by paying tribute to what has worked for the Old Skool for so many years now. The Vans Old Skool Navy White was released on January 1, 2000, and retailed for $70.

Vans Old Skool 36 Shoyroll Natural
Vans Old Skool KPop Demon Hunters Saja Boys
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Patent Chicago (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Patent Chicago (W) for women arrives in the classic Chicago Bulls colorway.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Patent Chicago (W) features a white and black leather base with red patent leather overlays at the forefoot and collar. The black continues to the toe box, heel counter, Swoosh, ankle collar, and Win(GS) for grade schoolers logo. The tongue tag features Zoom Air branding with a small pull-tab, while underfoot, a sail midsole featuring a Zoom Air unit and a red outsole finish off the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Patent Chicago (W) was released in February 2022 and retailed for $140.

title: Jordan 1 High Method Of Make Archaeo Brown (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Method Of Make Archaeo Brown delivers a premium and material focused take on the classic silhouette through a rich and layered color palette. Archaeo brown dominates the upper, while cacao wow and baroque brown tones add depth and variation across the design. The overall look feels refined and textured, emphasizing craftsmanship.

Fans of the Method Of Make series appreciate how it elevates the Jordan 1 through subtle material upgrades and tonal execution. The earthy palette gives it a mature and versatile feel. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage design with a focus on detail and modern refinement.

The Air Jordan 1 High Method Of Make Archaeo Brown was released on September 20, 2024 with a retail price of $155.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Anthracite
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Red Aqua Gold boasts a multicolor look with a leather, Durabuck, suede and denim composition. Hits of white, red, gold, aqua, and black deliver a broad palette. Similar to other colorways in the Jordan 1 Zoom Air CMFT collection, an inset Swoosh, a tongue with exposed foam edges, and a Zoom Air sole complete the design.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Red Aqua Gold released in May of 2022 and retailed for $140.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Crater Purple
description:
Launched by Jordan Brand in April 2022, Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Crater Purple became one of Air Jordan 1 Zoom CMFT offerings.

Compared to the Jordan 1, Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Crater Purple’s main difference is the sole’s full-length Zoom unit. The Zoom unit promotes comfort by ensuring a softer and more responsive cushioning. Its design features a white leather base with an overlaying purple and cut-out swooshes. It further features; Zoom Air branded tongues, black wings, a rubber outsole on top of a Nike speckled white midsole, and collars.

 On its release date, Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Crater Purple retailed at $140. DISCLAIMER: Purple may bleed onto white canvas when exposed to water.

title: Jordan 1 High Method Of Make Pink Oxford (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Pumpkin Spice
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Pumpkin Spice introduces autumnal colors in an updated version of the sneaker icon.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Pumpkin Spice is constructed on a Black suede base contrasted by a light shade of Orange suede overlays, with a darker shade of Orange introduced on the mesh collars and trim outsole. A cut-out Swoosh reveals a crisp white underlay, while a retro win(GS) for grade schoolers logo is stamped in black on the lateral collar flap. A Zoom Air unit delivers responsive cushioning underfoot.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Pumpkin Spice was released in January 2022 and retailed for $140.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Hare
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Hare is a high-top sneaker that takes after the "Hare" colorway from the Air Jordan 7.

This shoe’s upper is crafted using a mix of gray suede and white leather overlays. It boasts a deconstructed tongue that takes after the AJ7 tongue, white laces, a white midsole, and a red outsole. The sneaker also features white Swooshes on the lateral sides, a red Jordan Wings logo on the ankle flap, and a red Zoom Air logo on a black tongue tag.

The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Hare was released on August 10, 2022. Originally, it retailed at $140.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Particle Grey
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Particle Grey takes a classic silhouette and enhances the comfort, makes the aesthetic eclectic, and dresses it all in a subtle colorway.

The Particle Grey iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Zoom Air High-Top CMFT 2 features pale grayish textile on the side panel and perforated toe box. White mesh forms the collar, and the signature side-panel Nike Swoosh appears as dark gray mesh in a cutout window. Darker gray suede overlays the toe cap, eye stays, vamp, collar, and heel counter. Perforations also appear on the inside quarter panel and overlays. Zoom Air branding graces the tongue tag and insole. A white Wings logo adorns the lateral collar, completing the look of this upper.

But what we enjoy most about this sneaker is the sail midsole, which houses a Zoom Air unit for ultimate comfort. The heel of the gray and white rubber outsole features a cutout window through which you can see Zoom Air branding. The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Particle Grey was released on September 19, 2023, for $150 retail.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's)
description:
The Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's) Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 made its stellar debut on June 1, 2023. A collaborative masterpiece between the multi-talented Teyana Taylor and Jordan brand, this sneaker is a vibrant representation of her Harlem roots.

Equipped with a Zoom Air unit, these sneakers don't just boast of style, they provide unbeatable comfort too. These kicks are an emblem of Harlem's strength and resilience.

The Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's) Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 retailed at a price of $150 on June 1,2023.
secondary_title: Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's)

title: Jordan 1 High FlyEase Bred White Toe (GS)
description:
The Jordan 1 High FlyEase Bred White Toe (GS) takes the classic Peter Moore silhouette, infuses it with Tobie Hatfield's easy entry design, and then dresses it in a colorway inspired by the Chicago Bulls.

The upper of the Bred White Toe (GS) Jordan 1 High FlyEase is crafted from tumbled black leather on the side panel and padded collar. That same tumbled black leather forms the overlays on the toe cap, vamp, and eyestays. Tumbled red leather forms the collar and heel overlays, as well as the side-panel Nike Swoosh, which is outlined in red embroidery. A hook and loop strap in red leather closes over the ankle and is stamped with a black Wings logo. The lone hit of white on the upper is the perforated smooth leather toe box. This matches the white foam midsole that contains air within and rides on a red rubber outsole.

Our favorite detail of this shoe is the black zipper with a red tab that runs from the heel to the eyestays for an added element of lockdown fit. The Jordan 1 High FlyEase Bred White Toe (GS) was released on November 1, 2019, for $100 retail.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Blackened Blue
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Blackened Blue is a high-top basketball shoe. It is made of a blend of leather, mesh, and suede. The design includes many retro features from the original Air Jordans released in the mid-1980s. This consists of the Air Jordan's wing logo and micro-perforations on the toe.

The Swoosh is on its sidewall for branding, and the Zoom Air label is on the shoe's tongue. A rubber outsole makes for good traction. Midsole cushioning with Air technology and a padded collar gives you quality foot and ankle support with every move.

The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Blackened Blue has a multicolor scheme of black, dark blue, warm beige, and coconut milk. Our team is most impressed with the suede accents, which give this shoe a more premium look. Nike released this basketball sneaker on May 10, 2023. It originally retailed for $150.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT PSG Paris Saint-Germain
description:
Jordan Brand and French professional soccer club Paris Saint-Germain teamed up once again to collaborate on the Jordan 1 Zoom Air CMFT High. The two entities have made their collaborative efforts consistent since first releasing the Jordan 5 PSG in 2018. Following that, Jordan 6 and Jordan 4 models were stamped with the PSG insignia, leading to a fresh spin on the Jordan 1.

The Jordan 1 Zoom Air CMFT Paris Saint-Germain features an off-white and black Durabuck upper with a reflective iridescent cut-out Swoosh located on each lateral side. A purple and pink gradient textile wraps the ankle, with a similar gradient filling in the Wings logo on the ankle. An iridescent Jordan PSG motif is placed on the back heel, similar to previous collaborative designs. Raw-cut construction around the ankle exposes its purple foam cushioning. Lastly, a white midsole and black outsole complete the design in traditional Jordan 1 fashion.

The Air Jordan 1 Zoom PSG released in February of 2021 and retailed for $140.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom CMFT Bred (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 High Zoom CMFT Bred (Women's) arrives in a black and University Red-white color scheme.

The Bred Jordan 1 High Zoom CMFT (Women's) has an upper featuring a mix of materials, including leather and textile, providing durability. The shoe features Zoom Air technology in the midsole, providing cushioning and responsiveness. The shoe's padded collar offers comfort and support. The sneaker also features a lace-up closure system for a secure fit. The shoe has a toe box with perforations for breathability. The signature Air Jordan Wings logo is displayed on the collar, and the Nike Swoosh logo is featured on the lateral sides. The shoe's design is completed with a "ZOOM Swoosh Air" inscription on the tongue.

What we love about the Jordan 1 High Zoom CMFT Bred (Women's) is its combination of iconic design and modern comfort technology. The shoe features a premium leather upper with classic color blocking, staying true to the original Jordan 1 silhouette. The women’s rendition of the sneaker was released to the public on November 11th, 2021, and sold for a retail price of $140.

title: Jordan 1 High FlyEase Black White (GS)
description:
The Jordan 1 High FlyEase Black White (GS) is a sneaker for grade schoolers with a high-top and a sleek colorway.

The Black White (GS) Jordan 1 High FlyEase has a leather upper in black and white. White forms the perforated toe box, the heel counter, and the ankle strap, while black forms the sides, the toe cap, and the eyestays. The Nike swoosh appears in white on each side, and the Air Jordan logo can be found in black on the ankle strap. The ankle strap is Velcro for an adjustable fit. In addition, the laces don’t need to be tied— there is a zip closure that goes down and around the heel. The shoe sits on a white midsole and a black outsole.

What we love most about this sneaker is the colorway, which gives the shoe a clean and elegant look. The Jordan 1 High FlyEase Black White (GS) was released on July 20, 2021, for $100.

title: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Black Fire Red Cement
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Black Fire Red Cement is a high-top silhouette in a black, fire red, cement grey, and white color palette.

The ‘Black Fire Red Cement’ Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 has a leather upper, offering longevity. The sneaker has the signature Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the collar. Furthermore, the sneaker features additional branding details such as the "ZOOM Swoosh AIR" inscription on the tongue and the Nike Swoosh on the sides. The shoe also features Zoom Air technology in the midsole, offering responsive cushioning and support. The shoe is finished off with a rubber outsole for traction and sturdiness, ensuring stability.

The most distinctive feature of this shoe lies in the intriguing cement grey splatter pattern that elegantly drapes over the midsole and extends to the outsole, creating a bold look. The Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Black Fire Red Cement was released on March 1, 2023, and sold at an initial price of $150.

title: Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's)
description:
The women's Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's) features a white leather upper with Wolf Grey Durabuck overlays and Swooshes. From there, a Jordan Wings logo on the heel and a translucent outsole adds the finishing touch.

The women's Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's) released in July of 2021 and retailed for $100.

title: Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked Varsity Red White Black
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked Chicago brings one of the most iconic colorways in sneaker history onto the course, blending performance functionality with undeniable heritage. The varsity red, black, and white palette instantly calls back to the original Chicago look, while the spiked outsole adapts the silhouette for traction and stability during play. It keeps the familiar low top shape intact, making it recognizable from any angle.

What makes this pair stand out is how it bridges two worlds. Golf footwear rarely carries this level of cultural weight, and incorporating the Chicago colorway adds a layer of storytelling that goes beyond performance. For collectors and players alike, it offers a chance to wear something rooted in basketball history while stepping into a completely different environment.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked Chicago was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

title: Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink translates one of the most iconic silhouettes into a performance driven format without losing its cultural weight. The white base keeps the look clean and familiar, while fir and elemental pink accents introduce subtle contrast that gives the shoe a fresh personality on and off the course. The low cut shape stays true to the original design, maintaining the visual DNA that has defined the Air Jordan 1 for decades.

Golf adaptations of classic Jordans continue to gain traction because they merge sport function with lifestyle credibility. This pair captures that balance, offering something that feels just as relevant in casual settings as it does in play. For collectors, it represents the ongoing expansion of Jordan Brand into new spaces while still honoring the legacy that made the silhouette iconic.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens brings high shine attitude to a timeless color combination. Glossy patent leather defines the upper, giving varsity red and black a bold and confident finish that immediately stands out. White details break up the contrast, keeping the look balanced while letting the material choice carry the visual impact. The low profile shape keeps it sleek and expressive.

This version appeals to fans who enjoy classic Jordan colorways with a fashion forward edge. The patent treatment adds drama and texture, transforming a familiar palette into something more statement driven. Collectors appreciate how the shine shifts the energy of the shoe without altering its core identity, making it feel special while remaining unmistakably Jordan. It is a pair that feels made for nights out as much as everyday rotation.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe (GS)
description:
The grade school Air Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe GS mimics the color scheme of its predecessor, the Air Jordan 1 Bred Toe. It features amazing details like a puffy black nylon tongue, a large Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the heel, and a white Jumpman logo. Additionally, it features an enhanced red outsole and a cushioned white midsole.

The grade school Air Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe GS was released on 8th December 2021. It retailed at $75.

title: Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings draws inspiration from the earliest chapters of Jordan Brand history through a clean and symbolic color story. Summit white covers nearly the entire upper, creating a crisp and uniform look, while varsity red accents add a subtle nod to the origins of the Jordan legacy. The low profile keeps the presentation modern and accessible.

Fans appreciate this release for its meaning rather than flash. The New Beginnings theme speaks to heritage, growth, and legacy, making it appealing to collectors who value storytelling. It feels ceremonial yet wearable, offering a sense of history without relying on heavy contrast or complex detailing. This pair reflects the idea that sometimes the strongest statements come from restraint and intention rather than excess.

The Air Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

title: Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue offers a cooler toned take on the classic low top silhouette, using a mix of deep navy and bright university blue to create contrast across the upper. The color blocking feels familiar but refreshed, giving the shoe a clean and versatile look that still carries enough personality to stand out. The white base helps balance the darker tones, keeping the overall design sharp.

Jordan 1 Low releases continue to resonate because of their ability to adapt through color rather than structure. This pair leans into that approach, offering a palette that feels both easy to wear and visually engaging. Fans of the silhouette appreciate how small changes like this can create a completely different mood while still staying true to the original design.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

title: Jordan 1 Low Black University Blue
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Black University Blue arrives in a low-top silhouette with a traditional lace closure, with a Reversed Black and University Blue color combination in honor of the University of North Carolina – the alma mater of Michael Jordan.

In this iteration, the classic Black University Blue Jordan 1Low color scheme is reimagined with a distinctive twist. The iconic UNC blue takes center stage as the predominant color, encompassing the shoe's foundation, mesh tongues, ankle collar, Swoosh emblem, and heel branding. Contrasting panels of black leather add emphasis, while the laces and inner mesh lining harmonize in the timeless black shade. The Wings logo is meticulously stitched in black on the heel, while the tongue and insole get the Jumpman logo. To round off the design, the shoe is perched atop a white midsole, with a University Blue rubber outsole for a sleek and unified appearance.

What our experts love about the Jordan 1 Low Black University Blue its low-top silhouette. The low-top silhouette provides wearers with greater freedom of movement and a style that effortlessly transitions from the court to everyday streetwear. The sneaker debuted for $110 on August 1st, 2023.

title: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda
description:
The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda reimagines an iconic basketball shoe into cleats meant for football players. The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat is a men's shoe where the TD stands not for toddler, but for "touchdown."

The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat in a white and black "Panda" colorway features an upper of white tumbled leather with toebox perforations and black tumbled leather overlays. The side panel Nike Swoosh, collar, and eyestays are also tumbled black leather. The tongue is white with a black patch that features a white Jumpman logo. The laces, sock liner, and insole are also black.

What our experts appreciate most about this shoe is the gridiron construction of the outsole, with the studs placed wide apart for flexibility and traction on the football field. The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda was released on June 7, 2023, for a retail price of $140.

title: Jordan 1 Low Golf White Light Pumice
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Golf White Light Pumice brings the familiar Air Jordan 1 design to the golf course with a soft, contrasting color palette. White and Light Pumice form the foundation, while Pink Glow and Sequoia add accent colors. Genuine leather construction preserves the sneaker’s classic appearance, and the Wings logo at the heel maintains a recognizable connection to Jordan’s basketball heritage.

Encapsulated Air cushioning in the heel supports each step, while the integrated traction pattern adapts the original outsole concept for golf. A forefoot pivot circle contributes to the course-focused construction, giving the shoe practical features beneath its familiar styling. For golfers who collect Jordans, the appeal comes from bringing an established sneaker identity into their playing rotation. The lighter palette pairs naturally with neutral golf trousers and shorts, offering a coordinated option from the opening tee shot through the final green.

Released on April 1, 2026, the Jordan 1 Low Golf White Light Pumice retailed for $155.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Elephant Black (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 Low SEPatent Elephant Black (Women's) is a sophisticated, high-fashion sneaker for fun and dressy wear.  It is all-black, made of high-quality leather, and accented with a patterned and textured patent leather material for an elegant touch.

Of course, the shoe is made extra special with various Nike and Jordan logos, such as the Jordan Flight logo on the outer tongue and the Swoosh symbol on the side of the shoe. Perforations on the toe cap and sides give this sneaker enhanced breathability, and Nike Air technology provides the shoe with extra cushioning for better comfort and support throughout the day.

The Jordan 1 Low SEPatent Elephant Black (Women's) is a laced sneaker with black laces for a classic sneaker look. Our team is most impressed with the placement of the white Wings Air Jordan logo on the shoe's heel. Nike released this shoe on July 1, 2024. It originally retailed for $125.

title: Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred
description:
The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred has the same legendary durability and functionality features of Michael Jordan's first signature sneaker but with a low-cut design. They come with a unique and robust construction that makes them perfect for the office or the court.

The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred features a white Air midsole, ideal for both the court and the street. It also arrives with Swoosh logos that run across the sides, while the wings and Jumpman logo are featured at the heel and tongue, respectively. The side panels and toe come with black micro-perforated leather, while red leather covers the overlays. Padding at the ankle enhances the shoe's functionality and comfort.

The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred was released in September of 2020 for $90.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown
description:
As part of the Method of Make series, the Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown reimagines the AJ1 Low using premium materials and a contemporary color scheme. It boasts neutrals, including Sail, Legend Light Brown, Archaeo Brown, and Neutral Grey.

Creating a sophisticated feel, the base is constructed from leather in Sail, while the suede overlays at the heel and forefoot come in Legend Light Brown. The eyelets, the signature Swoosh logo, the Jumpman logo, and the Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the heel showcase soft Archaeo Brown. The minimalist branding on the tongue contributes to the sneaker’s premium appearance, while the perforations on the toebox allow the foot to breathe.

Our experts at StockX like the midsole’s off-white hue. Here, encapsulated Air units provide responsive cushioning without adding a distracting design detail. The Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown was released on July 18, 2024, and sold for $125.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail leans into outdoor inspired tones to give the Jordan 1 Low a rugged yet refined personality. Medium olive dominates the upper with a grounded feel, while sail accents soften the look and keep it versatile. title: Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Grey Cool Grey White
description:
The Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Grey Cool Grey White blends white leather uppers with Medium Grey patent overlays on the heel and collar, plus Cool Grey nubuck at the toe and forefoot. It is set on a white Air-sole midsole and translucent rubber outsole.

The Medium Grey Cool Grey White 1 Low SE by Jordan applies smooth white leather across the quarter, lace placket, and heel counter. Medium grey patent leather wraps around the heel, collar, and Swoosh, and the perforated toe box and forefoot panels are a subtle cool grey. Underfoot, there's Air-sole cushioning in a white foam midsole paired with a semi-translucent outsole that has pivot and herringbone grip zones.

One of the things we love about the Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Grey Cool Grey White is its layered leather and nubuck upper for structure and airflow. We also value the Air-sole unit for consistent cushioning without changing the low-profile design. It retailed at $125 when released on December 20, 2024.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Laser Palomino
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Laser Palomino brings the same distinctive laser detailing technique into the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette, combining phantom, university red, palomino, and sail into a warm, richly layered palette. The Jordan 3's signature elephant print detailing remains intact, now enhanced through this laser treatment that adds genuine textural depth and technical craftsmanship to the design. Palomino as a dominant tone gives this release an earthy, sophisticated quality distinct from more traditional Jordan 3 color stories.

The Jordan 3 holds legendary status within sneaker history, and applying this laser detailing technique gives the silhouette a genuinely fresh technical treatment beyond its classic elephant print texture. This warm, palomino based palette offers a distinctive alternative to the model's more common bold primary color releases, appealing to collectors who want a sophisticated, earth toned take on this iconic shape. Fans of both the Jordan 3's storied history and innovative material techniques find this Laser Palomino release a compelling way to experience the silhouette through fresh technical craftsmanship.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Laser Palomino was released on August 22, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Sports Renaissance (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Sports Renaissance Womens brings a bold, athletic inspired concept into the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette, combining obsidian, track red, blue beyond, and chalk into a genuinely dynamic, multi sport color story built specifically in women's sizing. The Sports Renaissance naming suggests a celebration of athletic revival and cross sport inspiration, giving this release conceptual depth beyond a standard colorway. The Jordan 3's signature elephant print detailing remains intact, giving this women's specific release the same authentic construction found in the silhouette's most celebrated versions.

The Jordan 3 holds legendary status within sneaker history, and this Sports Renaissance concept gives collectors a fresh, dynamically colored way to engage with one of the line's most respected silhouettes. Obsidian and track red together create striking contrast, while blue beyond and chalk add additional depth and dimension to the overall design. Fans of both the Jordan 3's storied history and bold, athletically inspired colorways find this women's specific release a compelling way to experience the silhouette through fresh creative direction.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Sports Renaissance Womens was released on August 15, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red (2022)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red 2022 brings back an OG colorway from the year 1988.

The top section of the Retro Fire Red is crafted from white leather with elephant print overlays done in dark gray at the heel and forefoot. The model also features contrasting fire red accents on the midsole, eyelets, and perforated leather collar. An airsole is nestled underfoot in the heel section, and the sneaker gets a fire red Jumpman on the tongue and a Nike Air logo on the heel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red 2022 was released on the 10th of September 2022 and initially retailed for $210.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0 blends basketball heritage with Korean pride in one unforgettable silhouette. A sequel to the ultra-limited 2018 edition, this pair pays homage to South Korea’s cultural iconography and the 1988 Seoul Summer Olympics. It returns with a crisp white leather upper, suede elephant print panels, and bold accents of sport royal and challenge red inspired by the Taegukgi flag.

Jordan Brand added subtle upgrades to set the 2.0 version apart: quilted blue collars, aged yellow midsoles, and the reversal of the original embroidery across the tongues. These thoughtful tweaks make the sneaker feel both fresh and reverent to its roots. It’s a refined evolution of a beloved design that merges MJ’s legacy with Korean flair.

The Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0 was released on May 15, 2025, for a retail price of $200. Done in white, black, sport royal, challenge red, pale vanilla, and college grey, it captures the spirit of Seoul and the DNA of an all-time classic.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS) is a relaunch of Tinker Hatfield’s iconic sneaker with gray elephant-print detailing and an eye-catching colorway of black, Fire Red, Cement Grey, and Sail.

Originally released in 1988 and last seen in 2013, the Black Cement (2024) (GS) Jordan 3 Retro boasts a tumbled leather upper in black with tonal stitching. Elephant print decorates the leather overlays at the forefoot and heel, while perforations add texture to the gray leather around the collar. Pops of Fire Red stand out on the Jumpman logo, the first three eyelets, the bottom of the shoe, and the underside of the tongue. Padding in the tongue and collar completes the look and protects the ankle.

Our experts like the tonal contrast provided by the raised, white Nike Air logo on the heel. The grade school-sized Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS) was released on November 23, 2024, and sold for $150.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair (GS)
description:

The Jordan 3’s iconic shape provides a strong foundation, while the Family Affair theme adds emotional depth through thoughtful color choices and restrained detailing. It feels personal and celebratory without losing the confidence that defines the model.

Collectors appreciate this release because it highlights the Jordan 3’s ability to carry meaning beyond performance. In grade school sizing, the design still feels complete and intentional, offering younger fans a connection to Jordan storytelling rooted in relationships and heritage. It stands as a reminder that some of the most powerful releases are the ones that speak quietly but clearly.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair GS was released on 10/25/2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Indigo
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Indigo brings two iconic American brands together through a thoughtful blend of denim heritage and classic basketball silhouette. This collaboration dresses the 3 in rich denim panels that replace the traditional leather upper, giving the sneaker texture and character rooted in Levi’s legacy. Subtle black and sail accents balance the design, while the familiar Jordan 3 shape keeps it rooted in streetwear culture.

What truly sets this edition apart is the way Levi’s DNA is woven into every detail. The classic red Levi’s tab sits proudly on the lateral side, signaling authentic denim lineage, and a co-branded Jordan x Levi’s hangtag adds collectible appeal straight out of the box. Inside, custom insoles printed with Levi’s denim motifs give a nod to the material’s cultural history, melding fashion and sneaker worlds in a way that feels natural and purposeful.

When the Air Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Indigo released, it retailed for $230 and dropped on February 25, 2026. With its standout denim materials, heritage branding details, and co-branded accents, this collaboration stands as one of 2026’s most talked-about takes on a timeless silhouette.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Cement Grey
description:
Introducing the Air Jordan 3 Retro Cement Grey as the latest fresh take on a legendary sneaker that has been a staple in the Jordan lineup since its debut in 1988. ​​
