The 2016 Jordan 11 Space Jam marks the third time that this iconic shoe and immensely popular colorway hit retail shelves. The Black, Dark Concord and White colorway received the Space Jam nickname due to the product placement in Space Jam the movie that released in 1996. With 2016 being the 20th anniversary and the rumors of LeBron James playing a role, the Jordan 11 Space Jam captures the spotlight once again with a retro release. After early speculations had the colors and shape of the silhouette slightly off, official images seem to have a majority of sneakerheads anticipating this release. If pre-release action is any indicator, the 2016 Air Jordan 11 Space Jam is one of the biggest release.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) (GS) brings one of the most talked-about holiday colorways down to grade school sizing with its sleek palette and head-turning contrast. Set on a black upper with glossy patent leather wrapping the sides, the pair pops with gamma blue branding and varsity maize details on the Jumpman and heel. Borrowed from the beloved adult release, this junior version carries the same bold visual energy in a smaller package.

Originally introduced in 2013, the "Gamma Blue" 11s quickly became a modern icon for the silhouette. The 2025 retro keeps that spirit alive, making this colorway as compelling now as it was over a decade ago. While not part of Michael Jordan’s on-court history, the look grew into its own lore among collectors and sneaker fans.

When the Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) (GS) released, it retailed for $190 and dropped on December 13, 2025. Tailored for young fans and collectors alike, this grade school edition captures the magic of a modern classic.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Jubilee 25th Anniversary
description:
In 2020, Jordan Brand celebrated 25 years of one of their most popular models, the Jordan 11. To commemorate the famed silhouette, Michael Jordan and Nike released the Jordan 11 Jubilee. The sneaker’s distinct colorway was inspired by original sketches from the designer of the 1995 sneaker, Tinker Hatfield.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee showcases everything Hatfield envisioned for the sneaker 25 years ago; a performance product that can be worn easily both on and off the court. Features such as the two types of leather on the upper with hits of metallic lettering and Jumpman emblem add luxe elements to the athletic sneaker. A white midsole and foggy translucent outsole deliver contrast to the black sneaker. Carbon fiber plating on the sole provides stability and power to the wearer’s feet on the court.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee 25th Anniversary released in December of 2020 for $220.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Space Jam Magic Ball (Women's)
Jordan 11 Retro Win Like 96
description: Please note: the Air Jordan 11 Retro Win Like ‘96 sneakers do not include 72 wins and a championship banner (sorry to rub it in Warriors fans). These 11s were part of a historic NBA season for one of the most historic players in the game. Needless to say they are a must own for any MJ fan. The shoe features a mix of patent leather, mesh, and Zoom Air cushioning, and was released in December of 2017 in a full family run of sizes.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) (GS) is a relaunch of Tinker Hatfield’s sleek basketball shoe from 1995. It features a white base with Legend Blue and black accents.

Originally launched in 1996 as the "Columbia" colorway, this Legend Blue, grade school–sized version of the Jordan 11 Retro features a leather and mesh construction. The shiny patent leather overlays come in clean white, showing off the sneaker’s rounded toe and aerodynamic shape. Legend Blue details can be found on the semi-translucent rubber outsole, the Jumpman logo embroidered on the heel, and the tongue tag. In terms of technology, a carbon fiber plate runs the full length of the shoe and a Zoom Air unit provides cushioning. The back tab and collar come in black, contrasting the light Legend Blue and white.

Our experts at StockX like the heritage detailing, including the number 23 on the back tab. The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) (GS) was released on December 14, 2024, and sold for $185.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Pearl (Women's)
description:
Air Jordan 11 Retro Grand Finale Womens delivers elegance and drama through one of the most refined silhouettes in Jordan Brand history. The Air Jordan 11 has always carried a sense of occasion, and the Grand Finale colorway leans into that legacy with a polished and elevated presence designed specifically with women in mind. It feels luxurious without being overstated, letting the silhouette’s natural grace take the lead.

Collectors appreciate how this release highlights the Jordan 11’s flowing shape and iconic construction. The color story feels intentional and celebratory, making the shoe feel like a closing statement rather than a routine drop. It resonates with fans who love Jordan releases that feel special and emotionally charged, reinforcing why the 11 remains one of the most beloved designs of all time.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Grand Finale Womens was released on11/26/2020 with a retail price of $225.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) (TD)
description:
Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue 2025 TD introduces one of the most iconic Jordan color stories to the smallest size range while keeping its bold personality intact. The contrast between deep black and vivid gamma blue gives the shoe a futuristic edge that instantly highlights the sleek Air Jordan 11 silhouette. Even in toddler sizing, the design feels confident and unmistakable.

For collectors, this release represents continuity across generations. The Gamma Blue story has long been associated with confidence and modern flair, and seeing it translated into TD form reinforces the timelessness of the design. It feels symbolic, connecting legacy colorways to new beginnings in a way that sneaker fans find especially meaningful.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue 2025 TD was released on 12/13/2025 with a retail price of $90.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low 72-10
description:
Jordan Brand honored Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls' historic 72 win 1995-1996 season with the Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10.

The Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10 boasts a black tumbled leather upper with a signature patent leather mudguard and woven lace loops. On the interior, an embroidered tongue tag that reads "Inspired by the most historic season led by the greatest player ever" tributes MJ's monumental accolade. From there, a semi-translucent sole with red and black carbon fiber detailing completes the design.

The Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10 released in May of 2022 and retailed for $190.

traits.name: Colorway
traits.value: Canyon Purple/Off Noir/Violet Dust/Medium Soft Pink

title: Jordan 11 Retro Mojave
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro "Mojave" (2025) brings the 11 silhouette into a new terrain. Dressed in canyon purple, off noir, violet dust, and medium soft pink, the suede-rich upper pulls inspiration from dusk-lit desert rock walls and Las Vegas night skies. Reflective piping, a tonal Jumpman, and gold carbon-fiber accents nod to the city lights and luxury of the Strip.

Showcased as part of the AJ11’s 30th-anniversary collection, this release isn’t just another re-run, it’s a themed reinterpretation rooted in place and mood. The choice of nubuck and texture over the usual patent leather gives it an unexpected edge, making the silhouette feel fresh and intentional rather than simply nostalgic.

When the Air Jordan 11 Retro "Mojave" (2025) released, it retailed for $250 and dropped on November 22, 2025 at ComplexCon. With striking purple tones and desert-inspired design, it’s one of those limited-region pieces that speaks to collectors and style-seekers alike.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garçons Homme Plus White
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garcons Homme Plus White continues this significant collaboration between Jordan Brand and Comme des Garcons Homme Plus, bringing the Jordan 11 into a clean white execution that offers a genuinely different visual presentation compared to the black version within this collaboration. Comme des Garcons Homme Plus represents the house's more experimental menswear line, giving this Jordan 11 partnership genuine artistic credibility beyond a standard retro colorway release. White gives the patent leather detailing and signature silhouette added visual clarity and sophistication.

Comme des Garcons Homme Plus specifically represents the house's more experimental, avant garde menswear output, giving this Jordan 11 collaboration genuine artistic credibility distinct from typical streetwear crossovers. White offers a fresh, contemporary alternative to the black version, appealing to collectors who want the collaboration's boundary pushing design sensibility through a brighter, more striking presentation. Fans of both Jordan Brand's storied silhouette history and Comme des Garcons' avant garde design philosophy find this White release a compelling companion piece to its black counterpart.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garcons Homme Plus White was released on September 5, 2026 with a retail price of $358.
secondary_title: Comme des Garçons Homme Plus White

title: Jordan 11 Low TD Black Anthracite Metallic Silver
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Low TD Cleat Patent Black takes one of the most iconic basketball silhouettes and adapts it for the field with a performance driven edge. The glossy black patent leather instantly stands out, wrapping the upper in that signature shine that made the Jordan 11 legendary, while the cleated outsole transforms it into something built for traction and movement. Metallic silver and anthracite accents add subtle contrast without taking away from the all black presence.

This version hits differently because it bridges sport and culture in a unique way. Seeing a Jordan 11 built for football creates a crossover moment that fans of both sports can appreciate. It carries the same visual impact as the original while introducing a new purpose, making it a standout option for athletes who want performance without giving up style.

The Air Jordan 11 Low TD Cleat Patent Black was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $195.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo (Women’s) refreshes a legendary silhouette with a crisp White/Igloo palette and sleek materials that turn heads from first wear. A glossy patent leather mudguard wraps the foot with signature AJ11 shine, balanced by breathable textile at the upper for day‑long comfort. Subtle pastel Igloo accents highlight the tongue branding and heel details, while an icy, slightly tinted translucent outsole frames the design with a cool, modern edge. Sitting low on the ankle for easy, everyday styling, this women’s colorway (style AH7860-103) delivers the clean, refined look that made the Air Jordan 11 a crossover icon, equally at home with athleisure, denim, or tailored streetwear. 

Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a supportive midsole work in tandem with a carbon-fiber shank plate to offer stability and court-inspired performance you can feel. Herringbone traction pods grip on a variety of surfaces, and the padded collar plus secure lacing give a locked‑in fit without sacrificing comfort. Launched June 7, 2025, the Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo blends heritage DNA with a fresh seasonal twist, making it a standout choice for collectors and style-driven wearers alike. From its polished contours to its luminous outsole and soft mint cues, this pair brings effortless versatility and instant polish to any rotation.

Our team loves this product because it pairs iconic AJ11 craftsmanship with a refined White/Igloo finish that elevates everyday outfits while delivering dependable comfort and support.

title: Nike Dunk Low SE Triple Black
description:
The Nike Dunk Low SE Triple Black delivers the Dunk Low in its most understated and versatile form, leaning fully into monochrome design. Every panel is blacked out, allowing the silhouette’s shape and construction to define the look. It feels stealthy, confident, and purpose driven, proving that the Dunk does not need contrast to make an impact.

Fans love this release because it works everywhere. The triple black execution makes it an easy choice for daily wear, while still carrying the cultural weight of the Dunk Low. Collectors appreciate it as a foundational piece, one that prioritizes wearability and longevity over momentary trends, making it a staple that stays relevant long after release.

The Nike Dunk Low SE Triple Black was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day in Fierce Purple, Blue Lagoon, and Sail is the first-ever Dunk Low Protro — applying the Protro concept Kobe coined to mean Performance Retro, historically used for his signature shoes, now extended to the Dunk Low as a lifestyle silhouette with ReactX foam insole upgrade — designed to honor the pivotal night in June 1996 when Kobe Bryant was selected 13th overall by the Charlotte Hornets and immediately traded to the Los Angeles Lakers, presented in the Hornets' teal and purple palette that defines this moment in basketball history. The Charlotte-coded colorway is executed through a white leather base giving way to glossy purple overlays and bright teal Blue Lagoon accents across the Swoosh, laces, and heel tab, with the teal Swoosh featuring a textured scale-like finish trimmed with gold adding a subtle Black Mamba reference, purple snakeskin-style overlays across the panels, a Sail midsole, and KOBE branding across the heel in multicolor embroidery splitting the name in Charlotte and Lakers colors to trace the draft night trade's geographic journey. The shoe released on June 26, 2026 alongside the Nike Kobe 4 Protro Draft Day Mystery Pack — a blind box of 14 colorways representing each team that passed on Kobe plus the Lakers — marking the 30th anniversary of the 1996 NBA Draft at which Kobe entered the league. Released June 26, 2026 at $145 retail through Nike SNKRS and select retailers globally with style code IM0586-500.

The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day was released on June 26, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

title: Nike Dunk Low Team Red
description:
Constructed of white and Team Red smooth leather, the Nike Dunk Low Team Red is an ode to the original look of the 1985 Nike Dunk Low. Nike embroideries on the heel tab and a woven tongue label arrive in a classic fashion. From there, a white and Team Red sole completes the design.

The Nike Dunk Low Team Red released in May of 2022 and retailed for $100. It was also re-released in 2023.

traits.name: Colorway
traits.value: Phantom/Midnight Navy/College Grey/Varsity Red/Lemon Drop/Dark Smoke Grey

title: Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom
description:
Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom taps into the darker, atmospheric side of the Dunk Low by drawing inspiration from the eerie tone that defines Stranger Things. The Phantom color story keeps things muted and moody, letting texture and contrast create tension rather than loud color. It feels cinematic, like a sneaker designed to mirror the slow burn suspense and nostalgia that made the series a cultural phenomenon.

Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it treats collaboration as storytelling rather than branding. The Dunk Low silhouette anchors the design in familiarity, while the Stranger Things influence adds emotional depth tied to late night episodes and eighties inspired dread. It feels intentional and immersive, appealing to fans who enjoy sneakers that capture a feeling rather than chase spectacle, making it a natural fit for displays rooted in pop culture crossover moments.

The Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom was released on 11/06/2025 with a retail price of $155.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull is here to celebrate Halloween in style, offering a spooky twist on the classic Dunk silhouette. This limited-edition sneaker features a cracked leather upper, with vibrant green hues emerging from beneath the black exterior, creating a dramatic contrast. An embossed black skull decorates the toe box, adding to the eerie theme, while the custom insole showcases a series of skull graphics for a chilling effect.

Designed with the same iconic Dunk Low shape, the Halloween Skull edition stands out for its bold design and attention to detail. The textured cracked leather gives the shoe a unique look, and the bright cactus and green curry accents make it a real eye-catcher. Whether you’re hitting the streets or attending a Halloween event, this sneaker is sure to turn heads with its striking visuals and Halloween-themed aesthetics.

Released on October 24, 2024, the Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull retailed for $140. With its vibrant colorway and limited-edition design, this sneaker is a must-have for sneakerheads looking to celebrate Halloween in style.

title: Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (Women's)
description:
The women's Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (W) is made of white leather with Photon Dust leather overlays and Swooshes. A woven Nike label on the tongue and embroidered Nike branding completes the design.

The women's Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (W) released in May of 2021 and retailed for $100.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Phantom
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Phantom leans fully into a tonal approach, using a monochromatic Phantom colorway to highlight the silhouette’s shape and construction. The uniform palette creates a clean and minimal look, allowing the paneling and structure to stand out without distraction. It feels simple but intentional, staying true to the Dunk’s roots.

Fans appreciate this version because it emphasizes versatility and ease of wear. The tonal execution makes it adaptable across different styles, while the classic Dunk build keeps it grounded in sneaker history. It is a reliable and refined take on a timeless model, appealing to those who value understated design.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Phantom was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins takes a classic sports shoe silhouette and dresses it in the iconic colors of the legendary NFL franchise.

The Miami Dolphins colorway of the Nike Dunk Low-Top sports a base of white leather with the signature perforations in the toe box for breathability. Overlays adorn the upper in iconic Miami Dolphin turquoise that matches the sock liner that's padded at the collar. The orange leather Nike swoosh matches the orange heel tab with white Nike branding. White Nike branding appears on the turquoise insole, while turquoise Nike branding adorns the white tongue tag.

What we enjoy most about this sneaker is the way the sole unit locks in the Miami Dolphins colors as well as the Nike Dunk dependability. A white foam midsole and turquoise rubber outsole provide impact absorption and traction for sports or everyday wear. The Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins was released on January 17, 2024, for a retail price of $115.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro NYC CBGB
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro NYC CBGB pays tribute to the legendary Manhattan music venue that served as the birthplace of punk rock and new wave from its opening in 1973 until its closure in 2006 due to a rent dispute, translating the gritty, poster-plastered interior and raw Bowery aesthetic of the club into a Metallic Silver, College Grey, Cave Stone, and Off Noir palette on the Dunk Low's standard leather and suede upper construction with torn and distressed material detailing that gives the shoe a deliberately worn-in character mirroring CBGB's weathered walls. CBGB logos appear on the tongue and heel, while Bleecker and Bowery street sign replicas are printed on the inner tongues as a location-specific detail referencing the exact corner at 315 Bowery where Hilly Kristal opened the club with the original intention of hosting country, bluegrass, and blues acts before the venue became the defining stage for the Ramones, Blondie, Talking Heads, Television, and the entire American punk and new wave movement. The Metallic Silver base is the most unusual and most venue-appropriate color choice for a Dunk Low, with the silver reading as both the backstage and stagelight steel-and-chrome aesthetic of the music club environment and connecting to the distressed, worn-metal visual language of rock and punk material culture that defined CBGB's physical identity across its three-decade run.

Released June 2, 2026 at $130 retail via SNKRS as a Quick Strike release with style code IB2258-001.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro NYC CBGB was released on June 2, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Dunk Low Gore-Tex Triple Black
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Triple Black reinforces the classic silhouette with all weather protection and a stealth driven finish. Dressed entirely in Black, the upper integrates Gore Tex construction to shield against rain while preserving the familiar Dunk paneling. The low cut profile and sturdy outsole remain true to its basketball heritage roots.

Triple black executions always deliver versatility, and pairing that with waterproof materials adds functional depth. The monochrome design keeps it sleek and adaptable for colder seasons, while the Gore Tex build enhances durability. It feels practical and understated, merging timeless Dunk style with everyday performance upgrades.

The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Triple Black was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant FC Barcelona Black Field Purple
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant FC Barcelona Black Field Purple brings Kobe Bryant's enduring legacy into the classic Dunk Low silhouette through Protro construction, combining black and field purple to celebrate one of world football's most storied and passionately supported clubs. This crossover ties Kobe's significant global basketball influence to FC Barcelona's massive international fanbase, giving collectors a genuinely meaningful way to celebrate both legacies simultaneously. The Protro construction gives this Dunk Low genuine premium detailing befitting the collaborative significance.

FC Barcelona holds legendary status within global football, celebrated for its rich history, iconic playing style, and massive passionate fanbase spanning continents, giving this crossover genuine international appeal. Kobe Bryant's global basketball influence extended well beyond American shores, making this collaboration a meaningful bridge between his legacy and international football culture. Fans of both Kobe's enduring basketball legacy and FC Barcelona's storied football history find this release a compelling, culturally significant addition to their collection.

The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant FC Barcelona Black Field Purple was released on September 4, 2026 with a retail price of $135.
secondary_title: Kobe Bryant FC Barcelona Black Field Purple

title: Nike Dunk Low Arizona State
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Arizona State takes on the college aesthetics and features an all-leather upper with a bordeaux base and yellow overlays.

This low-profile shoe also has a mesh tongue and sock liner in the same color-blocking design. Other details include yellow Swooshes, a lace-up closure system with bordeaux laces, a perforated toe box, and ‘NIKE’ branding on the heel tab, tongue tab, and insoles. The white midsole sits on a yellow rubber outsole that has a visible linear pattern for traction.

The Nike Dunk Low Arizona State was released on November 25th, 2022, with a retail price set at $100.

title: Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry
description:
Nike added a luxe twist to the Dunk Low with the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry. The Curry colorway first made its way onto the Nike Dunk Low in 1999 as part of the Nike CO.JP (Concept Japan) collection. Since then, there have been multiple Curry Dunk releases in Nike’s catalog, including the 2003 Nike Dunk High Premium Curry, 2010 Nike Dunk Low VNTG Dark Curry, and now, the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry.

The upper of the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry is composed of Sail hairy suede with Medium Curry overlays and a Bone-colored Swoosh. Nike branding is present on its traditional woven tongue tag and Medium Curry heel patch. A Sail nylon tongue, Sail midsole, and Medium Curry outsole complete this retro design.

The Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry released in March of 2021 and retailed for $110. The Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry shock dropped again in May of 2024 and retailed for $125.

title: Nike Dunk Low Shibuya Halloween
Nike Dunk Low SE Black Grey Gum
description:
The Nike Dunk Low SE Black Grey Gum is a low-top shoe with a color-blocking design made with a mix of materials. 
       
This iteration of the Nike Dunk Low SE has a base of dark Grey suede that forms the perforated toe box, the ankle area, and the sides. Black overlays form the toe cap, eyestays, and ankle strap that runs down around the heel. The Nike Swoosh adorns both sides as a white leather overlay, and the heel collar is white with embroidered black Nike branding. The tongue also contains a white Nike logo patch. The midsole is black, while the outsole is a classic gum rubber for traction. 

What stands out about this shoe is certainly the white Nike Swoosh on each side, which provides a nice contrast against the otherwise dark build. The Nike Dunk Low SE Black Grey Gum was released on January 6, 2025, for $125.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Pale Ivory
primary_title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B "Pale Ivory" brings effortless style and skate-focused function to a beloved silhouette. Dressed in a refined mix of Pale Ivory and Summit White with Copper Moon accents and black hits, this colorway balances clean neutrals with subtle contrast for versatile wear on and off the board. Premium suede and leather paneling provide a plush handfeel and long-lasting durability, while classic SB details, like the padded, mesh-backed tongue and supportive collar, lock in comfort for all-day sessions. Perforations at the toe help with breathability, and the Swoosh in Copper Moon adds a standout touch that catches light without overpowering the minimalist palette.

Performance is at the core of the Dunk Low Pro B, Style HJ0367-100. A responsive insole with Nike cushioning absorbs impact on landings, and the flexible cupsole delivers excellent boardfeel without sacrificing protection. The grippy rubber outsole, complete with the SB-modified tread pattern, bites into decks and pavement for reliable traction in varied conditions. Reinforced stitching in high-wear zones and a sturdy overlay at the ollie area extend the life of the shoe, while the classic Dunk profile makes it a go-to for streetwear rotation. Whether you’re stacking clips or keeping it casual, this May 31, 2025 release pairs modern comfort with timeless SB heritage.

Our team loves this product because it blends supple materials, dialed-in cushioning, and skate-ready traction with a crisp, everyday colorway that elevates any fit.
model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro White Gum
description:
Nike SB is launching into 2023 with the release of the Nike SB Dunk Gum Pack. Nike’s Gum Pack features the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro in White Gum and Black Gum colorways.

The Nike Sb Dunk Low Pro White Gum is constructed using premium tumbled leather across the uppers, and black nubuck swooshes. The sneakers sit on top of a gum colored outsole, and feature black Nike branding on the heel, tongue, and insoles.
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro White Gum released March 1, 2023, with a retail price of $110.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Bronx Girls Skate
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Bronx Girls Skate celebrates community, grit, and creativity through a design rooted in real skate culture. The color mix pulls from urban energy and youth expression, giving the Dunk Low a raw and authentic feel. It feels grounded and expressive, using contrast and texture to tell a story connected to girls skateboarding and the Bronx scene that inspired it.

Fans love this release because it feels genuine. Nike SB collaborations resonate most when they spotlight real communities, and this pair does exactly that. Collectors appreciate how the Dunk Low becomes a platform for representation rather than just design, making this a sneaker that carries cultural weight while still delivering the durability and board feel skaters expect.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Bronx Girls Skate was released on January 27, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey is a low-cut sneaker whose design follows the classic color blocking of previous Dunk Lows, with this iteration presenting in a dark smoke grey and black color palette.

The SB Dunk by Nike is a low top sneaker that has a solid following thanks to its relaxed, casual aesthetic and comfortable fit. Fresh colorways are always appearing, and this iteration boasts a tonal dark smoke grey and black combination. The entire upper is all suede. The dark smoke grey envelopes the toe cap, forefoot, eyelet, and heel overlay. While black fills in the remaining areas. The white midsole adds balance, while the gum outsole is a classic choice that provides well-needed traction.

According to our experts, the black leather Swoosh is a premium design element and gives this shoe a touch of elegance. The Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey was released on December 3, 2024, with a $115 recommended retail price.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise leans into contrast and texture, pairing a lightning yellow base with wolf grey and denim turquoise accents that create a layered and slightly rugged feel. The denim elements add depth to the upper, giving the shoe a different visual texture compared to standard leather builds. It feels both vibrant and grounded at the same time.

This pair stands out because of its material mix. SB Dunk releases often experiment with fabrics, and this version uses denim to shift the overall look while keeping the silhouette familiar. It is a bold but wearable option for those who want something more expressive without losing structure.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn
description:
The Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn boasts that recognizable Nike SB Dunk silhouette with a Halloween-inspired colorway and candy details.

A gradient of Amarillo and Orange covers the smooth leather upper and overlays before fading to white across the vamp. It appears almost spraypainted across the sneaker. This high-top skateboarding shoe features overlapping Swoosh logos in Orange and Amarillo on the left and right sides that connect around the heel. In addition, the Orange swoosh complements the laces and the stitching along the midsole. The rubber outsole provides traction and a burst of black that contrasts the bright colors on the upper.

Our experts at StockX love the Trick-or-Treat-inspired insole. It features graphics of candy corn with pennies, a nod to candy corn's status as the original "penny candy." The Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn was released on October 18, 2023, and retailed at $125.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon is a creative collaboration between Nike SB and pro skateboarder, Alexis Sablone. Known for her unique style both on and off the board, Sablone draws inspiration from chameleons for this standout design. The sneaker features an oil green, desert moss, and white colorway with chameleon-like color-shifting panels and scale-textured overlays that make it truly one-of-a-kind. The playful design is a nod to the ever-evolving world of skateboarding and style.

The Nike SB Dunk has been a cultural icon since its debut in the early 2000s, blending performance features with a design that has transcended the skate world. This latest iteration continues that legacy, featuring Sablone’s logo on the heel and interior of the sneaker. The green scale overlays reveal a purple layer underneath, adding a dynamic touch that changes as the shoes wear in. This mix of artistry, functionality, and personal expression makes the Alexis Sablone Chameleon Dunk an instant classic that appeals to skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike.

Released on August 22, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon retailed at $135. Its oil green, desert moss, and white colorway, combined with the unique wear-and-reveal feature, ensures this sneaker is more than just a stylish piece—it's a statement. Whether you’re skating or simply making a fashion statement, this collaboration captures the essence of both skate culture and Sablone’s creative spirit.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings
description:
Introducing the Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings, a sneaker that pays homage to the thrifty spirit and celebrates the art of the find. Released on April 17, 2024, these kicks are a perfect match for the crowd with a penchant for vintage vibes and sustainable fashion. Decked in a mix of baroque brown, summit white, sanddrift, dark smoke grey, and paradise aqua, the design mirrors the eclectic array of goods one might discover in antique, vintage and thrift shops.​
​​
​Constructed with a medley of premium materials, the Nike SB Dunk Low tells its unique story through textures that evoke the thrill of thrifting. You'll notice the suede overlays reminiscent of well-worn leathers and rope-textured laces that speak to the craft and quality of past eras. The sneaker's inner tongue features a boldly stated 'BIG MONEY SAVINGS' tag, a playful nod to the unexpected deals and steals found in the hunt for hidden gems.​
​​
​At $125, the Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings is a narrative woven into each thread, inspired by a sustainable choice that resonates with the values of its wearers. It's an invitation to explore the stories behind the style, to embrace the patina of the past, and to make a fashion statement that is as conscious as it is cool.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black feels like a bridge between skate history and Supreme’s early visual language, pulling inspiration from the mid nineties era that shaped both brands. The black upper gives the shoe a serious and raw tone, while the Supreme influence adds cultural weight that longtime fans instantly recognize. It feels rooted in authenticity rather than trend chasing, designed for people who understand where SB culture comes from.

This release stands out because it honors restraint. Instead of loud graphics, the design relies on mood and legacy, letting subtle details do the storytelling. Collectors gravitate toward Supreme SB Dunks like this because they represent moments when skateboarding, fashion, and attitude aligned naturally, creating pieces that age with meaning rather than noise.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black was released on 09/04/2025 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low City of Love Light Bone
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low City Of Love Light Bone is a masterpiece of design that captures the essence of Paris, the City of Love, in every stitch and shade. Adorned in a harmonious blend of coconut milk, light bone, phantom, university red, and sail, this sneaker reflects the city’s renowned architecture, elegance, and vibrant culture. Crafted for those who appreciate the subtleties of storytelling through design, this edition brings a piece of Parisian spirit to the world of skateboarding and streetwear.

Drawing inspiration from the limestone facades and the romantic allure that pervades Paris’s streets, the sneaker’s colorway is a nod to both the city’s historic charm and its modern vibrancy. The use of university red accents evokes the passion and love that the city symbolizes, while the detailed construction and choice of materials showcase Nike’s dedication to quality and innovation. It’s a celebration of Parisian creativity, designed for those who navigate the urban landscape with ease and elegance.

Released on February 9, 2024, for $125, the Nike SB Dunk Low City Of Love Light Bone became an instant icon among sneaker enthusiasts and Francophiles alike.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro J-Pack Chicago
description:
The latest Nike SB Dunk J-Pack Chicago keeps Jordan Brand’s relationship with skateboarding strong. For those that don’t know, before the plethora of options for proper skateboarding footwear, skaters in the 80s and 90s preferred boarding in Air Jordan 1s. The sneaker’s high top construction provided the proper amount of ankle support needed to bare various skateboarding tricks. The recent addition to the Nike SB Dunk J-Pack pays homage to Air Jordan 1’s involvement with early skate culture.

This Nike SB Dunk Low J-Pack Chicago has something that both Jordan and SB heads will enjoy. The classic SB Dunk Low silhouette is dressed in a Chicago Jordan 1 red, white, and black leather colorway. From there, a fat tongue and oval laces introduce the skateboarding aspect of the sneaker.

The Nike SB Dunk Low J-Pack Chicago release in September 2020 for $95. They were re-released in 2024.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum dresses the classic silhouette with practical colors.

This Nike SB Dunk Low Black Gum color scheme consists of the classic combination of black, white, and Gum light brown. Its upper is composed of black nubuck material, complemented by a white leather Nike Swoosh. The heel tab is also adorned with an embroidered Nike wordmark in the same white color. The sneaker features a traditional cupsole design with white sidewalls and a tacky gum rubber outsole for traction. Additionally, a Zoom Air unit is incorporated into the insole to provide cushioning.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum was released on 1st March 2023 with its retail price set at $110.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club features the classic low-top silhouette of the SB Dunk in a colorway inspired by the Crenshaw Skate Club, including a mix of earthy tones – Sail, light blue, and Cedar.

The Crenshaw Skate Club Nike SB Dunk Low incorporates a Sail foundation adorned with cracked leather overlays, drawing inspiration from the iconic Crenshaw Square sign. Each tongue tag and back tab displays Nike and CSC branding in a mismatched manner, adding a unique touch to the design. Inside the tongue sits an illustration reminiscent of a daycare, and this graphic is repeated under the translucent rubber outsole, which features a subtle blue tint. The sneaker features light blue Swoosh logos on either side.

Our experts love the Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club and its unique colorway inspired by the Crenshaw Skate Club, a nod to the local skateboarding culture and community. This collaborative aspect and the earthy color palette set it apart from other SB Dunk releases. The sneaker debuted for $130 on August 5th, 2023.

description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Saffron Quartz brings a warm, earthy palette to the beloved skate focused Dunk Low silhouette, combining saffron quartz, pear, buff gold, sequoia, and barley into a genuinely rich, layered color story. Nike SB's involvement ties this shoe directly to skateboarding culture, ensuring genuine functional skate credibility alongside its considered, nature inspired aesthetic. This warm tonal combination offers a distinctive alternative within the extensive SB Dunk Low catalog, favoring earthy sophistication over bold, high contrast color blocking.

Nike SB has consistently found creative color concepts to drive its Dunk Low releases, giving skateboarding focused collectors thematically rich pairs beyond simple bold color updates. This saffron and sequoia combination offers a genuinely distinctive, earth toned take within the extensive SB Dunk catalog, appealing to collectors who appreciate more sophisticated, muted palettes. Fans of both skate culture and the Dunk Low's storied collecting history find this release compelling for how it merges genuine skateboarding functionality with a considered, nature inspired color story.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Saffron Quartz was released on August 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass rides straight out of San Francisco skate culture with a color palette inspired by the city transit system. title: Nike Vomero Plus White Pearl Pink Peony (Women's)
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus White Pearl Pink Peony is a women's exclusive colorway that finds the Vomero Plus at its most lifestyle-forward, pairing a clean white engineered mesh upper with Pearl Pink and Peony accents in a combination that feels soft and considered without crossing into saccharine territory. White forms the primary base across the breathable yarn upper, with Pearl Pink appearing through the overlays and structural panels in a tone that adds warmth and dimension while maintaining the overall lightness of the palette. Peony traces through the midsole detailing and select accents in a slightly deeper, more saturated pink that anchors the colorway and prevents the build from reading as purely neutral. A Phantom grey underlay keeps the base grounded, and the shoe's overall profile, elevated by a towering ZoomX midsole stack, gives it a presence that reads immediately modern without losing the approachable character of the color story.

The Vomero Plus sits as the middle tier of Nike's 2026 Vomero lineup, positioned between the standard Vomero 18 and the elite Vomero Premium, offering a full-length ZoomX foam experience at approximately 45mm in the heel without the exposed Air unit architecture of the Premium model. For women who want a high-stack recovery shoe that provides genuine plush cushioning across everyday runs and easy effort days, the Plus delivers that in a package weighing approximately 242 grams with a ten-millimeter heel-to-toe drop that makes long-duration wear feel natural rather than fatiguing. The White Pearl Pink Peony colorway makes the shoe equally compelling as a running piece and a casual lifestyle choice, and the elevated midsole stack gives it a visual presence that looks as considered standing still as it does in motion.

The Nike Vomero Plus White Pearl Pink Peony Women's was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

The Vomero Plus platform's premium cushioning specification and elevated construction quality make it one of the most rewarding daily wear acquisitions in Nike's current running lifestyle lineup, the substantial stack height and premium materials creating a wearing experience that rewards the investment beyond what lighter and more minimal running silhouettes in similar colorways can provide. At one hundred and eighty dollars the Vomero Plus in this colorway is a serious running lifestyle investment that delivers premium cushioning and palette sophistication in equal measure.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Chicago Marathon
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Chicago Marathon celebrates the Bank of America Chicago Marathon with city-inspired details and a cushioning system built for high-mileage training. Its Energy, Green Strike, Arctic Green, Deep Teal, Black, and Action Grape palette gives the substantial silhouette a vivid appearance. An engineered mesh upper provides lightweight breathability, while Chicago graphics connect the shoe to one of running’s best-known annual events.

A full-length ZoomX midsole surrounds two Air Zoom units positioned at the forefoot and heel. This combination delivers responsive cushioning within a pronounced 55-millimeter stack, creating the model’s distinctive profile. A padded tongue and collar add comfort, while a high-abrasion rubber Waffle outsole provides durable traction. Reflective details and a Chicago-inspired insole print complete the construction, which features a 10-millimeter heel-to-toe drop.

The race-specific graphics give this training silhouette a connection to Chicago that extends beyond its colorful finish. Released on September 24, 2026, the Nike Vomero Premium Chicago Marathon retailed for $240.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Black White
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Black White is the most foundational and most broadly versatile colorway in the debut August 7, 2025 launch of the Vomero Plus, Nike's mid-tier entry in the three-level Vomero product family that sits between the Vomero 18 icon model and the Vomero Premium, applying a full-length ZoomX midsole for higher stack height and softer ride than the Vomero 18 while maintaining the daily trainer positioning appropriate to the Vomero franchise's identity as Nike's maximum-cushioning road running series. The Vomero Plus was designed by an all-female team over nine months with women's insights at the foundation of every construction decision, a development approach that shaped the shoe's softer, more rounded visual language as a deliberate departure from the sharp, aggressive lines of more performance-focused Nike running shoes, making the silhouette feel more accessible and more inviting without compromising the responsiveness and mileage-capability that serious daily trainers require. The Black and White colorway, with Anthracite, Light Smoke Grey, and Metallic Silver accent details completing the full palette, is the launch pair that most directly connects the Vomero Plus to the running tradition of clean, non-distracting colorways designed for wearers who want the shoe to disappear into their outfit rather than define it. The engineered mesh upper with no-sew overlays delivers the lightweight, breathable, and aerodynamic construction that the Vomero Plus's full-ZoomX midsole stack demands, keeping the upper from adding unnecessary weight or warmth above the shoe's substantial cushioning platform. A curved toe design supports the shoe's rocker geometry for smooth heel-to-toe transitions, reflective details provide low-light visibility for morning or evening runs, and high-abrasion rubber on the outsole ensures the platform holds up across the mileage for which maximum-cushioning trainers are typically used. Style code HV8150-002, $170.

The Nike Vomero Plus Black White is the debut colorway for the runner who wants the most foundational and most styling-versatile execution of Nike's new mid-tier ZoomX maximum-cushioning daily trainer, the pair that earns its place in a running rotation through technology rather than color.

The Nike Vomero Plus Black White was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: adidas Samba Jane Ruffle Pack White Pink Gum (Women's)
description:
The Adidas Samba Jane in Cloud White, Pink, and Gum for Women is a colorway that brings the women's specific Samba Jane silhouette to one of its most naturally flattering and seasonally resonant expressions, pairing the clean brightness of cloud white with a pink accent that sits in the warm and approachable range of the color spectrum that has consistently proven to be among the most beloved and wearable options in the contemporary women's sneaker market. Cloud white provides the pristine and open foundation that the Samba Jane's clean lines and considered proportions demand, allowing the pink detailing to register as a deliberate and confident color choice rather than a competing element in a visually crowded composition, and the gum sole adds the warm vintage quality that connects every Samba colorway back to the silhouette's deep athletic archive roots regardless of how fashion forward the color story above it might be. Pink on a Samba Jane occupies a specific and beloved space in the women's sneaker conversation, speaking simultaneously to the color's feminine and cultural associations and to the broader streetwear and fashion rehabilitation of pink as a serious and considered palette choice rather than a default or expected one.

The Samba Jane's women's specific construction means every element of the fit, last geometry, and proportioning has been developed for the female foot rather than adapted from a men's template, which makes the cloud white and pink colorway feel as correct and intentional in its physical wearing experience as it does in its visual presentation. Gum soles on white and pink Samba colorways create a particularly harmonious and complete shoe, the warm translucent brown of the gum providing the ideal neutral grounding element that allows both the white upper and the pink accents to exist in their fullest and most expressive form without any visual competition from the sole unit. For women who want a Samba Jane that feels soft, wearable, and genuinely spring and summer ready without sacrificing any of the silhouette's inherent cool and cultural credibility, cloud white pink gum is the colorway that delivers that combination most completely.

The Adidas Samba Jane in Cloud White, Pink, and Gum Women's has a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White (Women's)
description:
The Adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White is the summer rethink the Samba has genuinely earned after years of dominating every other season, and it arrives as one of the most structurally interesting iterations the silhouette has produced across its long run of 2020s relevance. Offered exclusively in women's sizing, this version of the Samba strips the heel counter entirely and reconstructs the upper in an open, breathable basketweave woven leather that feels as purposeful as it looks unique, turning one of football footwear's most enduring shapes into a warm weather slip-on that retains every visual cue that makes the Samba instantly recognizable. The monochromatic cream white treatment runs across the woven leather body, suede T-toe overlay, and eyestay panels in a single cohesive tone that emphasizes the texture story rather than competing with it, while gold Samba script lettering on the outer side reintroduces the branding in a script-style font that feels entirely right for a shoe this relaxed in its attitude. The classic gum cupsole and low-profile silhouette carry forward from the original, keeping the heritage footprint intact while everything above the sole speaks to a completely different seasonal register. Three Stripes appear in a slightly textured finish that blends into the woven construction rather than interrupting it, and the overall effect is a shoe that manages to feel brand new while still carrying thirty years of Samba DNA in every stitch.

The Samba has done Mary Janes, brogues, snakeskin boots, and collaboration reworks by some of fashion's most respected names, but the Mule Woven is the version that makes the most sense for how people actually want to wear shoes in summer: easy on, heritage intact, and light enough to forget you're wearing them until someone stops to ask what they are.

The Adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White Womens was released on June 1, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

title: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver Womens reimagines the iconic Samba through a glamorous and fashion forward lens. Crystal white leather forms a clean and minimal base, elevated by rhinestone detailing that catches light with every step. Silver metallic accents add refinement, while the gum sole maintains the shoe’s connection to its athletic origins. The contrast between sparkle and simplicity defines the look.

This version appeals to fans who enjoy pushing classic silhouettes into new spaces. It feels expressive and confident, designed for those who see sneakers as an extension of personal style rather than purely function. Collectors value how the rhinestone treatment transforms a familiar shape into something celebratory and bold without compromising its recognizability. It is a statement piece that still carries the cultural weight of the Samba name.

The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver Womens was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: adidas Samba OG Gold Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's)
description:
adidas Samba OG Gold Metallic Cracked Leather Womens elevates a global icon through texture and shine, transforming the Samba into something bold and celebratory. The cracked metallic gold leather adds dimension and character, giving the shoe a luxurious edge while preserving the familiar shape that made the Samba timeless. It feels expressive and fashion forward without losing its sporting DNA.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it balances statement and restraint. The cracked finish creates visual interest that rewards closer inspection, while the classic tooling keeps it grounded. It appeals to fans who enjoy seeing heritage silhouettes reimagined through material experimentation, proving that even the most familiar designs can still surprise when handled thoughtfully.

The adidas Samba OG Gold Metallic Cracked Leather Womens was released on 09/24/2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Collegiate Green (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green refreshes the legendary silhouette with a color palette that feels both grounded and expressive. Black leather anchors the upper, contrasted by cream white accents that soften the look and collegiate green details that add character and depth. The familiar gum sole reinforces the Samba’s heritage while keeping the overall presentation clean and balanced.

Collectors appreciate this colorway because it feels versatile without being predictable. The green accent brings a subtle collegiate energy that nods to sport culture while remaining easy to style across different aesthetics. This version of the Samba feels intentional and wearable, proving that thoughtful color placement can keep a decades old design feeling relevant. It is the kind of pair that quietly earns its place in rotation through comfort, history, and effortless appeal.

The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: adidas Samba OG Off White Crystal Linen (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Off White Crystal Linen Womens delivers a soft and fully tonal take on the silhouette through a clean and layered neutral palette. The off white upper creates a smooth and minimal base, while crystal linen accents add subtle depth that enhances the overall design. The look feels refined and cohesive, emphasizing simplicity and balance.

Fans of neutral Sambas appreciate how tonal variations like this elevate the silhouette without relying on bold contrast. The clean execution makes it highly versatile across different outfits. It is a sneaker that reflects understated elegance within a timeless design.

adidas Samba OG Crochet Pack Sand Strata (Women's)
description: The adidas Samba OG Crochet Pack Sand Strata (Women's) offers a unique, artisanal update to the iconic indoor soccer silhouette. The shoe features Sand Strata, Magic Beige, and Gum. The design replaces the traditional leather upper with an intricately crocheted textile, providing a distinct texture and handmade aesthetic. The design maintains the signature T-toe structure and gum rubber outsole. Slated for release on June 1, 2025, this textural model carries a retail price of $100. The light, cohesive tones of Sand Strata and Magic Beige emphasize the woven texture of the crochet material. The Gum outsole roots the design in its heritage, contrasting the contemporary textile update. Our experts commend the unique, high-texture finish created by the intricate crocheted Sand Strata upper, offering a stylish, artisanal twist on the classic Samba.

title: adidas Samba OG Black Off White (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Black Off White (Women's) gives the familiar Samba a darker look. Core Black covers the upper and Three Stripes, while Off White provides a lighter accent. Its low profile shape, T-toe, and gum sole keep the details that made the Samba recognizable long after its beginnings as a football shoe.

For collectors, the appeal is in this colorway’s simplicity. It has the shape of a classic Samba without the sharper contrast of the usual black and white pair. That makes it easy to wear with denim, tailored pants, or casual layers, while still giving Samba fans a distinct colorway to add to their rotation. The restrained palette also lets the shoe’s proportions and familiar paneling carry the design.

This is a practical pair for someone who wears their collection often, especially if they want a black sneaker with a little more character than a plain tonal shoe. The adidas Samba OG Black Off White (Women's) released April 20, 2026, with a retail price of $110.
